Bava Metzia 42a:2-7: Gemara bishlama kullehu shello shimmer kederech hashshomrim. ella tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav, may hava leh lemibad? amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak amar kera: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", af al pi shetztzerurin – yihyu beyadcha.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: leolam yehe kaspo shel adam matzuy beyado, shenneemar: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha". veamar rabbi yitzchak: leolam yashlish adam et meotav, shelish bekarka, ushelish bifrakmatya, ushelish tachat yado.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha". tana deve rabbi yishmael: en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar sheen haayin sholetet bo, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha".

Tanu rabbanan: haholech lamod et gorno, omer: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettishlach beracha bemaase yadenu". hitchil lamod, omer: "baruch hashsholeach beracha bakkeri hazze". madad veachar kach berach – hare ze tefillat shav, lefi sheen habberacha metzuya lo bedavar hashshakul velo bedavar hammadud velo bedavar hammanuy, ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha".

Amar shemuel: kesafim en lahem shemira ella bakkarka. amar rava: umode shemuel beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, dela atrechu rabbanan. vei sheha lemotzae shabbat shiur lemikberinhu vela kavrinhu – mechayyayv. vei tzureba merabbanan hu savar: dilma mibbee leh zuze leavdalta.

Vehaiddana dishchichi gashoshae – en lahen shemira ella bishme kora. vehaiddana dishchichi paromae – en lahem shemira ella bene ureve. amar rava: umode shemuel bechotel, i name ben hakkeranot. vehaiddana dishchichi tafochae – en lahen shemira ella betefach hassamuch lakkarka, o betefach hassamuch lishme kora.
Berakhot 6b:2-13: Amar ravin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: kol haragil lavo levet hakkeneset velo ba yom echad, hakkadosh baruch hu meshael bo, shenneemar: "mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo asher halach chashechim veen noga lo".
Im lidvar mitzva halach — noga lo, veim lidvar harshut halach — en noga lo.
"Yivtach beshem Adonai" may tama? — mishshum dahava leh livtoach beshem Adonai, vela betach.
Amar rabbi yochanan: beshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu ba bevet hakkeneset, velo matza bah asara — miyyad hu koes, shenneemar: "maddua bati veen ish karati veen one".
Amar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol hakkovea makom litfillato — elohe avraham beezro.
Ucheshemmet, omrim lo: "e anav, e chasid, mittalmidav shel avraham avinu".
Veavraham avinu mena lan dikva makom? dichtiv: "vayyashkem avraham babboker el hammakom asher amad sham", veen "amida" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel".
Amar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset al yafsia pesia gassa. amar abbaye: la amaran, ella lemippak. aval lemeal — mitzva lemirhat, shenneemar: "nirdefa ladaat et Adonai".

Amar rabbi zera: meresh ki hava chazena lehu lerabbanan deka rahati lefirka beshabbeta, amena: "ka mechallayin rabbanan shabbeta". kevan dishmana leha derabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: leolam yarutz adam lidvar halacha vaafillu beshabbat, shenneemar: "achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag" vegomer, ana name rahetna.
Amar rabbi zera: agra defirka — rihata.

Mishnah Meilah 6:6: Peruta shel hekdesh shennafla letoch hakkis, o sheamar, peruta vechis ze hekdesh, kevan shehotzi et harishona, maal, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis. mode rabbi akiva beomer peruta min hakkis ze hekdesh, shehu motzi veholech ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis:
Mishnah Nazir 6:10-7:2:
Gillach al hazzevach venimtza fasul, tiglachto fesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. gillach al hachattat shello lishmah veachar kach hevi karbenotav lishman, tiglachto fesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. gillach al haola o al hashshelamim shello lishman veachar kach hevi karbenotav lishman, tiglachto fesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. rabbi shimon omer, oto hazzevach lo ala lo, aval shear zevachim alu lo. veim gillach al shelashtan venimtza echad mehen kasher, tiglachto cheshera, veyavi shear hazzevachim: 
Mi shennizrak alav echad min haddamim venitma, rabbi eliezer omer, soter et hakkol. vachachamim omrim, yavi shear karbenotav veyithar. amru lo, maase vemiryam hattarmodit shennizrak aleha echad min haddamim, uvau veamru lah al bittah shehayta mesukkenet, vehalcha umetzatah shemmeta, veamru chachamim, tavi shear karbenoteha vetithar: 
Kohen gadol venazir enan mittammein likrovehen, aval mittammein lemet mitzva. hayu mehallechin badderech umatzu met mitzva, rabbi eliezer omer, yittamma chohen gadol veal yittamma nazir. vachachamim omrim, yittamma nazir veal yittamma chohen gadol. amar lahem rabbi eliezer, yittamma chohen sheeno mevi karban al tumato, veal yittamma nazir shehu mevi karban al tumato. amru lo, yittamma nazir sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam, veal yittamma chohen shekkedushshato kedushshat olam: 
Al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach, al hammet, veal kazzayit min hammet, veal kazzayit netzel veal melo tarvad rakav, al hashshidra veal haggulgolet veal ever min hammet veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alav basar karauy, veal chatzi kav atzamot veal chatzi log dam, al maggaan veal massaan veal oholan, veal etzem kasseora, al maggao veal massao. al ellu hannazir megalleach umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii, vesoter et hakkodmin, veeno matchil limnot ella ad sheyyithar umevi et karbenotav:
Mishnah Nazir 6:5-9:
Shelosha minin asurin bannazir, hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggafen. chomer battuma uvattiglachat mibbayyotze min haggefen, shehattuma vehattiglachat sotrin, vehayyotze min haggefen eno soter. chomer bayyotze min haggefen mibbattuma uvattiglachat, shehayyotze min haggefen lo huttar mikkelalo, vetuma vetiglachat hutteru mikkelalan betiglachat mitzva uvemet mitzva. vechomer battuma mibbattiglachat, shehattuma soteret et hakkol vechayyavin aleha karban, vetiglachat enah soteret ella sheloshim yom veen chayyavin aleha karban: 
Tiglachat hattuma ketzad, haya mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii, umegalleach bashshevii, umevi karbenotav bashshemini. veim gillach bashshemini, mevi karbenotav bo vayyom, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi tarfon, ma ben ze lammetzora. amar lo, ze tohorato teluya veyamav, umetzora tohorato teluya vetiglachto, veeno mevi karban ella im ken haya meorav shamesh: 
Tiglachat hattohora ketzad, haya mevi shalosh behemot, chattat ola ushelamim, veshochet et hashshelamim, umegalleach alehem, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar omer, lo haya megalleach ella al hachattat, shehachattat kodemet bechol makom. veim gillach al achat mishshelashtan, yatza: 
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hevi shalosh behemot velo feresh, haruya lechattat tikrav chattat, leola tikrav ola, lishlamim tikrav shelamim. haya notel sear rosh nizro umeshalleach tachat haddud. veim gillach bammedina haya meshalleach tachat haddud. bamme devarim amurim, betiglachat hattohora. aval betiglachat hattuma, lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud. rabbi meir omer, hakkol meshallechin tachat haddud, chutz min hattame shebbammedina bilvad: 
Haya mevashshel et hashshelamim o sholkan. hakkohen notel et hazzeroa beshela min haayil, vechallat matztza achat min hassal, urekik matztza echad, venoten al kappe hannazir umenifan, veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulehittamme lemetim. rabbi shimon omer, kevan shennizrak alav echad min haddamim, huttar hannazir lishtot beyayin ulehittamme lemetim:
Mishnah Nazir 7:3-8:2:
Aval hassechachot, vehapperaot, uvet happeras, veeretz haammim, vehaggolel, vehaddofek, ureviit dam, veohel, verova atzamot, vechelim hannogim bemet, vime safro, vime gamro, al ellu en hannazir megalleach, umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii, veeno soter et hakkodmin, umatchil umone miyyad, vekarban en lo. beemet amru, yeme hazzav vehazzava vime hesgero shel metzora, hare ellu olin lo: 
Amar rabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, kol tuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha, chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. vechol tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha, en chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. amar rabbi meir, lo tehe zo kalla min hashsheretz. amar rabbi akiva, danti lifne rabbi eliezer, ma im etzem kasseora sheeno metamme adam beohel, hannazir megalleach al maggao veal massao. reviit dam shehu metamme adam beohel, eno din sheyyehe hannazir megalleach al maggaah veal massaah. amar li, ma ze akiva, en danin kan mikkal vachomer. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti et haddevarim lifne rabbi yehoshua, amar li, yafe amarta, ella ken amru halacha: 
Shene nezirim sheamar lahen echad, raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea eze mikkem, megallechin umeviin karban tuma vekarban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha. vesofrin sheloshim yom, umeviin karban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha veze karban tohorati. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha veze karban tohoratcha. met echad mehen, amar rabbi yehoshua, yevakkesh echad min hashshuk sheyyiddor kenegdo venazir, veomer, im tame hayiti, hare atta nazir miyyad. veim tahor hayiti, hare atta nazir achar sheloshim yom. vesofrin sheloshim yom, umeviin karban tuma vekarban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellech. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma besafek. vesofrin sheloshim yom umeviin karban tohora, veomer, im ani hu hattame, karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha veze karban tohorati. veim ani hu hattahor, karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma besafek vezehu karban tohoratcha. amar lo ven zoma, umi shomea lo sheyyiddor kenegdo venazir. ella mevi chattat haof veolat behema, veomer, im tame hayiti, hachattat mechovati vehaola nedava. veim tahor hayiti, haola mechovati vehachattat besafek. vesofer sheloshim yom umevi karban tohora, veomer, im tame hayiti, haola harishona nedava vezo chova. veim tahor hayiti, haola harishona chova vezo nedava, veze shear karbani. amar rabbi yehoshua, nimtza ze mevi karbenotav lachatzaim. aval hodu lo chachamim leven zoma: 
Nazir shehaya tame vesafek umuchlat besafek, ochel bakkadashim achar shishshim yom, veshote yayin umittamme lemetim achar mea veesrim yom, shettiglachat hannega docha tiglachat hannazir bizman shehu vadday, aval bizman shehu safek enah docha:
Mishnah Nazir 9:1-5:
Haggoyim en lahem nezirut. nashim vaavadim yesh lahem nezirut. chomer bannashim mibbaavadim, shehu chofe et avdo veeno chofe et ishto. chomer baavadim mibbannashim, shehu mefer nidre ishto veeno mefer nidre avdo. hefer leishto, hefer olamit. hefer leavdo, yatza lecherut mashlim neziruto. avar mikkeneged panav, rabbi meir omer, lo yishte, verabbi yose omer, yishte: 
Nazir sheggillach venoda lo shehu tame, im tuma yedua, soter. veim tumat hattehom, eno soter. im ad shello gillach, ben kach uven kach soter. ketzad, yarad litbol bimara venimtza met tzaf al pi hammeara, tame. nimtza meshukka bekarka hammeara, yarad lehaker, tahor. littaher mittumat met, tame, shechezkat tame tame vechezkat tahor tahor, sheraglayim laddavar: 
Hammotze met bitchilla mushkav kedarko, notlo veet tevusato. matza shenayim, notlan veet tevusatan. matza shelosha, im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone, hare zo shechunat kevarot. bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. matza echad besof esrim amma, bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma, sheraglayim laddavar, sheillu mittechilla metzao, notlo veet tevusato: 
Kol sefek negaim battechilla, tahor ad shello nizkak lattuma. mishshennizkak lattuma, sefeko tame. beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav ad shello nizkak lazziva. bemaachol, uvemishte, bemassa, uvikfitza, uvecholi, uvemare, uvehirhur. mishshennizkak lazziva, en bodkin oto. anso usefeko veshichvat zaro, temein, sheraglayim laddavar. hammakke et chavero vaamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya, leachar mikkan hichbid umet, chayyav. rabbi nechemya omer, patur, sheraglayim laddavar: 
Nazir haya shemuel, kedivre rabbi nehoray, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 1) umora lo yaale al rosho, neemar beshimshon (Shoftim 13) umora, veneemar bishmuel umora, ma mora haamura veshimshon, nazir, af mora haamura vishmuel, nazir. amar rabbi yose, vahalo en mora ella shel basar vadam. amar lo rabbi nehoray, vahalo chevar neemar (Shmuel 1 16) vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani, shekkevar haya alav mora shel basar vadam:
Mishnah Sheviit 7:2-5:
Veod kelal acher amru, kol sheeno maachal adam umaachal behema, umimmin hatztzovin, umitkayyem baaretz, yesh lo sheviit uledamav sheviit, en lo biur veen ledamav biur. e zehu, ikkar halluf hashshote, veikkar haddandanna, vehaarkavnin, vehachalbetzin, vehabbuchriyya. umimmin hatztzovin, happua veharichpa, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit, en lahem biur velo lidmehen biur. rabbi meir omer, demehem mitbaarin ad rosh hashshana. amru lo, lahen en biur, kal vachomer lidmehen: 
Kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello, kelippe egozim vehaggalinin, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit. hatztzabba, tzovea leatzmo, velo yitzba besachar, sheen osin sechora beferot sheviit, velo vivchorot, velo vitrumot, velo vinvelot, velo vitrefot, velo vishkatzim, velo virmasim. velo yihye lokeach yarkot sade umocher bashshuk, aval hu loket uveno mocher al yado. lakach leatzmo vehotir, muttar lemachran: 
Lakach bechor lemishte veno o laregel velo tzarich lo, muttar lemachro. tzade chayya ofot vedagim shennizdammenu lahem minim temein, muttarim lemachran. rabbi yehuda omer, af mi shennitmanna lo lefi darko, lokeach umocher, uvilvad shello tehe ummanuto vechach. vachachamim osrin: 
Luleve zeradim vehecharuvin, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit, yesh lahen biur velidmehen biur. luleve haela vehabbatna vehaatadin, yesh lahem sheviit, velidmehen sheviit, en lahem biur velo lidmehen biur. aval lealin yesh biur, mippene shennoshrin meavihen:
Mishnah Sheviit 7:6-8:3:
Havvered vehakkofer vehakketaf vehallotem, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit. rabbi shimon omer, en lakketaf sheviit, mippene sheeno feri: 
Vered chadash shekkevasho beshemen yashan, yelakket et havvered. veyashan bechadash, chayyav babbiur. charuvin chadashim shekkevashan beyayin yashan, vishanim bechadash, chayyavin babbiur. ze hakkelal, kol shehu venoten taam, chayyav levaer, min besheeno mino. umin bemino, kol shehu. sheviit oseret kol shehu beminah, veshello veminah, benoten taam: 
Kelal gadol amru bashsheviit, kol hameyuchad lemaachal adam, en osin mimmennu melugema laadam, veen tzarich lomar labbehema. vechol sheeno meyuchad lemaachal adam, osin mimmennu melugema leadam, aval lo livhema. vechol sheeno meyuchad lo lemaachal adam velo lemaachal behema, chashav alav lemaachal adam ulemaachal behema, notnin alav chumre adam vechumre vehema. chashav alav leetzim, hare hu cheetzim, kegon hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit: 
Sheviit, nittena laachila velishtiyya ulesicha, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, velasuch davar sheddarko lasuch. lo yasuch yayin vachometz, aval sach hu et hashshamen. vechen bitruma uvemaaser sheni. kal mehem sheviit, shennittena lehadelakat hanner: 
En mochrin perot sheviit, lo vemidda, velo vemishkal, velo veminyan, velo teenim beminyan, velo yarak bemishkal. bet shammay omrim, af lo aguddot. uvet hillel omrim, et sheddarko leegod babbayit, ogdin oto bashshuk, kegon hakkereshin venetz hechalav:
Mishnah Sheviit 8:4-7:
Haomer lappoel, he lach issar ze ulekot li yarak hayyom, secharo muttar. lekot li bo yarak hayyom, secharo asur. lakach min hannachtom kikkar befunedyon, kesheelkot yarkot sade avi lach, muttar. lakach mimmennu setam, lo yeshallem lo middeme sheviit, sheen porin chov middeme sheviit: 
En notnim, lo levayyar, velo levallan, velo lesappar, velo lesappan. aval noten hu levayyar lishtot. ulechullan, hu noten mattenat chinnam: 
Teenim shel sheviit, en kotzin otan bemuktze, aval kotze otam bacharba. en dorchin anavim baggat, aval dorech hu baareva. veen osin zetim babbad uvakkotev, aval kotesh hu umachnis labbodida. rabbi shimon omer, af tochen hu bevet habbad umachnis labbodida: 
En mevashshelin yarak shel sheviit beshemen shel teruma, shello yeviennu lide fesul. rabbi shimon mattir. veacharon acharon, nitpas bashsheviit. vehapperi atzmo, asur:
Mishnah Sheviit 8:8-11:
En lokchim avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea middeme sheviit. veim lakach, yochal kenegdan. en meviin kinne zavim vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot middeme sheviit. veim hevi, yochal kenegdan. en sachin kelim beshemen shel sheviit. veim sach, yochal kenegdo: 
Or shessacho beshemen shel sheviit, rabbi eliezer omer, yiddalek. vachachamim omrim, yochal kenegdo. amru lifne rabbi akiva, omer haya rabbi eliezer, or shessacho veshemen shel sheviit, yiddalek. amar lahem, shetoku, lo omar lachem ma sherabbi eliezer omer bo: 
Veod amru lefanav, omer haya rabbi eliezer, haochel pat kutim keochel besar chazir. amar lahem, shetoku, lo omar lachem ma sherabbi eliezer omer bo: 
Merchatz shehusseka beteven o vekash shel sheviit, muttar lirchotz bah. veim mitchashshev hu, hare ze lo yirchotz:
Mishnah Sheviit 9:1-5:
Happegam, vehayyarbuzin hashshotim, vehachalaglogit, kusbar shebbeharim, vehakkarpas shebbanneharot, vehaggarger shel afar, peturin min hammaasrot, venilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit, sheen kayyotze vahem nishmar. rabbi yehuda omer, sefiche chardal, muttarin, shello nechshedu alehen ovre avera. rabbi shimon omer, kol hassefichin muttarin, chutz missefiche cheruv, sheen kayyotze vahem beyarkot sade. vachachamim omrim, kol hassefichin asurin: 
Shalosh aratzot labbiur, yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. veshalosh shalosh aratzot lechol achat veachat. galil haelyon, vegalil hattachton, vehaemek. mikkefar chananya ulemalan, kol sheeno megaddel shikmin, galil haelyon, umikkefar chananya ulemattan, kol shehu megaddel shikmin, galil hattachton. utechum teverya, haemek. uvihuda, hahar vehashshefela vehaemek. ushefelat lod kishfelat haddarom, vehahar shellah kehar hammelech. mibbet choron vead hayyam medina echat: 
Velamma amru shalosh aratzot, sheyyihyu ochlin bechol achat veachat ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbah. rabbi shimon omer, lo amru shalosh aratzot ella vihuda. ushear kol haaratzot, kehar hammelech. vechol haaratzot, keachat lazzetim velattemarim: 
Ochlin al hammufkar, aval lo al hashshamur. rabbi yose mattir af al hashshamur. ochlin al hattefichin veal haddufera, aval lo al hassitvaniyyot. rabbi yehuda mattir kol zeman shebbikkeru ad shello yichle hakkayitz: 
Hakkovesh shelosha chevashim bechavit achat, rabbi eliezer omer, ochlin al harishon. rabbi yehoshua omer, af al haacharon. rabban gamliel omer, kol shekkala mino min hassade, yevaer mino min hechavit, vahalacha chidvarav. rabbi shimon omer, kol yarak, echad labbiur. ochlin bargila ad sheyyichlu siggariyyot mibbikat bet netofa:
Mishnah Sheviit 9:6-9:
Hamelakket asavim lachim, ad sheyyivash hammatok. vehamegabbev bayyavesh, ad shettered revia sheniyya. ale kanim vaale gefanim, ad sheyyishsheru meavihen. vehamegabbev bayyavesh, ad shettered revia sheniyya. rabbi akiva omer, bechullan ad shettered revia sheniyya: 
Kayyotze vo, hammaskir bayit lachavero ad haggeshamim, ad shettered revia sheniyya. hammuddar hanaa mechavero ad haggeshamim, ad shettered revia sheniyya. ad ematay aniyyim nichnasim lappardesot, ad shettered revia sheniyya. meematay nehenin vesorfin batteven uvakkash shel sheviit, mishettered revia sheniyya: 
Mi shehayu lo perot sheviit vehiggia sheat habbiur, mechallek mezon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. vaaniyyim ochlin achar habbiur, aval lo ashirim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, echad aniyyim veechad ashirim ochlin achar habbiur: 
Mi shehayu lo perot sheviit shennaflu lo virushsha o shennittenu lo bemattana, rabbi eliezer omer, yinnatnu leochlehen. vachachamim omrim, en hachote niskar, ella yimmachru leochlehen, udemehem yitchalleku lechol adam. haochel meissat sheviit ad shello hurema challatah, chayyav mita:
Mishnah Sotah 1:1-4:
Hamekanne leishto, rabbi eliezer omer, mekanne lah al pi shenayim, umashkah al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo. rabbi yehoshua omer, mekanne lah al pi shenayim umashkah al pi shenayim: 
Ketzad mekanne lah. amar lah bifne shenayim, al tedabberi im ish peloni, vedibbera immo, adayin hi mutteret levetah umutteret leechol batteruma. nichnesa immo levet hasseter veshahata immo chede tuma, asura levetah vaasura leechol batteruma. veim met, choletzet velo mityabbamet: 
Veellu asurot milleechol batteruma, haomeret temea ani lecha, veshebbau edim shehi temea, vehaomeret eni shota, veshebbalah eno rotze lehashekotah, veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech. ketzad ose lah, molichah levet din shebbeoto makom, umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech. rabbi yehuda omer, balah neeman aleha: 
Hayu maalin otah levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, umeayyemin aleha chederech shemmeayyemin al ede nefashot. veomrim lah, bitti, harebe yayin ose, harebe sechok ose, harebe yaldut osa, harebe shechenim haraim osim. asi lishmo haggadol shennichtav bikdushsha, shello yimmache al hammayim. veomrim lefaneha devarim sheenah keday leshoman, hi vechol mishpachat bet aviha:
Mishnah Sotah 1:5-8:
Im amra temea ani, shoveret ketubbatah veyotzet. veim amra tehora ani, maalin otah leshaar hammizrach sheal petach shaar nikkanor, sheshsham mashkin et hassotot, umetaharin et hayyoldot, umetaharin et hammetzoraim. vechohen ochez bivgadeha, im nikreu nikrau, im nifremu niframu, ad shehu megalle et libbah, vesoter et searah. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya libbah nae, lo haya megallehu. veim haya searah nae, lo haya sotro: 
Hayta mitkassa vilvanim, mechassah bishchorim. hayu aleha chele zahav vekatlayot, nezamim vetabbaot, maavirim mimmenna kede lenavvelah. veachar kach mevi chevel mitzri vekoshro lemala middaddeha. vechol harotze lirot ba lirot, chutz meavadeha veshifchoteha, mippene shellibbah gas bahen. vechol hannashim muttarot lirotah, shenneemar (yechezkel 23) venivvasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena: 
Bamidda sheadam moded, bah moddin lo. hi kishsheta et atzmah laavera, hammakom nivvelah. hi gilleta et atzmah laavera, hammakom gilla aleha. bayyarech hitchila vaavera techilla veachar kach habbeten, lefichach tilke hayyarech techilla veachar kach habbeten. ushear kol hagguf lo falet: 
Shimshon halach achar enav, lefichach nikkeru felishtim et enav, shenneemar (Shoftim 16) vayyochazuhu felishtim vaynakkeru et enav. avshalom nitgaa visaro, lefichach nitla visaro. ulefi shebba al eser pilagshe aviv, lefichach nittenu vo eser lonviyyot, shenneemar (Shmuel b 18) vayyasobbu asara anashim nose kele yoav. ulefi shegganav shelosha levavot, lev aviv, velev bet din, velev yisrael, shenneemar (sham 15) vaygannev avshalom et lev anshe yisrael, lefichach nitkeu vo shelosha shevatim, shenneemar (sham 18) vayyikkach shelosha shevatim bechappo vayyitkaem belev avshalom:
Mishnah Tamid 1:1-3:
Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash. bevet avtinas, bevet hannitzotz uvevet hammoked. bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz hayu aliyyot, veharovim shomrim sham. bet hammoked, kippa, uvayit gadol haya, mukkaf rovadim shel even, vezikne vet av yeshenim sham, umaftechot haazara beyadam. ufirche chehunna ish kisto vaaretz. lo hayu yeshenim bevigde kodesh, ella foshtin umekappelin umannichim otan tachat rashehen, umitkassin bichsut atzman. era keri leachad mehen, yotze veholech lo bammesibba haholechet tachat habbira, vehannerot dolkin mikkan umikkan, ad shehu maggia levet hattevila. umedura hayta sham, uvet kisse shel kavod. veze haya chevodo, metzao naul, yodea sheyyesh sham adam. patuach, yodea sheen sham adam. yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg venitchammem keneged hammedura. ba veyashav lo etzel echav hakkohanim ad shehashshearim niftachim, yotze veholech lo: 
Mi shehu rotze litrom et hammizbeach, mashkim vetovel ad shello yavo hamemunne. vechi veezo shaa hamemunne va. lo chol haittim shavot, peamim shehu va mikriat haggever, o samuch lo millefanav o milleacharav. hamemunne va vedofek alehem, vehem patchu lo. amar lahen, mi shettaval yavo veyafis. hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha: 
Natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas mibbet hammoked laazara, venichnesu acharav ushete avukot shel ur beyadam. venechleku lishte chittot, ellu holchim baachsadra derech hammizrach, veellu holchim baachsadra derech hammaarav. hayu vodkin veholchin ad shemmaggiin limkom bet ose chavittim. higgiu ellu vaellu, amru shalom, hakkol shalom. heemidu ose chavittim laasot chavittim:
Mishnah Tamid 1:4-2:3:
Mi shezzacha litrom et hammizbeach, hu yitrom et hammizbeach, vehem omrim lo, hizzaher shemma tigga bakkeli, ad shettekaddesh yadecha veraglecha min hakkiyyor, vahare hammachta netuna vammiktzoa ben hakkevesh lammizbeach, bemaaravo shel kavesh. en adam nichnas immo, velo ner beyado, ella mehallech leor hammaaracha. lo hayu roin oto velo shomin et kolo, ad sheshshomin kol haetz sheasa ven katin mucheni lakkiyyor, vehen omrim higgia et. kiddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor, natal machtat hakkesef veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna et haggechalim helach vehelach, chata min hameukkalot happenimiyyot, veyarad. higgia laritzfa, hafach panav latztzafon, halach lemizracho shel kevesh keeser ammot. tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe haritzfa rachok min hakkevesh shelosha tefachim, mekom shennotnin murot haof vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora: 
Rauhu echav sheyyarad, vehem ratzu uvau. miharu vekiddeshu yedehen veraglehen min hakkiyyor, natlu et hammagrefot veet hatztzinnorot vealu lerosh hammizbeach. haevarin vehappedarin shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, sonkin otam litzdade hammizbeach. im en hatztzedadin machazikin, sodrin otam bassovev al hakkavesh: 
Hechellu maalin baefer al gabbe hattappuach. vetappuach haya veemtza hammizbeach, peamim alav kishlosh meot kor. uvargalim lo hayu medashshenin oto, mippene shehu noy lammizbeach. miyyamav lo nitatztzel hakkohen millehotzi et haddashen: 
Hechellu maalin begizrin lesadder esh hammaaracha. vechi chol haetzim kesherim lammaaracha. hen, kol haetzim kesherin lammaaracha, chutz mishshel zayit veshel gefen. aval beellu regilin, bemurbiyyot shel teena veshel egoz veshel etz shamen:
Mishnah Tamid 2:4-3:3:
Sidder hammaaracha gedola mizracha, vachazitah mizracha, verashe haggizrin happenimiyyim hayu nogim battappuach. verevach haya ven haggizrin, shehayu matztzitin et haalita mishsham: 
Berru mishsham atze teena yafin, lesadder hammaaracha sheniyya lakketoret, mikkeneged keren maaravit deromit, mashuch min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot, beomed chamesh seim gechalim, uveshabbat beomed shemonat sein gechalim, sheshsham hayu notnin shene veziche levona shel lechem happanim. haevarim vehappedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, machazirin otan lammaaracha. hitztzitu shete hammaarachot baesh, veyardu uvau lahem lelishkat haggazit: 
Amar lahem hamemunne, bou vehafisu, mi shochet, mi zorek, mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, mi medashshen et hammenora, mi maale evarim lakkevesh, harosh veharegel, ushete hayyadayim, haoketz veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete defanot, hakkeravayim, vehassolet, vehachavittim, vehayyayin. hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha: 
Amar lahem hamemunne, tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. im higgia, haroe omer, barkay. matya ven shemuel omer, heir pene chol hammizrach. ad shehu vechevron, vehu omer, hen: 
Amar lahem, tzeu vehaviu tale millishkat hattelaim. vahare lishkat hattelaim hayta vemiktzoa tzefonit maaravit. vearba leshachot hayu sham, achat lishkat hattelaim, veachat lishkat hachotamot, veachat lishkat bet hammoked, veachat lishka shehayu osin bah lechem happanim:
Mishnah Tamid 3:4-7:
Nichnesu lelishkat hakkelim, vehotziu mishsham tishim ushelosha chele chesef uchele zahav. hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav. af al pi shehu mevukkar mibbaerev, mevakkerin oto leor haavukot: 
Mi shezzacha vattamid, moshcho veholech levet hammitbachayim, umi shezzachu vaevarim holchin acharav. bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach, vealav shemona ammudim nannasin, ureviit shel erez al gabbehen, veunkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuin bahen, ushelosha sedarim haya lechol echad veechad, shebbahen tolin. umafshitin al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim: 
Mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora hayu makdimin, vearbaa chelim beyadam, hatteni vehakkuz ushene maftechot. hatteni dome letarkav gadol shel zahav, machazik kabbayin vachetzi. vehakkuz dome lekiton gadol shel zahav. ushene maftechot, echad yored leammat hashshechi veechad poteach kevan: 
Ba lo lappishpash hatztzefoni. ushene fishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, echad batztzafon veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom lo nichnas bo adam meolam, vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel (yechezkel 44), vayyomer elay Adonai, hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish lo yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur. natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, nichnas latta, umin hatta el hahechol, ad shehu maggia lashshaar haggadol. higgia lashshaar haggadol, heevir et hanneger veet happotchot ufetacho. lo haya shochet hashshochet, ad sheshshomea kol shaar haggadol shenniftach:
Mishnah Tamid 3:8-4:2:
Miricho hayu shomin kol shaar haggadol shenniftach. miricho hayu shomin kol hammagrefa. miricho hayu shomin kol haetz sheasa ven katin mucheni lakkiyyor. miricho hayu shomin kol gevini karoz. miricho hayu shomin kol hechalil. miricho hayu shomin kol hatztzeltzal. miricho hayu shomin kol hashshir. miricho hayu shomim kol hashshofar. veyesh omrim, af kol shel kohen gadol beshaa shehu mazkir et hashshem beyom hakkippurim. miricho hayu merichim reach pittum hakketoret. amar rabbi eliezer ben diglay, izzim hayu levet abba behar michvar, vehayu mitatteshot mereach pittum hakketoret: 
Mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi, nichnas venatal hatteni vehinnicho lefanav, vehaya chofen venoten letocho, uvaacharona kibbed et hashshear letocho vehinnicho veyatza. mi shezzacha vedishshun hammenora, nichnas umatza shene nerot mizrachiyyim dolkim, medashshen et hashshear umanniach et ellu dolkin bimkoman. metzaan shekkavu, medashshenan umadlikan min haddolkim, veachar kach medashshen et hashshear. veeven hayta lifne hammenora uvah shalosh maalot, shealeha hakkohen omed umetiv et hannerot. vehinniach et hakkuz al maala sheniyya veyatza: 
Lo hayu choftin et hattale, ella meakkedin oto. mi shezzachu vaevarim, ochazim bo. vechach hayta akedato, rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav. hashshochet, omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit, al tabbaat sheniyya. shel ben haarbayim haya nishchat al keren mizrachit tzefonit, al tabbaat sheniyya. shachat hashshochet, vekibbel hamekabbel. ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit, venoten mizracha tzafona. maaravit deromit, venoten maarava daroma. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod deromit: 
Lo haya shover bo et haregel, ella nokvo mittoch arkubbo vetole vo. haya mafshit veyored ad shehu maggia lechaze. higgia lechaze, chatach et harosh unetano lemi shezzacha vo. chatach et hakkeraayim unetanan lemi shezzacha vahen. merak et hahefshet, kara et hallev vehotzi et damo. chatach et hayyadayim unetanan lemi shezzacha vahen. ala laregel hayemanit, chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, ushete vetzim immah. kerao, venimtza chullo galuy lefanav. natal et happeder unetano al bet shechitat harosh milmalan. natal et hakkeravayim unetanan lemi shezzacha vahem lahadichan. vehakkeres medichin otah bevet medichin kol tzarkah. vehakkeravayim medichin otan shelosha feamim bemiutah, al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:
Mishnah Tamid 4:3-5:4:
Natal et hassakkin vehifrish et harea min hakkaved, veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved, velo haya mezizah mimmekomah. nakav et hechaze unetano lemi shezzacha vo. ala laddofen hayemanit, haya chotech veyored ad hashshidra, velo haya nogea bashshidra, ad shehu maggia lishte tzelaot rakkot. chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, vehakkaved teluya vah. ba lo laggera, vehinniach bah shete tzelaot mikkan ushete tzelaot mikkan. chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, vehakkane vehallev veharea teluyim bah. ba lo laddofen hassemalit, vehinniach bah shete tzelaot rakkot milmalan ushete tzelaot rakkot millemattan. vechach haya manniach bachavertah. nimtza manniach bishtehen, shetayim shetayim milmalan ushetayim shetayim millemattan. chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, vehashshidra immah, vehattechol taluy bah. vehi hayta gedola, ella shel yamin korin gedola, shehakkaved teluya vah. ba lo laoketz, chotcho unetano lemi shezzacha vo, vehaalya veetzba hakkaved ushete chelayot immo. natal regel hassemali unetanah lemi shezzacha vah. nimtzeu chullan omdin beshura vehaevarim beyadam. harishon, barosh uvaregel. harosh bimino, vechotmo chelappe zeroo, vekarnav ben etzbeotav, uvet shechitato milmalan, vehappeder natun aleha. veharegel shel yamin bismolo, uvet oro lachutz. hashsheni, bishte yadayim, shel yamin bimino, shel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. hashshelishi, baoketz uvaregel. haoketz bimino, vehaalya meduldelet ben etzbeotav, veetzba hakkaved ushete hakkelayot immo. haregel shel semol bismolo, uvet oro lachutz. harvii, bechaze uvaggera. hechaze vimino, vehaggera vismolo, vetzaloteha ven etzbeotav. hachamishi, bishte defanot. shel yamin bimino, veshel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. hashshishshi, bakkeravayim hannetunim bevazach ucheraayim al gabbehem milmala. hashshevii, bassolet. hashshemini, bachavittin. hatteshii, bayyayin. halchu unetanum mechatzi hakkevesh ulematta bemaaravo, umelachum. veyardu uvau lahem lelishkat haggazit, likrot et shema: 
Amar lahem hamemunne, barchu veracha echat, vehen berchu. karu aseret haddevarim, shema, vehaya im shamoa, vayyomer. berchu et haam shalosh berachot, emet veyatztziv, vaavoda, uvirkat kohanim. uveshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze: 
Amar lahem, chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu. hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha. chadashim im yeshanim bou vehafisu, mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, hammaale evarim lakkevesh hu maale otan al gabbe hammizbeach: 
Mesarum lachazzanim, hayu mafshitin otam et bigdehem, velo hayu mannichin alehem ella michnasayim bilvad. vechallonot hayu sham, vechatuv alehem tashmishe hakkelim: 
Mi shezzacha vakketoret, haya notel et hakkaf. vehakkaf dome letarkav gadol shel zahav, machazik sheloshet kabbim, vehabbazach haya vetocho, male vegadush ketoret. vechissuy haya lo, uchemin metutelet haya alav milmalan:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:11-12: Happoresh middarche tzibbur af al pi shello avar averot ella nivdal meadat yisrael veeno ose mitzvot bichlalan velo nichnas betzaratan velo mitanne betaanitan ella holech bedarko keechad miggoye haaretz ucheillu eno mehen en lo chelek laolam habba. haose averot beyad rama kihoyakim ben sheasa kallot ben sheasa chamurot en lo chelek laolam habba. vezehu hannikra megalle panim battora mippene sheheez mitzcho vegilla panav velo bosh middivre tora:
Shenayim hem hammosrin. hammoser chavero beyad akkum lehargo o lehakkoto. vehammoser mamon chavero beyad akkum o beyad annas shehu keakkum. ushenehem en lahem chelek laolam habba:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:4-5: Af al pi shettekiat shofar berosh hashshana gezerat hakkatuv remez yesh bo kelomar oro yeshenim mishshenatchem venirdamim hakitzu mittardematchem vechappesu bemaasechem vechizru bitshuva vezichru boraachem. ellu hashshochchim et haemet behavele hazzeman veshogim kol shenatam behevel varik asher lo yoil velo yatztzil, habbitu lenafshotechem vehetivu darchechem umaallechem veyaazov kol echad mikkem darko haraa umachashavto asher lo tova. lefichach tzarich kol adam sheyyire atzmo kol hashshana kullah keillu chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav. vechen kol haolam chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav. chata chet echad hare hichria et atzmo veet kol haolam kullo lechaf chova vegaram lo hashechata. asa mitzva achat hare hichria et atzmo veet kol haolam kullo lechaf zechut vegaram lo velahem teshua vehatztzala shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 10 25)</small> "vetzaddik yesod olam" ze shetztzadak hichria et kol haolam lizchut vehitztzilo. umippene inyan ze nahagu kol bet yisrael leharebot bitzdaka uvemaasim tovim velaasok bemitzvot merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim yeter mikkol hashshana. venahagu kullam lakum ballayla baasara yamim ellu ulehitpallel bevatte kenesiyyot bedivre tachanunim uvechibbushin ad sheyyeor hayyom:

Beshaa sheshshoklin avonot adam im zechuyyotav en mechashshevin alav avon shechata bo techilla velo sheni ella mishshelishi veelach. im nimtzeu avonotav mishshelishi veelach merubbin al zechuyyotav otam shete avonot mitztarfim vedanin oto al hakkol. veim nimtzeu zechuyyotav keneged avonotav asher meavon shelishi veelach maavirim kol avonotav rishon rishon. lefi shehashshelishi nechshav rishon shekkevar nimchalu hashshenayim. vechen harvii hare hu rishon shekkevar nimchal hashshelishi vechen ad sofan. bamme devarim amurim beyachid shenneemar <small>(iyyov log 29)</small> "hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver". aval hatztzibbur tolin lahen avon rishon sheni ushelishi shenneemar <small>(Amos b 6)</small> "al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu". ucheshemmechashshevin lahen al derech ze mechashshevin lahen mervii veelach. habbenonim im haya bichlal mechetza avonot shellahen shello heniach tefillin meolam danin oto kefi cheto veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. vechen kol harshaim sheavonotehen merubbim danin otan kefi chataehem veyesh lahen chelek laolam habba shekkol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba af al pi shechatu shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 60 21)</small> "veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz". eretz zo mashal kelomar eretz hachayyim vehu haolam habba. vechen chaside ummot haolam yesh lahem chelek laolam habba:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:5-6: Beshaa sheshshoklin avonot adam im zechuyyotav en mechashshevin alav avon shechata bo techilla velo sheni ella mishshelishi veelach. im nimtzeu avonotav mishshelishi veelach merubbin al zechuyyotav otam shete avonot mitztarfim vedanin oto al hakkol. veim nimtzeu zechuyyotav keneged avonotav asher meavon shelishi veelach maavirim kol avonotav rishon rishon. lefi shehashshelishi nechshav rishon shekkevar nimchalu hashshenayim. vechen harvii hare hu rishon shekkevar nimchal hashshelishi vechen ad sofan. bamme devarim amurim beyachid shenneemar <small>(iyyov log 29)</small> "hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver". aval hatztzibbur tolin lahen avon rishon sheni ushelishi shenneemar <small>(Amos b 6)</small> "al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu". ucheshemmechashshevin lahen al derech ze mechashshevin lahen mervii veelach. habbenonim im haya bichlal mechetza avonot shellahen shello heniach tefillin meolam danin oto kefi cheto veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. vechen kol harshaim sheavonotehen merubbim danin otan kefi chataehem veyesh lahen chelek laolam habba shekkol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba af al pi shechatu shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 60 21)</small> "veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz". eretz zo mashal kelomar eretz hachayyim vehu haolam habba. vechen chaside ummot haolam yesh lahem chelek laolam habba:

Veellu hen sheen lahen chelek laolam habba ella nichratim veovdin veniddonin al godel risham vechattatam leolam uleolme olamim. hamminim. vehaeppikorosin. vehakkofrim battora. vehakkofrim bitchiyyat hammetim uveviat haggoel. hammordim. umachatie harabbim. vehapporshin middarche tzibbur. vehaose averot beyad rama befarhesya kihoyakim. vehammosrim. umattile ema al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim. veshofche damim. uvaale lashon hara. vehammoshech arlato:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:7-8: Chamishsha hen hannikraim minim. haomer sheen sham eloah veen laolam manhig. vehaomer sheyyesh sham manhig aval hen shenayim o yoter. vehaomer sheyyesh sham ribbon echad aval shehu guf uvaal temuna. vechen haomer sheeno levaddo harishon vetzur lakkol. vechen haoved kochav o mazzal vezulato kede lihyot melitz beno uven ribbon haolamim. kol echad mechamishsha ellu hu min:

Shelosha hen hannikraim eppikorsin. haomer sheen sham nevua kelal veen sham madda shemmaggia mehabbore lelev bene haadam. vehammachchish nevuato shel moshe rabbenu. vehaomer sheen habbore yodea maase bene haadam. kol echad mishshelosha ellu hen eppikorosim. shelosha hen hakkofrim battora. haomer sheen hattora meim Adonai afillu pasuk echad afillu teva achat im amar moshe amaro mippi atzmo hare ze kofer battora. vechen hakkofer beferushah vehu tora shebbeal pe vehammachchish maggideha kegon tzadok uvaytos. vehaomer shehabbore hechelif mitzva zo bemitzva acheret uchevar batla tora zo af al pi shehi hayta meim Adonai kegon hahagrim. kol echad mishshelosha ellu kofer battora:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:9-10: Shenayim hem hammumarim miyyisrael. hammumar laavera achat vehammumar lechol hattora kullah. mumar laavera achat ze shehechezik atzmo laasot otah avera bezadon vehurgal venitparsem bah afillu hayta min hakkallot kegon shehuchzak tamid lilbosh shaatnez o lehakkif pea venimtza keillu batla mitzva zo min haolam etzlo hare ze mumar leoto davar vehu sheyyaase lehacheis. mumar lechol hattora kullah kegon hachozrim ledate haovde kochavim beshaa sheggozrin gezera veyidbak bahem veyomar ma betza li lehiddabbek beyisrael shehem shefalim venirdafim tov li sheeddabbek beellu sheyyadam takkifa. hare ze mumar lechol hattora kullah:

Machatie harabbim ketzad. echad shehechti bedavar gadol kegon yaravam vetzadok uvaytos. veechad shehechti bedavar kal afillu levattel mitzvat ase. veechad haones acherim ad sheyyechteu kimnashshe shehaya horeg et yisrael ad sheyyaavdu avodat kochavim, o shehita acherim vehiddicham keyeshua:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:11-12:
Muttar lehadelik lechattechilla bishar shemanim kegon shemen tzenon veshumshemin velefet vechol kayyotze bahen. en asur ella ellu shemmanu chachamim bilvad: 
Lo yitten adam keli menukkav male shemen al pi hanner bishvil sheyyehe menattef. velo yemalle keara shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila letochah bishvil shettehe shoevet. gezera shemma yikkach min hashshemen shebbakkeli shehare lo nimas banner. veasur lehanot beshabbat min hashshemen shehudlak bo vaafillu kavta hanner vaafillu nataf min hanner mippene shehu muktze mechamat issur. veim chibber hakkeli sheyyesh bo hashshemen el hanner besid uvecharsit vechayyotze bahen muttar:
Niddah 15b:4-7: Amar rav shemuel mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: ishsha sheyyesh lah veset — balah mechashshev yeme vistah, uva aleha.
Amar leh rav shemuel bar yeva lerabbi abba: amar rabbi yochanan afillu yalda divziza lemitbal?
Amar leh: attu vadday raata mi amar rabbi yochanan?! emar deamar rabbi yochanan safek raata safek lo raata, veim timtza lomar raata — ema tavla,
Aval vadday raata — mi yemar detavla? have leh safek uvadday, veen safek motzi mide vadday.
Proverbs 11:25-30: Monea bar yikkevuhu leom uveracha lerosh mashbir
Shocher tov yevakkesh ratzon vedoresh raa tevoennu
Boteach beoshro hu yippol vecheale tzaddikim yifrachu

Proverbs 11:31-12:3: Hen tzaddik baaretz yeshullam af ki-rasha vechote
Ohev musar ohev daat vesone tochachat baar

Proverbs 12:15-19: Derech evil yashar beenav veshomea leetza chacham

Proverbs 12:9-14: Tov nikle veeved lo mimmitkabbed vachasar-lachem
Yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto verachame reshaim achzari
Oved admato yisba-lachem umeraddef rekim chasar-lev
Chamad rasha metzod raim veshoresh tzaddikim yitten
Befesha sefatayim mokesh ra vayyetze mitztzara tzaddik
Mipperi fi-ish yisba-tov ugemul yede-adam (yashuv) [yashiv] lo
Shabbat 105b:3-9: Gemara ureminhu: hakkorea bachamato uveevlo veal meto — chayyayv, veaf al pi shemmechallel et hashshabbat, yatza yede keria! la kashya: ha bemet dideh, ha bemet dealma.

Veha "meto" katane! leolam bemet dideh, uvehanach delav bene avelut ninhu. vei chacham hu — chayyove michayyayv, detanya: chacham shemmet — hakkol kerovav. hakkol kerovav salka datach?! ella ema: hakkol kikrovav, hakkol korin alav, hakkol choltzin alav, hakkol mavrin alav barchava. la tzericha, delav chacham hu.

Vei adam kasher hu chayyove michayyayv, detanya: mippene ma metim banav uvenotav shel adam keshehen ketannim — kede sheyyivke veyitabbel al adam kasher. kede sheyyivke?! ervona shakli minneh?! ella: mippene shello bacha vehitabbel al adam kasher, shekkol habboche al adam kasher mochalin lo al kol avonotav bishvil kavod sheasa. la tzericha, delav adam kasher hu.

Vei dekae bishat yetziat neshama — chayyove michayyayv, detanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: haomed al hammet bishat yetziat neshama — chayyayv likroa, ha lema ze dome — lesefer tora shennisraf! la tzericha, dela kae bishat yetziat neshama.

Tinach meto, ella chamato achamato kashya! chamato achamato name la kashya, ha — rabbi yehuda, ha — rabbi shimon. ha rabbi yehuda, deamar melacha sheen tzericha legufah — chayyayv aleha. ha rabbi shimon, deamar melacha sheen tzericha legufah — patur aleha.

Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda bimtakken, bimkalkel mi shamat leh? amar rabbi avin: hay name metakkan hu, dekaaved nachat ruach leyitzro. uchehay gavvna mi shere? vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum chilfa bar agra sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan ben nuri: hamekare begadav bachamato, vehameshabber kelav bachamato, vehamefazzer meotav bachamato, yehe beenecha keoved avoda zara. shekkach ummanuto shel yetzer hara: hayyom omer lo ase kach, ulemachar omer lo ase kach, ad sheomer lo avod avoda zara veholech veoved. amar rabbi avin: may keraa — "lo yihye vecha el zar velo tishtachave leel nechar", ezehu el zar sheyyesh begufo shel adam? heve omer, ze yetzer hara.
La tzericha, deka aved lemirma emta ainashe beteh. ki ha derav yehuda shalef metzavyayta, rav acha bar yaakov tavar mane tevire, rav sheshet rame la leamteh monine aresha, rabbi abba tavar nichtema.
Yevamot 105b:4-12: Man chachamim? rabbi yose hi. derabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon bar rabbi havo yatvi. petach chad minnayyhu vaamar: hammitpallel, tzarich sheyyitten enav lematta, shenneemar: "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim".

Vechad amar: enav lemala, shenneemar: "nissa levavenu el kappayim". addehachi ata rabbi yishmael berabbi yose legabbayyhu. amar lehu: bemay askitu? amaru leh: bitfilla. amar lehu: kach amar abba: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyitten enav lematta velibbo lemala, kede sheyyitkayyeymu shene mikraot hallalu.
Addehachi, ata rabbi limtivta. inhu dahavo kallile, yetivu beduchetayyhu. rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, aggav yukereh hava mefassa veazel.
Amar leh abbadan: mi hu ze shemmefassea al rashe am kadosh! amar leh: ani yishmael berabbi yose shebbati lilmod tora merabbi. amar leh: vechi atta hagun lilmod tora merabbi?

Amar leh: vechi moshe haya hagun lilmod tora mippi haggevura? amar leh: vechi moshe atta? amar leh: vechi rabbecha elohim hu? amar rav yosef: shakleh rabbi lematrafseh — dekaamar leh: "rabbecha" vela "rabbi".
Addehachi atya yevama lekammeh derabbi. amar leh rabbi leabbadan: pok bidka. levatar dinfak, amar leh rabbi yishmael, kach amar abba: "ish" katuv bapparasha, aval ishsha — ben gedola ben ketanna.

Amar leh: ta, la tzerichat, kevar hora zaken. kamfassa abbadan veate. amar leh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: mi shetztzarich lo am kadosh, yefassea al rashe am kadosh. mi sheen tzarich lo am kadosh, heach yefassea al rashe am kadosh?

Amar leh rabbi leabbadan: kum beduchetich! tana: beotah shaa nitztara abbadan, vetavu shene vanav, umeanu shete challotav. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: berich rachamana dechassefeh leabbadan behay alma.
Amar rabbi amme: middevarav shel berabbi nilmod: ketanna choletzet bifutut. rava amar: ad shettaggia leonat nedarim. vehilcheta: ad shettavi shete searot.
Zevachim 118b:6-12: Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi: bishlosha mekomot sharta shechina al yisrael – beshilo, venov vegivon, uvet olamim; uvechullan lo sharta ella bechelek binyamin. shenneemar: "chofef alav kol hayyom" – kol chafifot lo yehu ella bechelko shel binyamin.
Ki azel abbaye, amra kammeh derav yosef. amar: chad bera hava leh lechayylil, vela mittekan. vehachtiv: "vayyittosh et mishkan shilo", uchetiv: "vayyimas beohel yosef uveshevet efrayim lo vachar"!
Amar rav adda: may ka kashya leh? dilma shechina bechelek binyamin, vesanhedri gedola bechelek yosef; middematzinu bevet olamim dishchina bechelko shel binyamin, vesanhedrin bechelek yehuda!

Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam – mikarvan nachalot gabbe hadade; hacha – mi mekarvan?! hacha name mekarvan. kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: retzua hayta yotzet mechelko shel yehuda venichneset lechelko shel binyamin, uvah haya mizbeach banuy, vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha levolah.
Hacha name – retzua hayta yotzet mechelko shel yosef, lechelko shel binyamin. vehayeynu dichtiv: "taanat shilo".
Ketannae: "chofef alav" – ze mikdash rishon, "kol hayyom" – ze mikdash sheni, "uven ketefav shachen" – ellu yemot hammashiach.
Rabbi omer: "chofef alav" – ze haolam hazze, "kol hayyom" – ellu yemot hammashiach, "uven ketefav shachen" – ze haolam habba.
Zohar, Shemot 17: (Shemot 2:1) vayyelech ish mibbet levi. ribbi yose patach (Shir hashshirim 6:2) dodi yarad leganno laarugot habbosem vegomer. leganno: da keneset yisrael, begin dehi arugat habbosem, deihi kelila mikkol sitrin (nusach acher zine) busemin verechin dealma deate. beshaata dekudesha berich hu nachit leginta da (nusach acher deeden) kol innun nishmathon detzaddikayya, mitatteran tamman, kullehu yahave recha, kema deat amer vereach shemanayicha mikkol besamim, (nusach acher vereach appecha kattappuchim) illen innun nishmathon detzaddikayya, deamar ribbi yitzchak, kol innun nishmatin detzaddikayya, dehavu behay alma, vechol innun nishmatin, dizminin lenachta lehay alma, kullehu beginta (da kayymin

Beginta) di beara, (kullehu) kayymin bediyyukena vetziyyura dehavu kayymin behay alma, vesitra veraza da itmesar lechakkime. rucha denachit livne nasha, (tazria 45 amud bet) deihu missitra denukeba, mitgallefa tadir begillufa kehay chotam. tziyyura degufa devar nash behay alma, (73 amud bet) balit levar, verucha itgelif lego. kad itpashat rucha min gufa, hahu ruach balit beginta deara, betziyyura udeyukena degufeh mammash dibbehay alma, begin dehava tadir kachotam.

Veal da amra ihi, (Shir hashshirim 8:6) simeni kachotam, ma chotam galif begillufa lego, veittzayyayr betziyyura belita levar. uf hachi ihi rucha, dehava missitra dilah, kehay gavvna mammash behay alma, galif begillufa lego, vechad itpashat min gufa, veal beginta deara, avira detamman balit hahu gillufa leittzayyeyra levar, veittzayyayr betziyyura belita levar, kegavvna detziyyura degufa behay alma (leella).
Nishmeta, deihi meilana dechayay, ittzayyayr tamman leella, behahu tzerora dechayye, leitanga benoam Adonai, kema deat amer (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo.

Vayyelecha ish mibbet levi, (Shemot 19 amud alef, Bereshit 174 amud alef, tazria 44) da gavriel, kema deat amer (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon vegomer. mibbet levi: da cheneset yisrael, deatya missitra dismala. vayyikkach et bat levi da nishmeta.

Detaninan, beshaata deityeylid gufa detzaddik, behay alma, kudesha berich hu kare leh legavriel, venatil hahi nishmeta (detzaddik) di beginta, venachta lah lehay gufa detzaddikayya, deityeylid behay alma, veihu itpekad ala venatir lah.
Vei tema, hahu malacha deitmana al ruchehon detzaddikayya, layla shemeh, veat amart deihu gavriel. hachi hu vadday, begin deate missitra dismala, vechol man deate missitra dismala hachi ikre.
Vayyelecha ish: da amram. vayyikkach et bat levi: da yocheved. uvat kol nachtat veamrat leh leizdavvevga bah, deha kariv zimna defurekana deyisrael, al yeda dibbera deityelid minnayyhu.

Vekudesha berich hu siyyea beh, detanenan, shechinta sharya al arsayyhu ureuta dilhon bidvekuta chada, hava bah bishchinta, veal da, la itade shechinta, mehahu bera deolidu lekayyeyma, dichtiv, (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. bar nash dimkaddesh garmeh millera, kudesha berich hu mekaddesh leh leella, kema diruta dillehon hava bidvekuta dishchinta. hachi itdabbeka shechinta, behahu ovada mammash deavdu.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, zakkain innun tzaddikayya diruta dillehon bidvekuta dekudesha berich hu tadir, vechma deinnun mitdabbekin beh tadir, hachi name ihu itdabbak behu, vela shavik lon lealmin. vavy lerashiayyay, diruta dillehon, udevekuta dillehon, mitrachaka minneh. vela day lehu demitrachakan minneh, ella demitdabbekan besitra achara. ta chaze, amram deitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu. nafak minneh moshe, dekudesha berich hu la ade minneh lealmin, ushechinta itdabbekat bahadeh (Bereshit 21 amud bet) tadir, zakkaa chulakeh.
(Shemot 2:2) vattahar haisha vatteled ben vattere oto ki tov hu. may ki tov hu. amar ribbi chiyyay, deityeylid mahul. begin, deraza divrit, tov ikre, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov.

Ribbi yose amar, nehiru dishchinta denahir beh chamat, divshaata deityelid itmalya kol beta nehora, dichtiv vatter oto ki tov hu, uchetiv (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. veal da ki tov hu ketiv, vecholla hava.
Zohar, Shemot 5: Telata innun dedachyayn shechinta mealma, vegarmin, dediureh dekudesha berich hu la have bealma, uveni nasha tzavvchin vela ishtema kallehon. veillen innun: man deshachiv bannidda, begin delet misavu takkif bealma bar misseavu denidda. misavu denidda kashya mikkol misavu dealma, isteav ihu, vechol demitkarvin bahadeh yistaavun immeh, bechol atar deazlin itdachyay shechinta min kamayyhu.

Velo od, ella degarim marin bishin al garmeh, veal hahu zara deyolid, dechevan deyikrav bar nash legabbe nidda, hahu misavu dalig aloy, veyishtaar bechol shayyfin dileh, zara deyolid behahu shaata, (sefer acher misavu) mashchin aloy ruach misavu. vechol yomoy yehe bimsaavu, deha binyana visoda dileh ihu bimsaavu rav vetakkif mikkol mesaava dealma, demiyyad dekariv bar nash legabbe nidda, hahu misavu dalig aloy, dichtiv, (Vayikra 15:24) utehi niddatah alav.

Man deshachiv bevat el nechar, deail berit kodesh veat kayyayma birshu achara, dichtiv, (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar. vetanenan, let kina kame kudesha berich hu, bar kina divrit kaddisha, deihu kayyayma dishma kaddisha, veraza dimhemanuta. ma ketiv (Bamidbar 25:1) vayyachel haam liznot el benot moav miyyad vayyichar af Adonai beyisrael.

Reshshe amma deyadu velo michu bidayyhu, itanshu bekadmita, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 25:4) kach et kol rashe haam vehoka otam laAdonai neged hashshamesh. ribbi abba amar, may neged hashshamesh. neged habberit deikre shemesh, vaaleh ittemar (tehillim 84) ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim. shemesh umagen (224 2): da berit kaddisha. ma shemesh zarach veanhir al alma, uf hachi berit kaddisha zarach veanhir gufa debar nash. magen: ma magen ihu leaggana aleh debar nash, uf hachi berit kaddisha magen aleh debar nash, uman denatir leh, let nizka bealma, deyachil lemikrav bahadeh veda hu neged hashshamesh.

Reshe amma, yittafsun bechol dara vedara bechova da, i yadin vela mekanin leh. begin dechova da alayyhu, lekanaa leh lekudesha berich hu behay berit, man deail kedusha da birshuta achara, aleh ketiv (Shemot 20:Adonai) lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay. lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna vecholla kina chada. veal da itdachyay shechinta mikameh. man dimshakker bivrit kaddisha dechatim bivsareh debar nash, keillu meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, man dimshakker chotama demalka, meshakker beh bemalka, let leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael, i la bechela detiuveta tadir. (sefer acher yattir)

Rabbi yose patach veamar, (Shmuel 1 12:9) vayyishkechu et Adonai elohehem vegomer, vayaazvu et Adonai. may vayyishkechu vayaazvu. dedachu minnayyhu berit kayayma kaddisha, havo gazrin vela parin, ad deatat devora unedivat behay lechol yisrael kemma dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:2) bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barachu Adonai.
Man dekatil benoy, hahu obbara demitabbera itteteh, vegarim lekatala leh bimaha, desatir binyayna dekudesha berich hu veumanuta dileh. it man dekatil bar nash. vehay kattil benoy.

Telata bishin avid dechol alma la yachil lemisbal, veal da alma mitmogga zeer zeer, velo yedia, vekudesha berich hu istalik mealma, vecharba vechafna umotana atyayn al alma. veillen innun: katil benoy, satir binyayna demalka. dache shechinta, deazla umeshatteta bealma, vela ashkachat nayycha. veal (da) illen, rucha (sefer acher ruchin) dekudesha (avid) bachya. vealma itdan bechol hane dinin. vavy lehahu bar nash, vavy leh, tav leh dela yitbere bealma.

Zakkain innun yisrael, deaf al gav dahavu begaluta demitzrayim, istamaru mikkol hane telata, minnidda, umibbat el nichar, umikkettol zara, veishtaddalu befarhesya befirya ureviyya. deaf al gav digzera itgazrat (Shemot 1:22) kol habben hayyillod hayyeora tashlichuhu, la ishtechach benehon man dekatil ubbara bimaha deitteta, kol shekken levatar. uvizchuta da nafku yisrael min galuta.

Minnidda: detane ribbi chiyyay may dichtiv, (Shemot 38:8) vayyaash et hakkiyyor nechoshet veet kanno nechoshot bemarot hatztzovot. mippene ma zachu nashin lehay, begin deistamaru garmayyhu begaluta demitzrayim, dilvatar deitdachyayn havo atyayn mitkashshetan umistakkelan bammara bivalehon, umeorran lon befirya ureviyya.

Mibbat el nechar, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:41) yatzu kol tzivot Adonai vegomer. uchetiv (Tehillim 122:4) shivte yah edut leyisrael. edut leyisrael vadday. veelle shemot beni yisrael. shivte beni yisrael. dabber el bene yisrael.

Vei tema veha ketiv vehu ben ish mitzri. ha vadday chad hava, ufirsemo kera, dichtiv, (Vayikra 24:11) vehu ben ish mitzri vegomer veshem immo shelomit bat divri lematte dan. pirya verivya dichtiv, (Shemot 1:7) uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vegomer. umikkol hane istamaru yisrael. bene yisrael (7 1) alu, bene yisrael nafku, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot beni yisrael vegomer.
Zohar, Shemot 50: (Shemot 3:1) umoshe haya roe et tzon yitro chotno kohen midyan. ribbi shimon patach, (Shir hashshirim 2:16) dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. amar rabbi shimon, oy lahem labberiyyot, sheenam mashgichim veenam yodim, beshaa sheala bemachashava lifni hakkadosh berich hu, livro olamo, kol haolamot alu bemachashava achat, uvemachashava zo nivrau kullam, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita. uvemachashava zo, shehi hachachma, nivra haolam hazze, vehaolam shel mala.

Nata yemino, uvara haolam shel mala. nata semolo, uvara haolam hazze, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:13) af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim. kore ani alehem yaamdu yachdav. vechullam berega achat (uveshaa achat) nivrau, veasa haolam hazze, keneged haolam shel mala. vechol ma sheyyesh lemala, kedugemato lematta. vechol ma sheyyesh lematta, kedugemato bayyam. vehakkol echad. bara baelyonim hammalachim, bara baolam hazze bene adam, bara bayyam livyatan, kema deat amer (782) lechabber et haohel lihyot echad.

Ketiv baadam, (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv, (Tehillim 8:6) vattechasserehu meat meelohim. i beni nasha yakkirin beovadayyhu (nusach acher beovadoy) kol hay, veinnun mitabbedin (mittippa) meafar devera, bemma atyayn leshaava mineh. uvachar baelyonim, uvachar beyisrael, laelyonim la kara banim, lattachtonim kara banim. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. hu kara lahem banim, vehem karu lo av, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu. uchetiv dodi li vaani lo. hu bachar bi, vaani bacharti bo.

Haroe bashshoshannim, hu roe bashshoshannim, af al pi shehakkotzim saviv lahem, veen acher yachol lirot bashshoshannim kemoto. davar acher haroe bashshoshannim, ma shushan ze hu adom, umemav levanim, kach hakadosh baruch hu, manhig olamo, mimiddat haddin lemiddat harachamim. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu.

Ribbi abba hava azil beorcha, vahava immeh ribbi yitzchak. adhavo azle, paga beinun veradim, natal chad ribbi abba bidoy vahava azil. paga behu ribbi yose, amar vadday shechinta hacha, vaana chamena bidoy deribbi abba, lemelaf chachmeta saggia, deha yadana, deribbi abba la natal hay, ella leachazaa chachmeta.

Amar ribbi abba, tiv beri tiv. yatvu. arach ribbi abba behahu varda, amar, vadday en haolam mitkayyem ella al hareach. deha chazena delet nafsha mitkayyeyma ella al recha. veal da, hadas bemotzae shabbat.

Patach veamar dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. mi garam li, sheani ledodi vedodi li, mippene shehu manhig olamo bashshoshannim. ma shoshan yesh bo reach, vehu adom, motzkin oto, vehu mithappech lalavan, uleolam recho lo zaz. kach hakadosh baruch hu, manhig olamo bederech ze, sheilmale ken lo yitkayyem haolam bishvil haadam hachote. vehachote nikra adom, kema deat amar, im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu, makriv karbano laesh shehu adom. zorek haddam, saviv lammizbeach shehu adom. middat haddin adom, motzkin oto, (hareach) veole heashan kullo lavan, veaz haadom nehpach lelavan, nehpach middat haddin lemiddat harachamim.

Veta chaze, kol middat haddin, en tzarich hareach shello, ella mitztzad odem. vehayeynu deamar ribbi yehuda, ma dichtiv, (Melachim 1 18:28) vayyitgoddu kemishpatam vegomer ad shefach dam alehem. ella hayu yodim, shello yassigu mimmiddat haddin kirtzonam, zulati baodem.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, veod, odem velavan nikrav leolam, vehareach ole mishshetehen. ma hashoshan adom velavan, kach reach hakkarban. vehakkarban, meadom velavan. bo uree mereach hakketoret, shehashemanim, mehem adumim, umehem levanim, kegon hallevona, shehu lavan, mar deror adom, vehareach ole meadom velavan. veal ken manhig olamo bashshoshannim, shehu adom velavan. uchetiv (yechezkel 44:15) lehakeriv li chelev vadam.

Keneged ze, adam makriv chelbo vedamo, umitkapper lo, ze adom, veze lavan. ma hashshoshan shehu adom vehu lavan, en motzkin oto lachazor kullo lavan, ella baesh. kach hakkarban en motzkin oto lachazor kullo lavan, ella baesh. achshav, mi sheyyoshev betaanito, umakriv chelbo vedamo, eno nitzmak lachazor kullo lavan, ella baesh. 215, mittoch taanito shel adam, machalishin evarav, vegover alav haesh, uveotah shaa, tzarich lehakeriv chelbo vedamo beoto haesh, vehu hannikra mizbach kappara.

Vehayeynu deribbi elazar, kad hava yativ betaanita, hava metzalle veamar, galuy veyadua lefanycha Adonai elohay vilohe avotay, shehikravti lefanecha chelbi vedami, vehirtachti otam bachamimut chuleshat gufi, yehi ratzon millefanecha, sheyyehe hareach haola mippi beshaa zo, keriach haole mehakkarban baesh hammizbeach, vetirtzeni.

Nimtza, sheadam hu makriv betaanito hachelev vehaddam, vehareach sheole mippiv, hu mizbach kappara, ulefichach tiknu hattefilla bammakom hakkarban, uvilvad sheyyitkaven lema deamaran. amar ribbi yitzchak, mikkan ulehala ketiv, (Bamidbar 31:23) kol davar asher yavo baesh taaviru baesh vetaher. amar ribbi yose, keshehaya bet hammikdash kayyaym, adam makriv karbano beinyan ze, umitkapper lo. achshav, tefillato shel adam mechapper lo bimkom hakkarban, ki hay gavvna.

Davar acher, dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. ma hashoshannim kotzin metzuyin betocham, af hakkadosh baruch hu, manhig olamo betzaddikim ureshaim. ma hashoshannim, ilmale hakkotzim, en hashoshannim mitkayyeymin. kach ilmale harshaim, en hatztzaddikim nikkarim. deamar ribbi yehuda, bemma hatztzaddikim nikkarim, mittoch sheyyesh reshaim, deilmale reshaim en hatztzaddikim nikkarim. davar acher haroe bashshoshannim, hammanhig olamo beshesh shanim, vehashsheviit shabbat laAdonai. davar acher bashshoshannim, beotam sheshshonim battora.
Zohar, Shemot 51: Umoshe haya roe et tzon yitro chotno kohen midyan. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 23:1) mizmor ledavid Adonai roi lo echsar. kelomar, Adonai roi: Adonai haroe shelli. ma haroe manhig et hatztzon, umolicham lemire tov, lemire shamen, bimkom nachale mayim, meyashsher halichatan betzedek uvemishpat. af hakkadosh baruch hu, ketiv binot deshe yarbitzeni al me menuchot yenahaleni nafshi yeshovev.

Amar ribbi yose, derech haroe, linhog betzedek et tzono, leharechikam min haggazel, lehanehigam bemishor, vehashshevet beyado shello yattu yamin usemol. kach hakkadosh baruch hu, hu roe et yisrael lehanehigam bemishor, uvechol et hashshevet beyado shello yattu yamin usemol.

Davar acher umoshe haya roe, amar ribbi yose, teda lecha, shekkol zeman sheharoe chacham lenahel et tzono, hu muchan lekabbel ol malchut shamayim. im haroe shote, alav nikra (Mishlei 26:12) tikova lichsil mimmennu.

Amar ribbi yehuda, moshe chacham haya, uvaki linhog et tzono. bo uree, middavid, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 16:11) vehinne roe batztzon. lelammedcha sheddavid chacham gadol haya, vehaya roe tzono kaddin vechashshura. lefichach, asahu hakadosh baruch hu melech al kol yisrael. velamma tzon velo bakar. amar ribbi yehuda, yisrael nikraim tzon. shenneemar, (yechezkel 34:31) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem. uchetiv, (yechezkel 36:38) ketzon kodashim ketzon yerushalayim.

Ma hatztzon, kesheyyikkarvu al hammizbeach, bishvilam zoche lechayye haolam habba. kach hammanhig leyisrael kaddin vechashshura, bishvilam zoche lechayye haolam habba. veod, haroe et hatztzon, keshehatztzon yoldot, haroe notel otam telaim becheko, kede shello yilleu veyiggau, umolicham achare immotam, umerachem alehem. kach hammanhig leyisrael, tzarich lehanehilam berachamim, velo beachzariyyot. vechen amar moshe, (Bamidbar 11:12) ki tomar elay, saehu vechekecha vegomer.

Ma haroe et hatztzon, keshehu roe tov, matztzil et hatztzon min hazzeevim, umin haarayot. kach hammanhig leyisrael, im hu tov, matztzilan min haavodat kochavim umazzalot, umiddin shel matta, umiddin shel mala, umadrichan lechayye haolam habba. kach moshe, roe neeman haya, veraa hakadosh baruch hu, shekkeday hu lirot et yisrael, beoto haddin mammash, shehaya roe et hatztzon, lakkesavim, kefi harauy lahen. vehannekevot kefi harauy lahen

Ulefichacha ketiv, umoshe haya roe et tzon yitro chotno, velo shello, deamar ribbi yose, vechi ma shennatan et tzifora bitto lemoshe, lo natan lo tzon uvakar, vahalo yitro ashir haya. ella moshe lo haya roe et tzono, kede shello yomru bishvil shehaya tzono immo, haya roe otan betov. velachen ketiv et tzon yitro chotno, velo et shello. kohen midyan, ribbi tanchum amar, af al gav shehaya oved kochavim umazzalot, bishvil sheasa immo chesed, haya roe tzono kaddin vechashshura, bemire tov shamen vedashen.

(Shemot 3:1) vayynhag et hatztzon achar hammidbar. ribbi yose amar, moshe, miyyom shennolad, lo zaza mimmennu ruach hakkodesh. raa beruach hakkodesh, sheoto midbar haya kadosh, umuchan lekabbel ol malchut shamayim alav. ma asa, hinhig et hatztzon achar hammidbar. ribbi yitzchak amar, achar hammidbar al kol panim, velo bammidbar, shello ratza sheyyikkansu betocho, ella hirchikam achar hammidbar.

(Shemot 3:1) vayyavo el har haelohim choreva, hu levaddo belo tzon. 211, hay avna, dimkabbela parzela, kad chame leh, (mechet) medalga ilove. kach moshe vehar sinay, keshniru ze im ze, dilleg alav. hada hu dichtiv, vayyavo el har haelohim choreva.

Amar ribbi abba, muchanim hayu misheshet yeme bereshit, ze im ze. veoto hayyom, nitraggesh hahar lemul moshe. vechevan sheraahu shennichnas letocho, vedilleg bo, amad hahar. melammed, shesmechim hayu ze im ze.

Amar ribbi yannay, (nusach acher rabbi yose) yodea haya moshe, sheoto har, har haelohim hu. dichtiv vayyavo el har haelohim. detnan, ma raa moshe beoto har, raa ofot shehayu porchim, uforsim kanfehem velo hayu nichnasim bo.

Ribbi yitzchak (nusach acher amar Rabbi yitzchak) omer, raa haofot porchim vetasim mishsham, venoflim leraglav shel moshe, miyyad hirgish bainyan, veheemid et hatztzon achar hammidbar, vehu nichnas levaddo.

(Shemot 3:2) vayyera (159 amud bet, 167 amud alef) malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. ribbi tanchum omer, sheet hammincha hayta, shemmiddat haddin sholetet bo. ribbi yochanan amar, veha ketiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. middat chesed kaamar, velo middat haddin. amar ribbi yitzchak, mishsheyyotze haor, ad shennote laredet, nikra yom, vehu middat chesed. mishshennote laredet, nikra erev, vehu middat haddin. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom.

Amar ribbi yochanan, sheat hammincha hu, 46 shaot ulemata. detanya Rabbi yitzchak omer, mahu dichtiv, (Shemot 16:12) ben haarbayim tochlu basar uvabboker tisbeu lachem. ben haarbayim, dehu shaata dedina tochlu basar. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 11:33) habbasar odennu ben shinnehem veaf Adonai chara vaam. mishshum, deven haarbayim, dina demalchuta shalit. uvabboker tisbeu lachem, mishshum deikre chesed hahu shaata, uchetiv, (Tehillim 52:3) chesed el kol hayyom. uchetiv, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom. deihu mitztzafra.

Ribbi tanchum omer, da sumak, veda chivvavr. sumak: ben haarbayim. dichtiv, (Shemot 16:12) ben haarbayim tochlu basar. vechivvra: betzafra. dichtiv, uvabboker tisbeu lachem. ribbi yitzchak amar, ketiv, (Shemot 12:6) veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim vegomer. dehu shaata lemebad dina. ribbi yehuda amar, yalfinan mishshene kevasim shebbechol yom, haechad mitkarev keneged middat hachesed, vehv keneged middat haddin.

Veamar ribbi yehuda, mahu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker, vela ketiv et hakkeves harishon, ella et hakkeves haechad, meyuchad, keneged middat hachesed. divchol makom, sheni, lo neemar bo ki tov.

Ribbi tanchum amar, lefichach, yitzchak tikken tefillat hammincha, shehu keneged middat haddin. amar ribbi yitzchak, mikkan, (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki pana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. ki pana hayyom: ze middat hachesed. ki yinnatu tzille arev: shekkevar gavar middat haddin. avraham tikken tefillat shacharit, keneged middat hachesed.

Tanu rabbanan, behahi shaata deal moshe letura desinay, may tama itgele leh beshalhove eshshata, dehu dina. amar ribbi yaakov (nusach acher keen) kean shaata hava (shaata) garim. Rabbi yose amar, kolla lechad giza ishtarsha. ketiv, vayyavo el har haelohim choreva. uchetiv, (Devarim 9:8) uvechorev hiktzaftem et Adonai. uchetiv, vayyar malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. mittoch shehem atidim lihyot kassene, kehay dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:12) kotzim kesuchim baesh yitztzattu.
Zohar, Shemot 6: Veelle shemot bene yisrael. ribbi elazar veribbi yose havo azle beorcha, ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi elazar leribbi yose, aftach pumach, veyinharun milach amar leh nicha kameh demar, deeshal milla chada dekashya li, (achore daf ze) ha shemana mibbutzina kaddisha, dehava amar, veelle shemot beni yisrael, yisrael sava. kol innun chelin umashreyayn dehavo nachtin legaluta bahade yaakov, dichtiv, et yaakov. mahu dichtiv ish uveto bau. amar leh, vadday hachi hu. ella ha tanenan, kol dimkabbel meachara, ihu beta mehahu deyahiv, veal da ish uveto bau.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Melachim 1 9:1) vayhi kechallot shelomo livnot et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech vegomer. vechi kevan deamar et bet Adonai, mahu veet bet hammelech, i begin shelomo ittemar, lav hachi, ella et bet Adonai da bet hammikdash, veet bet hammelech da kodesh hakkodashim.

Bet Adonai deihu bet hammikdash kegon: azarot uleshachot uvet haulam vehaddevir, da bet hammikdash, vadday ikre bet Adonai. bet hammelech: da kodesh hakkadashim, deihu penimaa decholla, hammelech setam. melech da, af al gav deihu melech illaa, ihu nukeba legabbe nekuda illaa, setima decholla. veaf al gav deihu nukeba, ihu dechura legabbe melech diltatta, uvegin kach kolla kegavvna da veal da, tattae, beraza da ketiv behu, ish uveto bau.

Veelle shemot, ribbi (elazar) yose patach veamar, (Shir hashshirim 4:12) gan naul achoti challa gal naul mayan chatum. gan naul: da keneset yisrael shehi gan naul. deamar ribbi elazar, ma haggan hazze tzarich lishmor, lador, ulehashkot, velizmor. kach keneset yisrael, tzericha lador, velishmor, ulehashkot, velizmor, venikret gan, venikret kerm, ma hakkerem hazze tzarich lador ulehashkot velizmor velachpor, kach yisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:7) ki kerem Adonai tzevaot bet yisrael uchetiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:7) vayazkehu vaysakkelehu vegomer.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.
