Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Hannogsim. mitzriyyim hayu vehashshotrim hayu yisreelim; hannoges memunne al kamma shotrim vehashshoter memunne lirdot beose hammelacha (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vaytzav paro bayyom hahu. perush, davka bayyom hahu tzivva laasot ken, vehattaam kede shebbeemtzaut tokef hatztzara shello yuchelu seet tishshachach mehem hammachshava hahi shel hammora veyifnu laavod avodatam, vehammaskil yavin ki tzara hamezummenet tashkiach mechush tzara haatida veshekkevar avra, veze mehammurgash lammaskil al davar. veshier ki yaspik laze yom echad.

O yechavven hakkatuv lirmoz shello nishar od lahem baavoda ella yom hahu, ki lemachar ba moshe vehikka yeor mitzrayim, venishbera makkel hashshibud, kemaamaram zichronam livracha meet shehitchilu hammakkot nistallek hashshibud mealehem, veadrabba hitchilu lehozil kaspam bead mashke mayim, kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,10). veen lehakeshot meamro "gam temol gam hayyom", ki yom shellefanav lo chillu chukkam letzad shehaya yom besora vehayu mekubbatzim lifne moshe sheasa leenehem haotot.

rashi: Asura na. asura mikkan lehitkarev sham:

Hinni yissad leshon avar hu, kemo (Ester 1:8) "yissad hammelech", vechen tzarich lefotro: hinni hu asher yissad kevar. (betziyyon even kevar) nigzera haggezera lefanay, veheemadti melech mashiach, sheyyehe betziyyon leven bochan, leshon mivtzar vechozek, kemo (Yeshayahu 32:14) "ofel vavachan", uchemo "hekimu vechunav" (Yeshayahu 23:13):
Musad mussad. harishon pattach lefi shehu davuk, musad shel musad, shehu musad gamur:
Hammaamin lo yachish. hammaamin davar ze lo yemaharenna, lo yomar: "im emet hu, yemaher lavo":
targum: Bechen kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana memane vetzion melech melech takif gibbar veemtan atkefine veachsenine amar neviya vetzadikaya dehemanu veilen bemete aka la yizdazeun:

ohc: Lemaan yaaminu vegomer elohe avotam. taam amro "elohe avotam" vegomer paam achar paam. ulay sheramaz ki mehannimna shettihye shelitat haadam bivchinat hannachash kechezyon haot, ella lemi shennigla elav elohe avot haolam, velaze yihye haddavar leot ki nira elav elohe avotam vegomer:

rashi: Vegam elle. yoshve mishpat umeshive milchama shebbaddor hazze, kelomar: tovim vachashuvim shebbahen, bayyayin shagu, ki atta en tov bahem:
Shagu baroe. hiligu bedivre hanneviim, veyonatan tirgem bemaachal maadannim, sherauhu oneg lahem:
Paku peliliyya. hichshilu hammishpat:
Paku. leshon "pik birkayim" (Nachum 2:11), "puka" (Shmuel 1 25:31):
targum: Veaf ilen bechamra revo uveattika istalamu chahana vesappar revo min attik istalamu min chamar teo min attik itpeniu batar mechal besis teo dayanha:

rashi: Mizze veyadecha. lechach nichtav teva achat, lidrosh: mizze shebbeyadcha atta chayyav lilkot, shechashadta vichsherim; ufeshuto: keadam sheomer lachavero mode atta shezzo shellefanecha even hi? omer lo hen; amar lo hareni ose otah etz:
ohc: Vayyomer vegomer ma ze beyadecha. en sheela zo doma lishelat Adonai levilam (Bamidbar 22:9) "mi haanashim" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19) shemmetzao avit shel me raglayim, shehaya lo lomar atta yadata, ki sham mashmaut hashsheela hu shehainyan nelam veshoel alav, umimma shemmeshiv megalle dato ma shehu avit shel me raglayim, ma sheen ken sheela zo lo shaal al hannelam, ki galuy haya ki beyado matte, ella kemi sherotze sheyyode befiv al haddavar. veasa moshe mitzvat rabbo vayyomer matte, veshiur mashmaut hu vayyomer atta mavchin ma sheatta lokeach beyadcha ma hu, veamar lo hen adoni ani makkir bema shebbeyadi shehu matte.

rashi: Et mi yore dea. shemma letinokot sheen yodin lehavin, ki haggedolim panu lederech raa?
Gemule mechalav. bedule mechalav:
Attike mishshadayim. leshon "vayyatek mishsham" (Bereshit 12:8). davar acher: bedulim min hattora shennikret chalav, vattike mishshadayim musarim millifne talmide chachamim:
targum: Leman ityehivat orayta uman itpekad lemisbar chuchema hala levet yisrael dirchimin mikkol ammaya vachavivin mikkol malkevata:

rashi: Mi samcha leish. vehine odcha naar:
Halehorgeni atta omer. mikkan anu lemedim sheharago bashshem hameforash (Shemot Rabba 1):
Vayyira moshe. kifshuto. umidrasho: daag lo al sheraa veyisrael reshaim delatorin, amar, meatta shemma enam reuyin lehiggael (Shemot Rabba 1):

Achen noda haddavar. kemashmao. umidrasho, noda li haddavar shehayiti tameah alav, me chatu yisrael mikkol shivim ummot lihyot nirdim baavodat perech, aval roe ani shehem reuyim lechach (Shemot Rabba 1):
Chamad rasha. lihyot nizzon umitparnes mimmetzod reshaim, shetztzadin et habberiyyot bigzelot vechamas:
Veshoresh tzaddikim yitten. ma shehu rauy litten, vehu happeri:
targum: Raeg rashia metzudeta vishta veikarhon detzadike nitkayem:

rashi: Achar hammidbar. lehitrachek min haggezel, shello yiru bisdot acherim (Shemot Rabba 2):
El har haelohim. al shem heatid:
ohc: Umoshe vegomer vayyinhag vegomer. perush ki Adonai sibbevo laasot ken. o shehu nahag keminhago vehatztzon halchu shamma el har vegomer, ki sham yedabber elav haelohim.

rashi: Ki yadati et machovav. kemo "vayyeda elohim" (Shemot 2), kelomar ki samti lev lehitbonen veladaat et machovav velo heelamti enay leetom aznay mitztzaakatam:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai rao raiti vegomer. tzarich ledakdek lamma kafal lomar shete reiyyot. shenit, lamma hutzrach lefaresh velomar "asher bemitzrayim", veim lo yakkir moshe ammo shel haelohim eno mesuyyam etzlo besiman ze "asher bemitzrayim", halo kamma ummot hayu bemitzrayim. veulay ki lo hayta umma meunna umeruda bemitzrayim keyisrael, ella sheen haddaat mekabbelet ki lo yada moshe ki yisrael hem am Adonai venachalato.

Achen yechavven Adonai lehodia ki raa shete reiyyot. haachat sheadayin lo higgia hakketz, veaf al pi chen raiti et oni ammi, vehooni hu asher bemitzrayim, perush al derech amram sham bemassechet shabbat (10.) shebbishvil shene selaim melat vechulei nitgalgel haddavar veyardu avotenu lemitzrayim. vehikshu hattosafot, vahalo kevar nigzar haggalut beven habbetarim, veamru shehaya yachol lihyot bemakom acher shello hayu mishtabedim bo yisrael bechol kach tzaar veinnuy. vehu amro asher bemitzrayim, perush, velivchina zo shel koved hashshibud ani roe ki hagam shello higgia adayin ketz haggeulla, higgia ketz perat bechinat hooni asher meannim umeshabedim otam.

Od yirtze lomar raa hatztzaar sheyyeshnam bo, veod raiti oni ammi shehem chelek Adonai ammo, vehooni hu asher hem bemitzrayim, ki im yisrael mitakkevim od hem neevadim bar minnan, al derech amram zichronam livracha (haggada shel pesach): veillu lo hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu et avotenu mimmitzrayim adayin vegomer, ki im hayu mitakkevim sham od hayu nichnasim bachamishshim shaare tuma velo hayta tekuma, laze gealam miyyad velo shahu afillu shiur sheyyaspik betzekam lehachemitz. hagam shekkevar batla avoda mehem vehayu sare tzoan, hammakom hu gorem innuy, vehu taam amro (Shemot 13:39) "velo yachlu lehitmahmeah", vehu sheramaz pi chacham baruch hu asher bemitzrayim.

Od yirtze beamro rao raiti shete reiyyot: achat shennishlemu berure nitzotze hakkedushsha veen lahem od hanaa baggalut, ucheamram zichronam livracha (berachot 9,2; fesachim kayit,2) befasuk "vaynatztzelu et mitzrayim" – asauha kimtzuda sheen bah dagan vechimtzula sheen bah dagim, veod raiti sheikkuvam sham taria lahem lehateminam bakkelippa battumea kemo shekkatavti.

Veet tzaakatam shamati. perush, veod ba lefanay tzaakatam mitztzara lahem, ki hosifu lehara ad shetztzaaku tzeaka mikkeev lev, uchemo shepperashti befasuk "vattaal shavatam vegomer min haavoda". veze hakedamat taam lishlichuto kodem hazzeman, shehu lehatztzilo mitztzara meachshav, shello yishtabedu bo beotah shana shehayu hammitzrim mukkim makkot gedolot, ki miyyom shehitchilu hammakkot bemitzrayim nistallek hashshibud miyyisrael, kaasher avaer besamuch befasuk "vaered lehatztzilo". gam lema shepperashti beamro rao raiti shennitkavven al tzarat mitzrayim ki higgia haet lehistallek, af al pi chen tzarich hitorrut mehannitztzolim, laze amar veet tzaakatam shamati:

Veamro mippene nogsav – achar shehizkir shemiat hatztzeaka, velo chen haya lo lomar ella "veet tzaakatam mippene nogsav shamati". od amar "tzaakatam" leshon rabbim venogsav" leshon yachid velo hishva middat hallashon, nitkavven lomar ki bene yisrael tzaak libbam el Adonai bitfilla, veze yatzdik ma shepperashti befasuk "vattaal shavatam" vegomer (Shemot 2:23), veim haya omer "veet tzaakatam mippene nogsav shamati" haya nishma shehatztzeaka hayta mehaavoda, velo chen hu, shetztzaakatam hayta bitfilla lifne Adonai.

Vetaam sheamar tzaakatam bilshon rabbim vnogsav bilshon yachid, leheyot ki en rabbim hatztzoakim shavim betzookam el Adonai, laze kinna otam beshem rabbim, aval beerech hannoges haya noges lechullam yachad beshave, laze amar mippene nogsav leshon yachid. vetaam amro mippene nogsav hu lirmoz ki taam shekkibbel tzaakat libbam el Adonai hu letzad shetztzaaku mitztzara uchemo shepperashti befasuk "min haavoda". od yirtze beamro mippene nogsav kan ramaz ki hammitzriyyim nitmallet seatam lippara mehem asher hereu, hagam sheyyisrael adayin lo nishlam zeman haggeulla, veze taam acher lishlichut moshe kodem zeman haggeulla.

Od yirmoz mippene nogsav al derech amro (yeshaya 65,24) "terem yikrau vaani eene", vechan hodia ki kodem negishatam haadon margish betzaakat banav yedidav, ulederech ze taam amro leshon yachid lomar afillu negishat rishon shebbahem. veamar hattaam ki yadati et machovav lomar hagam sheadayin lo tzaaku ani yodea venoten lev al machovav shel ammi venachalati, gam baze gilla otzem ahavato im yisrael kerachem av rachaman vegomer.
Veladderachim harishonim shepperashti, kavvanat amro ki yadati vegomer, lehagedil rov tzarotam ki lo yuchelu seet, ki rabbu machovehem bannigle uvannistar.

Od yirtze lehodio ki yadati machovav, perush, lo shekkibbelam mehatztzoakim ella hikkir veyada shiur hammachovim, vedavar ze yechayyev letzad middotav lehatztzil, uchemo shepperashti befasuk "vayyar elohim", ki letzad reiyyato betzarat hannivraim yitrabbu rachamav lifnim mishshurat haddin, uchemo chen haddevarim shebbeemtzaut yediat hammachov shel yedidav yitrabbu rachamav, umikkol kibbutz hatteamim amar vaered lehatztzilo.

rashi: Gam mittemol vegomer. lamadnu shekkol 7 yamim haya hakkabba mefatte et moshe bassene lelech bishlichuto, "mittemol", "shilshom", "meaz dabbercha" hare 3 ushelosha gammin ribbuyin hem, hare shishsha, vehu haya omed bayyom hashshevii kesheamar lo zot od shelach na beyad tishlach, ad shechara bo vekibbel alav (Shemot Rabba); vechol ze shello haya rotze littol gedulla al aharon achiv shehaya gadol hemennu venavi haya, shenneemar "haniglo nigleti el bet avicha bihyotam bemitzrayim" (Shmuel 1 2) – hu aharon, vechen "vaivvada lahem beeretz mitzrayim … vaomar alehem ish shikkutze enav hashelichu" (Yechezkel 20), veotah nevua leaharon neemra (tanchuma):
Chevad pe. bichvedut ani medabber. uvilshon laaz 40:
ohc: Vayyomer moshe vegomer bi adonay. achar shennistemu mimmennu hatteanot, chazar levakkesh meAdonai mimmiddat harachamim, velaze diyyek lomar el Adonai shem harachamim, ma shello amar ken mikkodem ella kol imrotav hem el haelohim, vehitchil lehitchannen lefanav veamar bi leshon techinna veritztzuy.

O yirtze beamro bi, perush, taam shello yaaminu hu letzad hachissaron hattaluy bi, kesheyyiruni illeg vaafillu dibbur en ani yodea davar. veamro gam mittemol vegomer, nitkavven lomar elav ki chashav shebbeemtzaut sheyyedabber Adonai immo paamayim veshalosh yusar pegamo vidabber tzachot, vechevan sheraa sheddibber paam achat gam shetayim gam shalosh veodennu lo ish devarim, tzaak libbo el Adonai, shehare mumo kavua, umeatta vadday shello yaaminu lo ki yomru im nira elav Adonai haya mesir pegamo.

rashi: Lekoshesh kash latteven. leesof asifa, lilkot leket, letzorech teven hattit:
Kash. leshon likkut, al shem sheddavar hammitpazzer hu vetzarich lekoshsho karuy kash bishar mekomot:
Lamma ze azavten. hikkir bo shehu mizzaro shel yaakov, shehammayim olim likrato (Shemot Rabba 1):
Veyochal lachem. shemma yissa achat mikkem; kema deat amar: "ki im hallechem asher hu ochel" (Bereshit 39):
ohc: Lamma ze vegomer. keillu amar: lamma azavten et ze haish asher gemalchem tovot. o yirtze shemmakpid al zeman sheazavuhu meaz ad sheyyachzeru likro lo, vetamo ki eno mehammusar sheyyaase immahem ish nachri chesed veyavou veyannichuhu yaamod bachutz. o yirtze shehagam sheyyakpid yitro al hitkarvutam im anashim, amar ki yishtanne ze mikkullam, vehu amro lamma ze vegomer, ki maasav mochichot ki ish chesed hu, uma gam ledivrehem (Shemot Rabba 1,32) sheamru lo shealu hammayim likrato, hare ze meshunne lishvach shevachim.

rashi: Naakatam. tzaakatam, vechen "meir metim yinaku" (Iyov 24):
Et berito et avraham. im avraham:

Ki tzav latzav tzav latzav. navi metzavve lahem meet hakkadosh baruch hu, vehem yesh lahem tzav shel avoda zara keneged tzav ze; vechozer hannavi umochicham, vehem tamid omrim: "yesh lanu tzav letzav shellanu chashuv mishshellecha":
Kav lakav. yesh lahem kav mishkolet mishpete resha keneged kav hatztzedek:
Zeer sham. hannavi omer lahem: od meat tavo alechem raa, vehem omrim: "zeer sham, yemaher yachisha maasehu" (Yeshayahu 5:19) leyamim muatin:
targum: Are itpakadu lemebad orayta uma deitpakadu la tzeviu lemebad veitnabbiu alehon neviyaya deim yetuvun yishtevek lehon ulemile neviyaya la kabbilu halichu baraavat nafshehon vela chamidu lemebad orayti sevaru deyitkayem lehon pulechan taavata vela sevaru lefulechan bet makdeshi kizer hava beenehon bet makdashi lemiflach taman kizer beenehon shechinti taman:

rashi: Habbaim yashresh yaakov. halo yedatem ma asiti barishona? habbaim lemitzrayim asher hishrish yaakov, tzatzu ufarchu sham ad (asher) malu fene tevel tenuva:
targum: Yitkanshun mibbene galvathon vituvun learahon taman yityelidun devet yaakov yifshun veyisgun devet yisrael veyimlun afe tevel bene venin:

rashi: Ki ir betzura badad. ki baasotam zot, ir betzura shel yishmael tihye badad, veahnave yihye meshullach veneezav kammidbar:
Sham yire egel. efrayim yirashennu, shekkaruy 'egel, shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 31:18) "keegel lo lummad":
Vechilla seifeha. anafeha:
targum: Are karta dahavat kericha bilchoda titav tehe metaltela ushevika kemadbera bah yegichun tzadikaya veyivzun yat nichsaha visufun mashiryataha milmippak:

rashi: Velo yachla od hatztzefino. shemmanu lah hammitzriyyim miyyom shehechezirah, vehi yeladattu leshishsha chodashim veyom echad (sham), shehayyoledet leshiva yoledet limkuttain (nidda 38), vehem badku achareha lesof tisha:
Gome. gemi bilshon mishna (shabbat 78), uvelaaz 172, vedavar rach hu veomed bifne rach uvifne kashe (sota 12):
Vachemar uvazzafet. zefet mibbachutz vetit mibbifnim, kede shello yariach oto tzaddik reach ra shel zefet (sham):
Vattasem bassuf. hu leshon agam, 556 belaaz, vedome lo "kane vasuf kamelu" (Yeshayahu 19):
Vayyifen ko vacho. raa me asa lo babbayit ume asa lo vassade (sham). ulefi peshuto kemashmao:
Vayyar ki en ish. atid latzet mimmennu sheyyitgayyer (410):

ohc: Lo telchu rekam. kan ramaz Adonai mishpat eved ivri, dichtiv bo (Devarim 15:13-14): "lo teshallechennu rekam, haanek taanik lo".

rashi: Veet matkonet hallevenim. sechum cheshbon hallevenim shehaya kol echad ose layyom keshehaya hatteven nittan lahem, oto sechum tasimu alehem gam atta, lemaan tichbad haavoda alehem:
Ki nirpim. min haavoda hem, lechach libbam pone el habbattala vetzoakim lemor nelcha vegomer:
Matkonet. vetochen levenim, "velo nitkenu alilot" (Shmuel 1 2), "et hakkesef hametukkan" (Melachim 2 12), kullam leshon cheshbon hem:
Nirpim. hammelacha refuya veyadam vaazuva mehem vehem nirpim mimmenna; 438 belaaz:
ohc: Ki nirpim hem vegomer. tzarich ladaat mi tala tzaakat avoda lelohim letzad shehaavoda refuya alehem. veulay sheyyechavven lomar shello ratzu lalechet lizboach ella letzad sherau shehetiv Adonai immahem shehekel mealehem hashshibud vehem betelim, al ken vegomer perush, al ze hem tzoakim lemor nizbecha vegomer, perush, lehavi karban toda al hattov shehotziam mitztzarat hashshibud, shezzulat ze ma tovat Adonai alehem lehitchayyev lizboach lo. laze amar tichbad haavoda alehem umeatta lo yedabberu od bidvarim ellu shel sheker, ki afillu kefi datam en lahem lizboach ki paska tovat rifyon hatztzara mealehem.

Od yirtze, ki meamram nelcha venizbecha vegomer, ze yaggid ki tamam hu ki ma sheyyevattelu meavodatam yishnu behishshavon, kesheyyachzeru yidchaku atzmam laavod bechol yom chelek yoter meharagil ad tashlum melachtam asher batla. laze amar lo tosfun latet teven vegomer veet matkonet vegomer, vehattaam ki nirpim vegomer al ken hem tzoakim lemor, perush tzeaka sheachareha amira acheret shehi hattashlum haavoda sheyyaasu bachazaratam, im ken tichbad vegomer, vehaven:

Od yirtze beamro veal yishu leshon rifyon. veamar sibbat harifyon hu baddavar hanneemar lahem mimmoshe shebbeene paro hu sheker, vehakkavvana hu al derech ma shepperashti befasuk "vehishbattem" vegomer, ki beemtzaut hammora pen yifgaem yikkanes morech bilvavam velo yihye bahem koach laavoda hakkeveda shealehem, laze "tichbad" vegomer kannizkar.

rashi: Yesh bote. medabber, kemo "levatte visfatayim" (Vayikra 5:4):
Kemadkerot charev. shemmesachsech et habberiyyot vegorem lahem laharog:
Uleshon chachamim. hammevi shalom ben adam lachavero:
Marpe. lammivta hahu:
targum: It deimreh safsera ragsha velishana dechakkime masya:

rashi: Lefi sichlo yehullal ish. im chacham meat o harebe, hakkol lefi sichlo yittol secharo:
Venaave lev. shehenia libbo legamre min hattora, hu yihye lavuz:

Naave. kemo "naaveti mishshemoa" (yeshaya 21:3), vechen "ben naavat hammardut" (Shmuel 1 20:30). veyesh lomar naave – mi shellibbo naua, miggizrat "na vanad" (Bereshit 4:12). kaasher yomar "zaava" (Devarim 28:25) miggizrat "za" (Ester 5:9):
targum: Gavra mishtabbach befuma desucheltanuteh vachasir raayna yeheve lishtuta:

ohc: Vayyomer el ammo hinne vegomer. amro "hinne" vegomer yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 80,12) bappasuk (Bereshit 34:30) "achartem oti" shetztzelula hayta hechavit vechulei, ki masoret hayta beyad vechulei sheatidin lippol beyad yisrael, ad kan. velaze amar melech mitzrayim "hinne am bene yisrael" hayyadua betokef vaoz, hinne hu rav veatzum.

Veamar hava nitchakkema lo pen yirbe vegomer veala min haaretz, veyaase ma shehu masoret beyadam shehu yeabbed kol nefesh lakkenaani achiv, laze yitchakkemu alav leasro leval tzet. velaze nikret mitzrayim bet hakkele, ki hayu hammitzrim shomrim et yisrael bilti tzet mishsham lachashash kallot achiv hakkenaani vechulei.

Od yirtze beamro hinne am vegomer al ze hadderech, ki am ze meshunne mikkol haammim, ki shear haammim yitarvu benehem, veen lecha am sheen bo taarovot gadol mikkamma ammim, asher lo chen am yisrael. vehu amro hinne am kullo bene yisrael veen zar ittam, veamro rav veatzum perush ki beemtzaut heyotam am echad umeyuchad, hagam sheyyihyu meattim beerech shear haummot, yechashvu lerabbim vaatzumim mehem letzad shehem kol echad noten nafsho al achiv, veze yadua leyode erech milchama.

Od yirtze beamro rav veatzum, "rav" – shemmitrabbe shello kederech haolam, vehinne mitteva haolam kaasher yivvaldu rabbim yihyu tashshe koach ben bivchinat hannoladim ben bivchinat hammolid, vetze ulemad mehatteomim kayyadua lattiviyyim, umeatta en mechush leribbuyam ki sofam lehitmaet, vechi yihyu rabbim en bahem koach lachush leribbuyam, laze amar "veatzum", perush, hagam shehem mitrabbim beyoter meharagil af al pi chen "veatzum mimmennu", hagam sheen bahem haribbuy, umin harauy hem hayu reuyim lihyot chazakim yoter mehem, umeatta behechreach lehitchakkem alav. uchefi ze tevat "mimmennu" chozeret el "atzum" velo leamro "rav", ki besamuch hu omer "pen yirbe".

Od yirtze beamro rav veatzum mimmennu, perush sheggedullatam veribbuyam mehem haya. vehakkavvana baze ki ba lehodia otam ki yesh lahem chov beyisrael, venitkavven lehakedim taana leval yomru elav ammo o kol roe maasav nachriyyim, ki beeze koach yaamod veyikkach am echad hashshochen bekirbo veyaavod bo avodat eved. laze amar hinne am bene yisrael ze atzmo uvesaro mishshellanu hu, ki anu hecheyenu oto bishne raav, vechol ma shennitrabba mimmennu hu gam ken, ki beshivim nefesh ba lagur baaretz. umeatta yachzik beyisrael bachazaka sheimmah taana, veyitchakkemu lo laasot lo kattov beenehem.

Od yirtze, ki halo timtza ki kol hammelachim ugedole haammim yitchakkemu lefaer malchutam beam mechubbad, uma gam beam yisrael ki shem umaala meyuchedet lo, veen lecha umma sheshshalta beyisrael shello hayta meulla al kol haummot, besod (Eicha 1:5) "hayu tzareha lerosh". laze amar melech chadash: "hinne bene yisrael" hamechubbadim hem hem haikkar bammalchut yoter mehammitzrim, uvahem hem mitkabbedim, vechi yetzu mehair tihye hair pechuta uvezuya. laze hava nitchakkema lo vegomer, pen yetze mehair beemtzaut sibba ki tikrena milchama veyakutz mehammilchama veyelech lo, veaz en anu yecholin lemano ki yillachem banu behitztarfut milchama hallochemet immanu.

rashi: Lama hareota laam hazze. veim tomar ma ichpat lecha? kovel ani al sheshshelachtani (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vayyashav moshe vegomer lama vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: lama hareota, perush, ki lo amarta li ella sheyyechazzek libbo velo yishlach et haam, aval lo sheyyichbad alehem hara. veim tomar sheadayin lo higgia hakketz lehakel mealehem hashshibud veze hu sibbat hara, im ken lamma ze shelachtani, perush bizman ze, vehaya lecha lehametin ad ketz hashshibud.

Od yirtze al pi ma shekkatavnu lemala, ki gilla Adonai elav shehagam sheadayin lo karav ketz geula, af al pi chen hu makdim lehatztzil otam mehaoni, uchesheyyaggia ketz haggeula leachar shenem asar chodesh yaale otam. vehu amro lama hareota laam hazze, veim tomar mutav sheyyisbelu tzara zo letachlit haggeula, im ken "lamma ze shelachtani", shehare kol ikkar hashshelichut mikkodem zeman haggeula hu letzad hasarat hashshibud, veim en tachlit tov laddavar ella hayyetzia velo hatztzalato mitztzara, im ken lamma ze shelachtani. veramaz beamro ze lishnem asar chodesh shennitakkevu yisrael bemitzrayim mizzeman ze ad haggeula, vechashash moshe ki tzara zo shehichbid paro al yisrael tihye chen ad zeman yetziatam mimmitzrayim.

Od yirtze, leheyot shehayu beyisrael kat hammishtabedim vechat sheenam mishtabedim vehu shevet levi, laze amar keneged kat hammishtabedim lama hareota laam hazze, amar "hazze" lishlol sheenam mishtabedim, ucheneged kat shello garam lahem raa amar lamma ze shelachtani, perush, shello hoalti bishlichuti kelum.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: lama hareota leammecha, uvehechreach lehashiv beemtzaut hashshelichut yatzta haraa, im ken lamma ze shelachtani, veramaz betevat "ze" lomar ki al ze haya memaen millelech beet hashshelichut.

rashi: Veyosef haya vemitzrayim. vahalo hu uvanav hayu bichlal shivim, uma ba lelammedenu? vechi lo hayinu yodim shehu haya bemitzrayim? ella lehodiacha tzidkato shel yosef, hu yosef haroe et tzon aviv, hu yosef shehaya bemitzrayim, venaasa melech, veomed betzidko (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vayhi kol nefesh vegomer veyosef vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar "vayhi" leshon tzaar, veim al haggalut – en ze mekom haddavar. gam tzarich ladaat amro kol. od lamma hutzrach lachzor lehodia minyan yotze yerech yaakov uchevar hishmianu vidanum. od ma hodaa zo kedavar chadash "veyosef haya vemitzrayim".

Veulay sheychavven hakkatuv lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota lo,1) sheatid haya yosef lehaamid shenem asar shevatim, umi sibbev shello heemid ella shenayim, hu pega ra sheppegaatto eshet potifar "vayyafozzu zeroe yadav" (Bereshit 49:24) ad kan. ha lamadta shezzulat ze haya yosef maamid shenem asar shevatim, vehu amro vayhi leshon tzaar, shemmitztaeret hattora al shello hayu ben hakkol ella shivim nefesh, vehu amro kol nefesh vegomer, venatan hattaam laddavar shello hayu ella shivim, veamar veyosef haya vegomer, veden garma shello hayu yotze yerech yaakov ella shivim nefesh, shezzulat ze im lo yarad yosef lemitzrayim haya yosef maamid shenem asar shevatim vehayu bene yaakov shemonim anafim, uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim yachad.

Od yechavven hakkatuv beamro kol nefesh vegomer veyosef vegomer, lomar ki kelalut anafim ellu kullam shavim letova been hevdel benehem, kullam tzaddikim, kullam chachamim, kullam belev shalem ze al ze ucheillu kullam nefesh achat. vehodia chiddush urevuta gedola hi letzad yosef shehaya bemitzrayim, umin hatteva yihye mishtanne mehashevaat haachim, ben letzad haachva, ki lo yittachen sheyyihye shave beratzon kehashevaat kullam letzad ma sheasu lo shemmecharuhu venitachzeru alav, veech lo yihye ketzat shinnuy beno leven kullam, ben letzad hatztzidkut ki haya natun bechur hattuma vehaachim hayu beeretz kenaan umesochachim bailan hu yaakov avihem, veal kol panim yishtanne ketzat. veaf al pi chen modiacha hakkatuv ki shave hu lahem venichnas bemispar hashshivim, uchehashvaat kullam yachad likkare nefesh achat, ben lifrat haahava vehaachva hannechona ben leinyan hatztzidkut vetaharat hannefesh, shello nidbak bo mittachalue hannefesh hagam heyoto bemitzrayim. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Bereshit 46:30) "amuta happaam" vegomer.

rashi: Metzoraat kashshaleg. derech tzaraat lihyot levana – "veim baheret levana hi" (Vayikra 13); af beot ze ramaz lo shellashon hara sipper beamro lo yaaminu li, lefichach hilkahu vetzaraat, kemo shellakta miryam al lashon hara (shabbat 97):
Veamarta el paro. keshettishma shellibbo chazak vimaen lishloach emor lo ken:
Beni vechori. leshon gedulla; kemo: "af ani bechor ettenehu" (tehillim 89), zehu peshuto. umidrasho: kan chatam hakkabba al mechirat habbechora shellakach yaakov meesav (Bereshit Rabba 63):
ohc: Ko amar Adonai beni vechori. tzarich ladaat kavvanat nevua zo shello bizmannah, gam bamme sheshshamar leval yite moshe veyomar nevua zo lefaro befaam rishona beamdo lifne faro.

Venire shennitchakkem el elyon leharim michshol millev moshe, leval yakutz bashshelichut vechas veshalom tivvaled bedato tolada raa biroto otzem hammakkot ufaro lo kam velo za, veyeerach zeman chodesh nichnas chodesh yotze. laze sam davar befiv veyihye lo lemivtach leval yachshov machshevot aven chas veshalom, veamar elav veamarta el paro ko amar Adonai beni vechori, umeatta yihye metzappe moshe ledavar ze, vechol od shello yire makkat bechorot yisod libbo velo yihye mityare kol od shello hevi alav makka zo. veshiur hannevua hu al ze hadderech: "belechtecha lashuv mitzrayma ree" vegomer, vehinni modiacha sheani achazzek et libbo velo yeshallach afillu achar kamma makkot, ulevassof "veamarta elav vegomer hinni horeg" vegomer.

Od nitchakkem baze lehodio lemoshe ki makka zo tihye baacharona, ki bah yeshallach paro et haam, ki lo amar Adonai sheyyechazzek lev paro achar makkat bechorot. vaasher laze kesheamar paro lemoshe (Shemot 10:28) "al tosef reot panay", hikkir ki higgia et mitzva sheamar lo Adonai badderech bevoo mimmidyan lemitzrayim "veamarta beni vechori". vahagam shehosif devarim shello neemru kan, min hassetam neemru veyillamed satum mehameforash. uvaze en lehakeshot ematay neemra lemoshe otah nevua vehutzrechu rabbotenu lomar midrashim, vahare shellecha lefanecha. velo chash Adonai sheyyite moshe veyomar nevua zo lefaro, ki beemtzaut sheyyashiv moshe lifne Adonai divre paro techef umiyyad yishlachehu bishlichut makka acheret, umimmela yeda moshe ki adayin lo higgia zeman makkat bechorot ad et bo devar paro veamar lo "al tosef". veraa ki eno yachol latzet millifne paro lehitnabbeot chutz lair ladaat ma yedabber Adonai, amar higgia hazzeman lemor makkat bechorot. o diyyek divre Adonai sheamar "vaani achazzek et lev paro", umeatta eno yodea shiur sheyyechazzek Adonai libbo sheyyomar lo achare chen makkot bechorot, uchesheamar lo "al tosef reot panay" hikkir ki ze hu tachlit chozek hallev, uvetzeruf taam rishon shekkatavnu amar lo shelichut makkat bechorot.

Od efshar sheim haya paro machazik libbo leshalleach yisrael velo haya medabber devarim neged kevodo yitbarach, keamro (Shemot 5:2) "mi Adonai", haya Adonai mevi alav makkat bechorot techef umiyyad velo haya masbio kosot hattarela. veze hu sheramaz Adonai lemoshe beamro "vaani achazzek et libbo velo yeshallach et haam", perush shehachozek hu shello yeshallach, sheim yeshallach afillu makkat bechorot lo tavo alav. ucheshello yihye ella meniat shilluach haam, yihye lo letzara makkat bechorot, aval achar shennaga bichvodo yitbarach yavou alav makkot gedolot veneemanot. vechen timtza sheamar Adonai (Shemot 9:16): "baavur hareotcha et kochi ulemaan sapper shemi" vegomer:

rashi: Vayyiru shotre vene yisrael. et chavrehem hannirdim al yadam,
Bera, rau otam beraa vetzara hammotzeet otam, behachebidam haavoda alehem lemor lo tigreu vegomer:

Vayyoel. ketargumo, vedome lo "hoel na velin" (Shoftim 19), "velu hoalnu" (Yehoshua 7), "hoalti ledabber" (Bereshit 18). umidrasho: leshon ala – nishba lo shello yazuz mimmidyan ki im birshuto (nedarim 65):
ohc: Et tzippora vitto lemoshe. taam shekkafal hazekarat shemo velo hispik lomar "vayyitten lo et" vegomer, yechavven hakkatuv lehodia ki hi bat zugo, vetevat lemoshe hu divre hakkatuv sheomer ki tzippora lemoshe hi lemana bat zugo.

rashi: Uleruach mishpat. yihye hakkadosh baruch hu lehorot mishpat:
Layyoshev al hammishpat veligvura. yihye leotan shehem meshive milchama, milchamtah shel tora (Megila 15 2):
targum: Lememar keshot dedin lidyatvin bevet dina lemidan din dikshot ulemittan nitzchana lidnafkin bikrava laatavutehon bishlam levattehon:

rashi: Vayyetev. hetiv lahen. veze chilluk beteva sheyyesodah shete otiyyot venatan lah vav yod beroshah, keshehi vaa ledabber leshon vayyafil hu nakud hayyod betzere, shehu kamatz katan, kegon vayyetev elohim lamyalledot, "vayyerev bevat yehuda" (Eicha 2), – hirba taaniyya. vechen "vayyegel hashsheerit" dinvuzaradan (divrei hayamim 2 36), – higla et hashsheerit, "vayyefen zanav el zanav" (Shoftim 15) – hifna hazzenavot zo lazo, kol ellu leshon hifil et acherim; ucheshehu medabber bilshon vayyifal, hu nakud hayyod bechirik, kegon "vayyitav beenav" (Vayikra 10), leshon hutav, vechen vayyirev haam, – nitrabba haam, "vayyigel yehuda" (Melachim 2 25) – hagla yehuda, "vayyifen ko vacho" (Shemot 2:12) – hifna lechan ulechan. veal teshiveni vayyelech, vayyeshev, vayyered, vayyetze, lefi sheenan miggizratan shel ellu, shehare hayyod yesod bahen, yelech, yeshev, yered, yetze – 10 ot shelishit bo:
Vayyetev elohim lamyalledot. mahu hattova?:
ohc: Vayyetev vegomer vayyirev vegomer. tzarich ledakdek ma hu hahatava, veulay shehu harashum besamuch "vayyaas lahem battim", vekashe im ken lo haya mafsik beamro "vayyirev haam". venire shemmorenu hakkatuv davar shebbeemtzauto ravu bene yisrael, lefi ma shekkadam lanu shehayu mesappekot lahen mayim umazon, laze amar vayyetev elohim lamyalledot, perush, natan lahem rav tuv uveemtzauto haya lahen yecholet lesappek mazon, uvaze vayyirev haam, vezulat ze lo yihye lahem lesappek larabbim behafelaga, veachar kach hizkir Adonai secharam hattov sheasa lahem battim.

Od yirmoz ki birot Adonai yiratam mehaelohim, hizmin leyadam asot mitzvot leen ketz leharebot secharam, vehu amro vayyetev vegomer, uma hu hattova – vayyirev haam, shebbaze yigdal zechutam ki chullam yechashvu lahem keshello haragum. veulay ki letaam ze zachu moshe veaharon beyisrael, ki beshellam zochim letzad ki yocheved umiryam natnu nafsham alenu veavru pi melech, veod lahem shezzanu ufirnesu mishshellahem, laze yechashvu alav hu avinu hu malkenu hu moshienu. vechallech gam ken lederech ze ki letzad sheanu anfe nishmato shel moshe, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 63:11) "moshe ammo", laze savla yocheved ullenu lehagen baadenu ulesappek mayim umazon kemishpat hayyoldim livnehem.

Uledivre hamefarshim (Rashi) shehahatava hi asiyyat habbattim, yesh lomar ki taam shehifsik beamro vayyirev haam, shezzulat ze en makom levatte kehunna uvatte malchut, ki im en am en melech vechohen, laze hikdim Adonai haam veachar kach asa lahem battim vegomer:

Ger hayiti. leshon avar, ki bizman shennichteva hattora yedabber hakkatuv. o yirtze al ze hadderech ger hayiti al derech amro (Tehillim 119:19) "ger anochi vaaretz", ki hatztzaddikim enam baolam hazze ella kegerim belo shum yishshuv, vehu amro ger hayiti meodi, venosaf li beeretz nachriyya letzad shehaya chutz meechav uvet aviv:

rashi: Veshamu lekolecha. mikkevan shettomar lahem lashon ze, yishmeu lekolcha, shekkevar siman ze masur beyadam miyyaakov umiyyosef, shebbelashon ze hem nigalim, yaakov amar lahem "velohim pakod yifkod etchem" (Bereshit 50), yosef amar lahem "pakod yifkod elohim etchem" (sham):
Nikra alenu. leshon mikre; vechen "vayyikkar elohim", "veanochi ikkare ko" (bammidbar 23) – ehe nikre meitto halom:
ohc: Veshamu lekolecha. taam amro lekolecha yechavven lehodio ki yaaminu vikabbelu mimmennu, hagam shello yomar lahem ma shemo. velaze im haya omer "veshamu lidvarecha" o "elecha", adayin yesh bannishma ki taam hakkabbala letzad devarim hanneemarim mimmennu. umeamro lekolecha, hinne hakkol hu mugbal heyoto meadam hammotzio lo mizzulato, ma sheen ken haddevarim sheyyittachnu lehaomer otam vehem divre hazzulat. laze amar lekolecha, perush, ki kesheyyotzi kolo kol mevasser yekabbelu mimmennu, uvaze shalal sheen shum davar meakkev lahem haemuna, lo sheelat hashshem veen tzarich lomar otot umoftim.

Adonai elohe haivriyyim. hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot nitchakkem lomar elav ki eno mitratztze sheyyikkare shemo ella al haivrim, velo hodia shem haggadol hazze ella lehaivrim, vehakkavvana kede shello yihye lo makom lefaro lomar "lo yadati" vegomer, vahalo gam Adonai amar "elohe haivrim", aval atta encha makkir ki bazuy atta meod, uma yakkir ish sade bemargaliyyot?

Nikra alenu. perush, leval yachshov ki yihyu regilim bechach veyihye kaze yom machar vechen al ze hadderech. gam efshar sheyyomar lahem achare chen sheyyatmidu bainyan, laze amru ki davar ze eno bitmidut gam eno davar haragil ella derech mikre, vehu amro nikra alenu:

Veatta nelcha na. amro veatta perush, ki davar ze hem tzerichin laasoto techef umiyyad belo shum sheelat zeman, ki elohehem lo kava zeman. o yirtze, ki eno davar ze ella lefi shaa, uchemo shepperashnu benikra alenu", vehakkavvana baze mehattaam atzmo sheamar nelcha na derech sheloshet yamim.

Sheloshet yamim. vetaaman shel devarim sheamar ken, letzad sheamar besamuch "veshaala ishsha mishshechentah" vegomer, veim lo yomru chen en metziut lishol mehem ulehalvotam kele chesef vegomer velatzet birchush gadol. uvaze tanuach haddaat lamma tzivva Adonai sheelat kesef vegomer mehashshechenot bizman mukedam, velo himtin ad et bo devaro hattov letzetam meeretz mitzrayim vesham yomar lahem, uma gam shehaddevarim sham bimkoman uvizmannam neemru beyom shellemachar yetzu, veim ken ma tzorech leamram kodem shenem asar chodesh.

Vehaya nire lomar ki ze haya lechazzek levavam baamittut haggeulla, veen ze ikkar. uledarkenu kaftor vaferach, ki hutzrach Adonai lomar lahem hattaam shehu hassovev sheyyomru "nelcha derech sheloshet yamim" vegomer, shebbaze "veshaala ishsha" vegomer letzad sheddatam lachzor. uvesamuch yitbaer od tevat "veatta".

Vaadayin tzarich latet lev, sof kol sof lamma yetzav Adonai devarim sheenam mehammusar, lignov datam ben bahalicha ben behashealat cheftzehem. vehaemet ki chol hammaase hu mishpat tzedek, ki letzad sheshshibedu beyisrael tzerichin lehaalot sechar sachir, vetze ulemad mitteshuvat ish yisrael lemitzrayim (sanhedrin tze,1) keshettavu mehem kelehem asher shealum. ella lamma yaase Adonai haddavar derech arma, ki chas veshalom lo katzor katzra yado mippedot yisrael beal karcham ulehotzi mamonam veenehem root vechalot?

Venire lomar ki nitkavven Adonai baze lehateotam, kede sheyyirdefu acharehem lehikkaved befaro vegomer, vezulat hahashala gam zulat halichatam bederech ze al daat lachzor, lo hayu hammitzriyyim rodfim acharehem. veayyen ma shekkatavnu befarashat beshallach befasuk "vayyehafech levav paro" vegomer (Shemot 14:5).

Vetimtza ot lidvarenu, ki amru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 14,3) shebbime haafela gillu yisrael matzpune hammitzriyyim veyadu otzrotehem usegullotehem vecheftzehem, uveyom sheelatam lo hayu hammitzrim yecholim lehachechid. mare deavraham, velamma lo netalum az veen mevin davar? ella vadday shennitkavven Adonai sheyyaasu keseder ze lirdof acharehem kannizkar veyikkaved bahem.

Uveinyan hammaase mitztzad atzmo shennatlu mamonam en issur baze lehatztzil adam et shello mehaannas, vetze ulemad miyyaakov shehaya maarim lehatztzil et shello miyyad lavan haarammi, vetze ulemad mimmaase shelosha tannaim (yoma fag,1) asher hitztzilu pikdonam meeshet kidor bederech arma veen baze issur, vehu omer hannavi (tehillim 18,27): "veim ikkesh" vegomer.

Uma shellefanenu hainyan hu yoter naki uvar, ki dikdakti bechol haddevarim hanneemarim bainyan veen bahem devar sheker, ki lo hizkiru bilshonam hachazara kelal. vegam lashon ze letzad maalat kadsho elohe yisrael lo ratza lechannot haddevarim elav, ella hem bene yisrael yedabberu kaze. velaze amar tevat veatta, perush lomar ki hem divre atzmam lo divre elyon. sheim lo amar "veatta" haya hakkavvana al ze hadderech "nikra alenu veamar nelcha" vegomer. uchemo chen timtza bedivre moshe im paro amar lo (Shemot 5:1) "shallach et ammi veyachoggu li bammidbar", lo hizkir zeman, ella yisrael amru lo (Shemot 5:3) "nelcha na derech" vegomer. vahagam shebbedivrehem sham lo amru "veatta", samach al pasuk rishon. vahavinoti beimre noam beamro "shallach et ammi veyachoggu li bammidbar" ki chol devarav tzedek veemet, shehare dor sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim lo chaggu ella bammidbar, ki sham naflu pigrehem veet benehem hichnis Adonai laaretz. vahagam sheotam gam ken yatzu mimmitzrayim, af al pi chen lo yechashvu hem ella haggedolim haovdim vehazzovchim vehem mibben esrim shana, uvaze kol divre Adonai emet vatzedek. gam hashealat hakkesef vegomer en bo devar sheker, betorat sheela ba leyadam ella sheikkevuhu bead teviatam sheyyesh lahem keneged sechar sachir sheavdu otam uvanu kamma binyanim, uchesheyyavou lecheshbon yedayyeku hacheshbon veyashlimu lahem hammitzriyyim ma shennogea lahem.

Veachat shaalti amda li, uma hichriach haddavar lihyot ken lirdof hammitzrim achare bene yisrael, velamma lo yikkaved Adonai befaro uvechol ammo veyaale alehem hayeor baddavar atzmo asher zadu, vesham yatzef Adonai lefaro ulechol ammo vegam hannashim vehattaf, velo haya tzarich lechol haamur, veyotzi yisrael bechesef vezahav beal karcham, o sheyyitlu hakkol beshivat yeme afela (Shemot Rabba 94) ki lahem haya or vechippesum kemo shekkatavnu besamuch. veulay ki asa Adonai kacha lishne teamim, haechad ki keriat yam suf ufelaav pirsemu gedullato yitbarach uchevodo male olam kayyadua ma shello haya naase chen beofen acher. vetaam sheni ki Adonai moded midda keneged midda, veamru zichronam livracha (sota 11:) ki hammitzriyyim nitchakkemu al yisrael leshabedam bitchilla befe rach veachar kach befarech, vehashshofet betzedek madad bammidda atzmah ki mittechilla befe rach "nelcha sheloshet yamim", "hasheilunu kaspechem simlotechem" vegomer, veachar kach befarech, veal kol panim nitchakkem haadon shello yetze gam mippi yisrael devar sheker kannizkar (Micha 7:20) "titten emet leyaakov".

rashi: Belechtecha lashuv mitzrayma vegomer. da sheal menat ken telech shettehe gibbor bishlichuti laasot kol moftay lifne faro velo tira mimmennu:

Asher samti veyadecha. lo al shalosh otot haamurot lemala, shehare lo lifne faro tzivva laasotam ella lifne yisrael sheyyaaminu lo, velo matzinu sheasaam lefanav, ella moftim sheani atid lasum beyadcha bemitzrayim, kemo "ki yedabber alechem paro vegomer" (Shemot 7); veal titma al asher ketiv "asher samti", shekken mashmao, keshettedabber immo kevar samtim beyadcha:

ohc: Lech likrat moshe vegomer. vahagam sheamar elav Adonai mikkodem (Shemot 4:14) "hinne hu yotze" vegomer, lefi ma shennoda lanu ki yedabber Adonai devarim rabbim bedibbur echad, beshaa sheamar lemoshe "hinne hu" vegomer yatza dibbur acher leaharon bemitzrayim. unevua zo en safek shenneemra leaharon, hagam sheamru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim 1) shekkol makom shenneemar "vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon" lo neemar haddibbur ella lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon, vaafillu lerabbi yose haggelili shessover (sham) shennitmaet aharon afillu bedibburim shenneemru bemitzrayim, davka bidvarim hashshayyachim bishlichut lehazzulat, aval perat ze sheyyaase aharon mitzva, hare shellecha lefanecha sheddibber elav Adonai, umizze atta lamed shehaya navi leatzmo.

rashi: Ulevenim omrim lanu. hannogsim asu, kamminyan harishon:

Vechatat ammecha. illu haya nakud pattach, hayiti omer shehu davuk, vedavar ze chattat ammecha hu, achshav shehu kamatz, shem davar hu, vechach perusho: vedavar ze mevi chattat al ammecha, keillu chatuv vechattat leammecha; kemo "kevoana bet lechem" (Rut 1), shehu kemo levet lechem, vechen harebe:
Vechuppar beritchem et mavet. veyitbattel habberit asher amartem karatnu verit et mavet. kol 'kappara leshon 'kinnuach vesilluk davar, vechen "achappera fanav" (Bereshit 32:21):
Vechazutechem, asher amartem: im sheol asinu choze:
Shot shotef. asher amartem lo yevoennu, vihyitem lo lemirmas:
targum: Vivatel kiyamchon deim katola ushelamchon deim mechabbela la yitkayam mechat sana are tete alechon kenachal magbar utechon lehon ledayish:

rashi: Veelle shemot bene yisrael. aappi shemmenaan bechayyehem bishmotam, chazar umenaam bemitatam, lehodia chibbatam, shennimshelu lechochavim, shemmotziam umachnisam bemispar uvishmotam (shemot Rabba), shenne "hammotzi vemispar tzevaam lechullam beshem yikra" (Yeshayahu 40):
ohc: Veelle shemot bene yisrael. taam amro "veelle" betosefet vav, lelammed alehem ki chullam tzaddikim kaavotehem, "veelle" mosif al harishonim, ma rishonim lahem avraham yitzchak yaakov tzaddikim elyonim, kemaase avot asu habbanim.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, shemot 4) ki zeman haggalut hitchil mime avraham mishshennolad yitzchak, vehu amro "veelle" vegomer "habbaim mitzrayma" – mosif al harishonim, lomar lecha sheggam harishonim begalut hayu veelle immahem.
Od yirtze, ma harishonim yadu vehikkiru baggalut vekibbelu alehem veal zaram, kemo chen elle. vehu amro "veelle" mosif al harishonim.

Ulederech ze hirvachnu taam nachon ladaat leeze inyan chazar hakkatuv umenaam achar shekkevar menaam befarashat vayyiggash biridatam lemitzrayim, verashi zichrono livracha peresh ki lehodia chibbatam chazar umenaam bemotam, veen davar ze maspik ella lidrasha velo lifshatan shel devarim, veod lidvarav haya lo likboa hamminyan achar amro "vayyamat yosef" vegomer "veelle shemot" vegomer.

Uledarkenu hakkatuv yodia taam minyanam shemmone hu veholech besefer hattora mi vami habba lekabbel gezerat melech lisbol ol haggalut, velo pana oref kemaase esav harasha (Bereshit 36:8) shehalach lo el eretz mippene yaakov, vedarshu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 82,13) mippene shetar chov shel haggalut. veamar "veelle shemot vegomer habbaim mitzrayma", perush habbaim lisbol ol haggalut bemitzrayim "et yaakov", itto bedomin lo behasekama achat lifroa shetar chov haggalut. laze dikdek lomar habbaim, perush hagam shello bau, chafetzim hayu lavo, veze lecha haot ish uveto bau keadam shemmechin atzmo al haddavar, veillu yardu mitzrayim lesibba yedua lo hayu okrim diratam uvaim, vehayu baim biat aray veraglehem regel yeshara lashuv artza kenaan.

Vetaam shechazar lomar bau velo hispik bema shehikdim lomar "habbaim", nitkavven laasot hefresh ben hammenuyim bapparasha leanshe vetam, ki anshe vetam en kullam begeder ze. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat vayyiggash befasuk "banav uvene vanav" vegomer (Bereshit 46:7), ki hem davka hayu chafetzim baddavar. vahagam shello mana kan ella shenem asar shevatim, ulay shehem hayu begeder bifne atzmam bedome leyaakov.

O yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mertzonam vecheftzam mitzrayma harshumim reuven shimon vegomer, aval kol shear yotze yerech yaakov letzad shebba yaakov bau immo, vehu amro et yaakov ish uveto bau, vezulat biat yaakov lo hayu baim kullam, velaze hutzrach lomar "bau" paam sheniyya.

Od yirtze amro habbaim vegomer, shebba lomar mofet chotech ki birtzonam bau, veharaya sheachar mot avihem vealu artza kenaan chazru paam sheniyya, kaamur befarashat vaychi, vehu amro "habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov" mechadash "ish uveto bau", achar shealu mishsham chazru lemitzrayim ish uveto. umana hakkatuv mi hem baale tzidkut ze reuven vegomer, ha lamadta ki anfe hailan kailan atzmo shavim lachpotz bigzerat melech, vayyikkatev besefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai vegomer:

rashi: Vayyaas lahem battim. batte chehunna uleviyya umalchut shekkeruyin battim, kemo shekkatuv: "livnot et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech" (Melachim 1 9:1), kehunna uleviyya miyyocheved umalchut mimmiryam‪.‬ kidita bemassechet sota:‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬‬
Shal. shelof vehotze, kemo "venashal habbarzel" (Devarim 19), "ki yishshal zetecha" (sham 28):
Admat kodesh hu. hammakom:
ohc: Al tikrav vegomer shal vegomer. hinne shene devarim yetzav oto Adonai, echad shello yikrav, veechad sheyyishlof naal raglo shello yaamod bo afillu bammakom shehu omed bo, keamro hammakom asher atta omed alav kevar admat kodesh hu, vetzarich ledakdek lamma lo hikdim lomar lo hasarat michshol shekkevar hu natun bo shehu omed beminalo al admat kodesh, veachar kach yetzav alav leval yikrav halom.

Da ki bechol hattora kullah gilla Adonai dato uretzono, ki ikkar hakepadato umusaro hu al mitzvot lo taase, ki ze yachbol bannefesh. vehu taam amro (Kohelet 12:7) "veharuach tashuv vegomer asher netanah", veamru zichronam livracha (shabbat kinnev,2): tenah lo kemo shennetanah lecha. aval mitzvot ase hem hassagat hattov kesheyyihyu, uveheadram en onesh, zulat al peratim yeduim kegon pesach umila.

Vehinne kan tzivva lo Adonai mitzvat lo taase umitzvat ase. lo taase hi al tikrav halom, veamru zichronam livracha (eruvin tzav,1; shavuot lo,2) kol makom shenneemar "pen" veal" eno ella lo taase, umitzvat ase hi shal nealecha. veim moshe yikrav halom hare avar al lo taase, veim lo yasir naalo, hagam sheeno derech kavod lammakom, lo avar ella aase mimma sheamar lo Adonai bilshon ase. vetamid yakdim Adonai hashshemira laasiyya, dichtiv (Devarim 4:6): "ushemartem vaasitem", "lishmor laasot" (Devarim 15:5), "mishmarti mitzvotay" (Bereshit 26:5). laze gam ken hikdim hechamur al tikrav lo taase, veachar kach ase shal vegomer, sheyyinhag kavod bammakom hamekuddash.

Ella sheyyesh lanu ladaat daat elyon, lamma lo kara elav kodem sheyyaamod bemakom kadosh, lechol yikrav benaalo asher beraglo al admat kodesh. veulay ki eno rauy haddavar lehityached haddibbur alav ki im betzeruf azharat al tikrav halom. od efshar lomar shello nitkaddesh hammakom shebbo amad ad achar kach, vehattaam shekkesheratza Adonai ledabber immo sham bimkom amidato ratza lekaddesho vehizhiro kodem. veulay ki laze dikdek lomar tevat hu, ki lo haya tzarich lomar ella hammakom vegomer admat kodesh, ella nitkavven hakkatuv beamro hu lomar velo haya kodem.

rashi: Befesha sefatayim. befesha sifte dor hammabbul, sheamru: "ma shadday ki naavdennu" (Iyov 21:15), ba lahem mokesh ra, venoach hatztzaddik yatza mehatztzara (tanchuma, noach 16):
targum: Bechova desifvata matkal bisha ufalit tzadika min akta:

rashi: Bayyom hahu. kehittam happoshim:
Yihye Adonai tzevaot laateret tzevi. latztzaddikim hannisharim bah:
targum: Beidana hahi yehe meshicha dayya tzevaot lichlila dechedva ulecheter detushebacha lishara deame:

rashi: Lechol ammo. af alehem gazar (sota 12), yom shennolad moshe amru lo itztagninav, hayyom nolad moshian, veen anu yodim im mimmitzrayim im miyyisrael, veroin anu shessofo lilkot bammayim, lefichach gazar oto hayyom af al hammitzriyyim, shenneemar kol habben hayyillod, velo neemar hayyillod laivrim; vehem lo hayu yodim shessofo lilkot al me meriva:
ohc: Vaytzav vegomer lechol ammo vegomer. lefi ma shekkatavnu ki mittechilla dibber lamyalledot sheyyihye haddavar besod velo yedu benot yisrael, keshello alta beyado asa haddavar befirsum vetzivva lechol ammo al haddavar, ki chashav ki en nimlat mehem letzad heyotam rabbim venikkarim shello yerachamu alehem. od ulay letzad sheraa beitztagninut ki moshian shel yisrael nolad veatid lilkot bammayim (sanhedrin ka,1), laze gazar gezera chazaka uminna kol ish mitzri al haddavar, uvaze en nimlat miyyadam.

Veamro lemor, perush, lo shehammitzriyyim hem atzmam yashlichuhu, ella sheyyomru livne yisrael shekkol echad yashlich banav. vehattaam lema sheamarnu shehaggezera hayta letzad ma sherau itztagninav vechulei, min hassetam yiru hadderech shellaka bo shehu al yede yisrael, laze gazar shebbene yisrael hem yashlichu oto hayeora, uchemo shekken haya sheyyocheved hi hishlicha et moshe bayor.
O yirtze lemor, shehem yetzauu lechol shachen al shechunato al haddavar, velo yitztarchu kol haam.

Veyesh merabbotenu sheamru (sota 12,1) sheggam al hammitzriyyim gazar, veze derech derash shebbeyom echad asher amru lefaro ki vo bayyom vegomer, oto yom gazar al kol ammo. aval peshat hakkatuv en haddevarim amurim ella beyisrael, ki gezera zo bitmidut hayta, veharaya ki yocheved natna moshe bayor achar shelosha yerachim vehaitztagninim rau yom halleda, veillu lo hayta haggezera ella yom ledat moshe vehukkar hayyom hahu, ma makom ligzor od? ella vadday sheggezera zo al kol habben hayyillod hayta bitmidut, uvehechreach amro lechol ammo hu letzavvem al bene yisrael, vehadderasha tiddaresh.

rashi: Veal yishu bedivre shaker. veal yehegu vidabberu tamid bedivre ruach lemor, nelcha nizbecha; vedome lo "veesha vechukkecha tamid" (Tehillim 119); "lemashal velishnina" (Devarim 28), metargeminan "uleshoe"; vaysapper – "veishtai"; vei efshar lomar yishu leshon "vayyisha Adonai el hevel", "veel kayin veel minchato lo shaa" (Bereshit 4), ulefaresh al yishu – al yifnu, sheim ken haya lo lichtov veal yishu el divre shaker o ledivre shaker, ki chen gizrat kullam, "yishe haadam al osehu" (Yeshayahu 17), "velo yishe el hammizbechot", (sham), "velo shau al kedosh yisrael" (sham 31), velo matzati shimmush shel bet semucha leacharehem, aval achar leshon dibbur – kemitassek ledabber bedavar – nofel leshon shimmush bet, kegon: "hannidbarim becha" (Yechezkel 33), "vattedabber miryam veaharon bemoshe" (Bamidbar 12), "hammalach haddover bi" (Zecharya 4), "ledabber bam" (Devarim 11), "vaadabbera veedotecha" (Tehillim 119), af kan – el yishu bedivre shaker – al yihyu nidbarim bedivre shav vahavay:
Mipperi fi ish. missechar pihem shel oske tora, ochlim tov baolam hazze, vehakkeren kayyemet lahem laolam habba:
targum: Gavra min peri fumeh yisba tavta vechol bar nash hech ovad aydo mitperia:

rashi: Hafoch reshaim. kemo "lahafoch", kemahpechat rega (Eicha 4:6) nehpachim:
Veenam. kalim, kegon sedom (Bereshit 19:24-25):
Uvet tzaddikim yaamod. yitkayyem:
targum: Nithappechun rashie vela nishtakkechun uvethon detzadike yekum:

rashi: Shocher tov. hechafetz lehaderich et habberiyyot bederech tova, umochiach umeyasser otam:
Yevakkesh ratzon. hu chafetz sheyyihye hakkadosh baruch hu rotze bam, umitpayyes immam. ratzon, 210 belaaz:
targum: Demakdim tavta bae tzivyana vetavea bishta atya aloy:

rashi: Vaygarshum. mippene hannidduy (sham):
Ocher beto yinchal ruach. adam atzel sheyyinchal ruach tamid, veeno yagea battora velo vimlacha, sof ocher et bene veto, sheen lahem ma leechol:
targum: Acher beteh yeret pachata vesichla yeheve avda lechakkim libba:

rashi: Veheeminu lekol haot haacharon. mishshettomar lahem bishvilchem lakiti, al shessipparti alechem lashon hara, yaaminu lecha, shekkevar lamdu vechach shehammizdavvegin lehara lahem lokim bingaim, kegon paro vaavimelech bishvil sara:
Moshle haam hazze. haomrim latzon belashon mashal, kegon:
targum: Bechen kabbilu pitgama dayya gavrin rashiin shiltone ama haden di virushelem:

rashi: Hinne yesh ruach chazak veammitz laAdonai, shehu kezerem barad vsaar katev meriri:
Hinniach laaretz beyad. yannichehu al artzam beyado hachazaka, veyappil hannovlot min hatteenim:
targum: Ha machan takifan vachasinan atyan min kodam Adonai kezarmit barad kealul ruach kezarmit mayayn takifin shatfin ken yetun alehon ammaya veyiglunun mearahon leara ochari bechovaya di videhon:

rashi: Peri tzaddik. gemul perot maase hatztzaddikim etz chayyim hem laolam:
Velokeach nefashot chacham. mi shehu chacham, kone lo nefashot. shemmelammedam derech tov, vahare hem lo keillu kenaam, keinyan shenneemar "veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan" (Bereshit 12:5):
targum: Peroy detzadika ilana dechaye umekabbelanuta denafshe chachmeta:

rashi: Shikkore efrayim. shehayu mishtakkerin beyayin tov shel medinat perugita, kidamar (shabbat 147 2): mayya dedormaskit vechamra difrugita kippechu aseret hashshevatim:

Vetzitz novel tzevi tifarto. umatztzav matta tifarto yihye tzitz happerach shello novel. hem teenim hamekulkalot, kemo sheshshaninu bivrachot (berachot 40 2) al hannovlot, ufershu rabbotenu: beshule kamra, vtzitz netz, kedimtargeminan (Bamidbar 17:23) "vayyatzetz tzitz" – "veanetz netz":
Asher netuim al rosh ge shemanim. hi kinneret, shepperoteha metukim, vesham hem holmim atzman byayin:

Halume yayin. "ketushe chamar". veyesh od liftor tzevi tifarto asher al vegomer: tzevi hattiferet sheal rosh aseret hashshevatim, hammeshuchin begeut rashe shemanim, kemo shenneemar (Amos 6:6) "reshit shemanim yimshachu". ge leshon 'gaava, kemo (Yeshayahu 16:6) "moav ge meod" (veoto hatztzitz ketzitzat novel tihye). halume yayin. kach koran al shem shichrutan, shenneemar bahem (Amos 6:6) "hashshotim bemizreke yayin":
targum: Vay di yahev kitra legevtana tifsha rabba deyisrael veyahev mitznafta lerashiaya devet makdesha tushebachte di al resh chela shemena ketishe chamar:

rashi: Hakkemakkat makkehu hikkahu hareitem bigvurati, shekkemakkat hammakke yaakov hikkitiv? hem tibbeum bammayim vaani tibbatim bammayim. yesh temihot shehem mitkayyemot, kegon zo, uchegon (Shmuel 1 2:27) "haniglo nigleti el bet avicha", (Yechezkel 8:6) "haroe atta ma hemma osim":
Im kehereg yisrael, shehayu harugin shel paro, horeg paro veammo?
targum: Hakkemachta dahava mache machohi im kiktol ketilohi yitketel:

rashi: Vedibber hu lecha. bishvilcha yedabber el haam. veze yochiach al kol lecha veli velo velachem velahem hassemuchim ledibbur shekkullam leshon al hem:
Yihye lecha lefe. lemelitz, lefi sheatta chevad pe:
Lelohim. lerav ulesar:

Veachar bau moshe veaharon vegomer. aval hazzekenim nishmetu echad echad meachar moshe veaharon, ad shennishmetu chullam kodem shehiggiu lappalatin, lefi sheyyaru lalechet; uvesinay nifra lahem, "veniggash moshe levaddo el Adonai vehem lo yiggashu" (Shemot 24) – hecheziram laachorehem (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Veachar bau vegomer. perush, achar sheheemin haam. vechen hem divre Adonai, dichtiv (Shemot 3:18): "veshamu lekolecha" veachar kach "uvata" vegomer, velaze hifsik hafesaka kodem "veshamu lekolecha", hagam shehu siyyum inyan hannogea leyisrael, usemachah im "uvata" vegomer vehaven:

rashi: Meshitihu. shechalite, hu leshon hotzaa belashon arammi, "kemishchal binta mechalava", uvelshon ivri meshitihu leshon hasirotiv, kemo lo yamush, lo mashu, kach chibbero menachem. vaani omer sheeno mimmachberet mash veyamush ella miggizrat masha, uleshon hotzaa hu, vechen "yamsheni mimmayim rabbim", (Shmuel 2 22), sheillu haya mimmachberet mash lo yittachen lomar meshitihu ella hamishotihu, kaasher yeamer min kam hakimoti, umin shav hashivoti, umin ba havioti, o mashtihu, kemo "umashti et avon haaretz" (Zecharya 3), aval mashiti eno ella miggizrat teva sheppoal shellah meyussad beHei besof hatteva, kegon masha, bana, asa, tzivva, pana, kesheyyavo lomar bahem paalti, tavo hayyod bimkom hei, kemo baniti, asiti, tzivviti:
ohc: Vattikra shemo vegomer vattomer vegomer. hinne timtza shinnuy bikriat shem yitzchak veyaakov vehashshevatim, ki lechullam yakdim taam hashshem veachar kach hashshem. beyitzchak (Bereshit 21:6) "kol hashshomea yitzchak vegomer vattikra shemo yitzchak", yaakov (Bereshit 25:26) "veyado ochezet baakev vayyikra shemo yaakov". bashshevatim "ki raa Adonai vattikra shemo reuven" (Bereshit 29:32), "ki shama vegomer vattikra shemo shimon" (Bereshit 29:33), vechen al ze hadderech. ma sheen ken bikriat shemo shel moshe hikdim hazekarat shemo veachar kach taam hashshem.

Veulay ki haimmahot hayu baale ruach hakkodesh, vehayu massigot bechinat hashshem, ukeriat hashshem hayta lema shehayu mechavvenim bo, ma sheen ken keriat shem moshe. maggid hakkatuv ki lo hissiga ladaat bechinat hashshem, ki shemo niflaot yaggid. vetze ulemad ma shekkatuv besefer hazzohar (chelek 3 daf reu; Tikkunim tikun 69) ma yirmoz shem ze. vaAdonai hassam shemot baaretz sam befiha shem moshe, uma sheamra hi betaam hashshem hu ki min hammayim meshitihu, velo yada taam zulat ze:

O yirtze hakkatuv lomar, ki zot haishsha helima taam hashshem shello yitgalle lakkol, letzad ki hammaase haya hefech retzon kol ammah, lehatztzil otam, shehem gazru alehem lehashelicham layor vehi tevattel atzatam lera lahem. laze lo pirsema taam hashshem ella keraattu setam belo taam, vehakkatuv modia tamah shekkeraattu kach hu letzad sheamra "ki min hammayim".

rashi: Tov nikle. beenav, venaasa eved leatzmo:
Mimmitkabbed. beenav, veomer: genay hu li laamol bimlacha, sheani mibbene adam gedolim; vesofo lihyot chasar lachem:
targum: Tav hu zelila veavde it leh min hu demityakar vachasir lachma:

rashi: Vayyachazek bo. leshon achiza hu; veharebe yesh bammikra, "vayyachaziku haanashim beyado" (Bereshit 19), "vehechezika bimvushav" (Devarim 25), "vehechezakti bizkano" (Shmuel 1 17), (kol leshon chizzuk haddavuk levet leshon achiza hu):

Vehayu hammayim vegomer. "vehayu" "vehayu", 2 peamim nire veenay, illu neemar vehayu hammayim asher tikkach min hayeor ledam bayyabbashet, shomea ani, shebbeyado hem nehpachim ledam – veaf kesheyyerdu laaretz yihyu bahavayatan, aval achshav melammedenu shello yihyu dam ad sheyyihyu vayyabbashet:
ohc: Vehaya im lo yaaminu. vechi yesh safek lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, veod, vahalo kevar amar "veshamu lekolecha"? veulay sheshshiur haddevarim kach hu: vehaya im adayin tachush od velo yaspik lecha taam ze lomar shebbo vadday yaaminu.

Od nire ki nitkavven lomar lo lehasir gam safek sheeno nire, vehu dilma lo yachlitu yisrael haemuna belibbam hagam shebbifnehem lo yukkar heder haemuna, laze amar "im lo yaaminu" vegomer, vesafek ze eno yuchal lehitbarer lemoshe lomar alav mi ikka sefeka kamme shemayya lomar "im lo", shehem devarim shebballev, uva haadon lehasir mimmennu sefek hachechashat haemuna belev yisrael beemtzaut shelosh haotot.

Vehayu hammayim vegomer. meor ene yisrael Rashi zichrono livracha nire beenav ki taam amro "vehayu vehayu" hu lomar shello yihyu ledam ad sheyyihyu bayyabbeshet. vedivre kadosh chen. vaani mosif bo taam lishvach, ki hu mittaam atzmo shetztzivva Adonai ki aharon hu yakke bemattehu bayor, veamru zichrono livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,10) ki moshe eno yachol lehakkot hayeor letzad shehegin baado, vechan tzivva Adonai sheyyikkach mimmeme hayeor veyihyu ledam, venitchakkem shello tihye hammakka al yede moshe. laze amar vehayu bahavayyatan kol zeman sheyyihyu beyado, ella achar sheyyihyu bayyabbeshet yihyu dam, uvaze en lekutam ba al yede moshe.

rashi: Atta tire vegomer. hirharta al middotay, lo cheavraham sheamarti lo "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" (Bereshit 21), veachar kach amarti lo "haalehu leola" velo hirher acharay; lefichach atta tire. heasuy lefaro tire, velo heasuy lemalche shiva ummot kesheaviem laaretz (sanhedrin 111):
Ki veyad chazaka yeshallechem. mippene yadi hachazaka shettechezak alav yeshallechem:
Uveyad chazaka yegarshem meartzo. al karcham shel yisrael yegarshem, lo yaspiku laashot lahem tzeda; vechen hu omer "vattechezak mitzrayim al haam vegomer" (Shemot 12):
ohc: Atta tire vegomer. taam amro atta, hu teshuva lema sheamar "umeaz bati vegomer hera leyisrael" yoter mehakkodem, amar lo atta tire ki raa zo techef tistallek tosefet veikkar, kemo shekken haya shebbemakka rishona shel dam nistallek hashshibud kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9), veze hefech machashavto shechashav sheyyatmid raat yisrael meemtzaut shelichut ze ad et haggeulla kemo shepperashti bidvarav.

Od yirtze lahashivo al ma sheamar ki oyev cheref Adonai velo kinne lichvod shemo, atta tire asher eese lefaro al ze. veamro ki veyad vegomer yitbaer lefi ma shepperashnu beechad mehatteamim shenneemar lemoshe makkat bechorot bishlichut rishona, hu sheim lo haya paro meiz panav ledabber devarim neged kevodo yitbarach, techef haya meshallecham bemakkat bechorot, veal yede ki devar Adonai baza hifli Adonai makkotav, vehu amro ki veyad chazaka yeshallechem, perush, achazzek libbo ad sheatimehu mitteamim rabbim marim vekashim, veachar kach yeshallechem, veze letaam naga bichvod elyon.

Uveyad chazaka vegomer. kan hodia asher yarish Adonai bahavaat makkat bechorot, keamram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 186) befasuk "en bayit asher en sham met", ki hayu metim gedole habbattim im en bechor, vehayu metim bechore av gam bechore em. uveemtzaut ken lo hispik leshallecham levad ella legarsham bimhirut gadol, dichtiv (Shemot 12:33) "vattechezak mitzrayim vegomer lemaher" vegomer. ucheneged ma sheamar battechilla "lama hareota" vegomer, baa hatteshuva bapparasha hassemucha "vaydabber elohim" vegomer.
Chassalat parashat Shemot

rashi: Lirchotz al hayeor. sares hammikra ufarshehu: vattered bat paro al hayeor lirchotz bo:

Al yad hayeor. etzel hayeor, chemo "reu chelkat yoav el yadi" (Shmuel 2 14), vehu leshon yad mammash, sheyyad haadam semucha lo. verabbotenu amru, "holchot" leshon mita (sota 12), kemo "hinne anochi holech lamut" (Bereshit 25) – holchot lamut lefi shemmichu vah; vehakkatuv mesayyean, ki lamma lanu lichtov venaaroteha holchot:

Et amatah. et shifchatah. verabbotenu darshu (sota sham), leshon yad, aval lefi dikduk leshon hakkodesh haya lo lehinnaked ammatah, degusha, vehem darshu et amatah – et yadah, venishtarbeva ammatah ammot harebe:
ohc: Venaaroteha holchot vegomer. tzarich ledakdek kavvanat sippur ze venaaroteha holchot, veulay sheyyechavven lomar maase bitya, leheyot ki maase mitzva gedola asta dikdek hakkatuv lehodia dikduk ofen hammaase. vehinne davar yadua hu ki bat melech lo telech layor belo nearot kemishpat benot melachim, gam mimmusar haggedolim uvifrat hammelachim lihyot lahem echad meyuchad mechubbad harebe lehitgallot lefanav uleshammesho velirchotz bevet hammerchatz o bayor vechaddome, vechan hodia hakkatuv beamro "venaaroteha holchot" shehaya bizman shehayta rochetzet, shehutzrechu naaroteha mimmusar hammalchut shello laamod lefaneha, velo nishara immah ella achat hameyuchedet vattishlach otah, vehu amro vattishlach et amatah perush hameyuchedet lah lirchotz vegomer. veamro vattikkacheha shekula – o sheshshalcha otah leval teyaatzah hefech retzonah, ki retzonah shel bat paro hayta lehatztzil hayyeled hahu vattikkacheha bat paro latteva; o vattishlach vegomer vattikkacheha amatah, velishne hadderachim shevach bat paro yaggid, ki nafshah nefesh tehora, mi yitten tahor mittame vegomer (Iyov 14:4) ladderech ha yechavven lomar shehagam shello hayta immah ella ama achat vechol naaroteha hayu holchot vegomer af al pi chen chashsha limnia mimmenna ushelachattah venisheret bat melech levaddah velakcha hatteva beyadah, ulederech 2 gam ken shevach yaggid, shehagam shello hayta immah ella ama achat veen midderech hammusar shettishshaer bat melech yechida, veen tzarich lomar al sefat hayeor, af al pi chen shalcha otah lemerachok, velaze hikdim lehodia venaaroteha vegomer ladaat kavvanat hodaat vattishlach et amatah al ofen shekkatavnu, veillu lo amar venaaroteha lo hayta hakkavvana yedua shennitkavven lema shepperashnu, vehaven:
Veet hammatte hazze. amar hazze, lefi ma sheamru bazzohar (Zohar chelek 2 28) ki hayu shene mattot, amar "hazze" lishlol acher.

Veomro tikkach beyadecha perush bitmidut, vehattaam lesiman ki yesh beyado matte oz tifara, vechen chok lasserara hamemunnim al devar malchut. veze lecha haot dichtiv (Shemot 4:20) "vayyashav artza mitzrayim vayyikkach vegomer matte haelohim beyado", hare shettechef lavash keli zayin shennatan lo Adonai, sheim hayta kavvanat hallekicha hu shellekacho leholicho immo lo haya lo lomar beyado.

Veamro asher taase bo et haotot, ulay sheramaz lematte sheni shel aharon shebbo asa haotot shennehpach lenachash (Shemot 7:10), ucheamram sham bazzohar shezze yikkare matte aharon, shetztzivva gam alav sheyyihye muchan beyad aharon. od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha (targum yonatan Shemot 2:21) shehammatte haya sanpirinon, velo haya adam yachol lahasito ella moshe, uchefi ze lekichato yaggid ki hu bo yaase et haotot, veze lecha haot ki lo yikrav el hammatte ish zar zulat moshe.

rashi: Vehaya lahem devar Adonai vegomer. kemiddatam yimdod lahem, yigzor sheddevaro alehem tzav shel ummot hammishtabedim bam al tzav, pekuda al pekuda, avoda al avoda,kav shel puranut keneged kav shel averot shebbeyadam, kav lakav tikva chilluf tikva, yekauu leor vehinne choshech (Iyov 3:9):
Zeer sham zeer sham. leyamim muatim tavo alehem, vehem yitmaatu sham beeretz oyvehem:
targum: Den yehe chas pureanutehon al daavaru al pitgama dayya veal deitpakadu lemebad orayta uma deitpakadu la tzeviu lemebad bechen yitmasrun leammaya dela yedau orayta al dehalichu virut nafshehon vela chamidu lemebad reuti bechen yesabberun lesaid beidan deayti alehon aka vela yehe lehon said vesamich al dahava zeer beenehon bet makdashi lemiflach taman vechen yishtaarun kizer bene ammaya deyiglon letaman bedil dihachun veyitkelun laachora veyittabberun veyittatzdun veyitachadun:

rashi: Tov yafik. motzi min hakkadosh baruch hu nachat ruach, lehavi tova laolam:
Veish mezimmot yarshia. baal alilot yarshia – mechayyev et habberiyyot lehavi raa, vechen hu omer "vechote echad yeabbed tova harebe" (Kohelet 9:18):
targum: Tav man dekabbel reuteh deelaha vegavra rashia reia tariteh:

rashi: Beyad tishlach. beyad mi sheatta ragil lishloach, vehu aharon. davar acher: beyad acher shettirtze lishloach, en sofi lehachenisam laaretz velihyot goalam leatid, yesh lecha sheluchim harebe:
ohc: Bi adonay shelach vegomer. perush, eni chas veshalom tole haddavar letzad habbore, ki kol yachol asot, ella meniat hasarat happegam hi mitztziddi, ki eni rauy lenes. vehu amro "bi adonay" taluy kol hachissaron vehammenia. veamro shelach na vegomer, perush, beyad mi shehu rauy laasot shelichutecha, lo beshafal kamoni shekkavua bi mumi, veze yaggid al heyoti bilti mucheshar lishlichut naala:

rashi: Vattelech haalma. halcha bizrizut vealmut keelem (sham):
Shene anashim ivrim. datan vaaviram, hem shehotiru min hamman (nedarim 64):
Nitztzim. merivim:
Lamma takke. aappi shello hikkahu nikra rasha baharamat yad (sanhedrin 58):
Reecha. rasha kemotcha (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayyomer larasha vegomer. perush, larasha shehaya bahem, veamro reecha – lu yihye sheyyihye rasha kemotcha, lamma yihye bolea tzaddik mimmennu. o yirtze ki hikkir sheechad rasha veechad tam shello hereo, laze amar larasha, lamma takke adam shello nitchayyev lecha velo bikkesh raatcha, vehu amro reecha. vahagam sheamar battechilla shene anashim nitztzim, yimmatze sheechad yariv chinnam letzad risho veidach yariv al rivo chinnam.

Vayyomer hinneni. lo kishmuel shello hikkir hakkore (Shmuel 1 3:4), ki moshe navi haya beterem yatza mibbeten immo vehikkir hakkore. veulay ki ze ramaz beamro hammare haggadol ramaz el gadol hameyuchad:

Hinne anochi va vegomer. perush, hareni maskim lavo bishlichut ze, veen makom latteanot shettaanti, ella shetztzarich kodem leheamen lenavi leyisrael, vetzarich ani lavo lahem mikkodem. veamru li ma shemo – perush, bifshitut hu etzli sheyyomru li ma shemo, vehattaam ki timtza shebbechol nevuat havetachot haavot yazkir lahem Adonai shemo. beavraham amar befarashat lech lecha (Bereshit 15:7): "ani Adonai asher hotzeticha" vegomer, uvinvuat havetachat hazzera vehaaretz od amar lo (Bereshit 17:1): "ani el shadday", vechen beyaakov amar befarashat vayyetze (Bereshit 28:13): "vayyomer ani Adonai", od befarashat vayyishlach amar elav (Bereshit 35:11): "ani el shadday" vegomer. ha lamadta ki bechol hahavtachot yazkir shemo yitbarach hammavtiach, umikkol shekken kesheyyishlach navi lezulat, shetztzarich sheyyomar shem hameshalleach. veulay ki bechol nevua asher yinnave Adonai laavadav yizkor shemo, veyillamed satum mehameforash. veleheyot shekkesheddibber Adonai el moshe binvua zo lo hizkir lo shemo, ella ken amar lo: "anochi elohe avicha" vegomer, laze amar elav: hinne anochi ba el bene yisrael veamarti lahem elohe avotechem kemaamar Adonai el moshe anochi elohe avicha elohe avraham belo hazekarat hashshem, veamru li ma shemo – perush, letzad sheen ani mazkir hashshem bezichrono hem yishalu.

Uvaze tanuach haddaat bachakira achat, vehu ma ot vehammofet bidiat hashshem o behazekarato, mimma nafshach: im shem ze yadua livne yisrael en baze ot letova, ki keshem sheyyedauhu yisrael yedao gam ken moshe veen hochacha, veim en hashshem yadua ki ze shemo yitbarach vead atta umi yaamin elav ki ze shem nora. veraiti mehamefarshim sheppershu perushim uderachim rechokim, vechol mi sheyyesh lo chech toem yitam devarenu veyihyu lefiv tzappichit ki lo leot ulemofet hu chafetz behazekarat hashshem, vetimtza sheamar lo Adonai shem "ehye" hagam shello matzinu shehuzekar bechol hannevuot laavot umin hassetam lo yihye yadua labbanim ella shemot shehukkeru lehaavot, ella vadday sheen ot velo mofet behazekarat hashshem ella tamo kemo shekkatavnu. veze techillat hakkarat moshe ki neeman pashut hu bechol shelichutav unevuotav sheddikdek divre Adonai shello hizkir hashshem, velo samach al dato lomar ki yefaresh middato veyazkir shemo achar shehussag etzlo emunat hannevua, umin hassetam vadday sheyyadua haya lemoshe shem echad mishshemotav shel hamenabbe. veod efshar shennitkavven moshe lehareviach daat ma hi hammidda shemmedabber immo Adonai bah.

rashi: Lo yitten etchem melech mitzrayim lahaloch. im en ani mare lo yadi hachazaka; kelomar, kol od sheen ani modio yadi hachazaka, lo yitten etchem lahaloch:

Lo yitten. la yishbok kemo: "al ken lo netatticha" (Bereshit 20), "velo netano elohim lehara immadi" (sham 31), vechullan leshon netina hem. veyem velo beyad chazaka — velo bishvil sheyyado chazaka, "ki meaz eshlach et yadi vehikketi et mitzrayim vegomer", umetargemin oto "vela min kodam dechele takkif". mishshemo shel rabbi yaakov berabbi menachem neemar li:
Vayyifgeu. anashim miyyisrael et moshe veet aharon vegomer. verabbotenu darshu: kol "nitztzim" "venitztzavim" datan vaaviram hayu, shenne bahem "yatzu nitztzavim" (Bamidbar 16:24), (nedarim 64):
Asher amar hannavi lahem zot hammenucha – lihyotchem beshalva, hanichu leayef – shello tigzeluhu, zot tihye lachem hammargea:
targum: Deamrin lehon neviyaya den bet makdesha pelachu veh veda achsanat bet neyacha vela avu lekabbala ulefan:

rashi: Vayyotziah mecheko vehinne shava kivsaro. mikkan shemmidda tova memaheret lavo mimmiddat puranut, shehare varishona lo neemar "mecheko" (sham):

Belabbat esh. beshalhevet esh – libbo shel esh, kemo "lev hashshamayim" (Devarim 4), "belev haela" (Shmuel 2 18); veal titma al hattav, sheyyesh lanu chayyotze vo, "ma amula libbatech" (Yechezkel 16):
Mittoch hassene. velo ilan acher, mishshum "immo anochi vetzara" (Tehillim 91 15):
Ukkol. neechol, kemo "lo ubbad bah" (Devarim 21), "asher lukkach mishsham" (Bereshit 3):
Mi sam pe vegomer. mi limmedecha ledabber, keshehayita niddon lifne faro al hammitzri?

O mi yasum illem. mi asa faro illem, shello nitammetz bemitzvat harigatcha, veet meshartav chershim shello shamu betzauoto alecha, veet espaklatorin hahorgim mi asaam ivrim shello rau keshebbarachta min habbima venimlatta?
Halo anochi. sheshshemi Adonai asiti chol zot (sam):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai elav mi sam vegomer. yirtze lomar elav shehaya lo livtoach bo shehu hassam pe sheyyasim gam elav, vechevan shekken mana mimmennu harfua zulat leet hatztzorech, vehu amro veatta vegomer vehoreticha aval lo laakor mimmennu haillegut. o yirtze lirmoz sheyyaase teshuva al miut havetachato.

Od raiti ledakdek divre Adonai shello ramaz lo perat happeulla shemmoshe tzarich lah, shehi sheyyasim lo pe achar heyoto illem, o ayin achar heyoto ivver, velo amar ella techillat habberia umeora sheachare chen, vehu amro "mi sam pe" vegomer, vehammeora hu "o mi yasum illem o cheresh", vechen chaluka sheniyya: "o fikkeach" bitchillato "o ivver" achar kach, aval lo hizkir ki yaase achar kach laillem petuach pe, vecheresh shomea, veivver pikkeach. umeatta en kavvanat hatteshuva yedua. veyesh lehair od lamma Adonai lo mana mimmennu taana zo bitchilla uvarishona, uma gam sherauy lihyot ken.

Achen nitkavven lomar elav ki hu haadon hu habbore, vehiskil laasot pe laadam leshichlul habberia, vehu amro mi sam pe vegomer, veamar o mi vegomer perush, shehagam sheyyeera laadam davar sheyyihye illem vegomer gam ze lo bemikre yihye haddavar hahu ella mimmenni, anochi Adonai hu haose haddavar vaani mesabbev sibbuvin laasoto ken letachlit davar. uvaze ramaz lo ki kevedut piv uleshono hu letachlit davar tov, velaze lo hesir mimmennu illeguto. o yirtze lomar kevan shehassam illem vegomer hu Adonai baruch hu, im ken haya lo lehasekil bedato ki meAdonai yatza devar malchut sheyyease illeg, vezulat gezerat melech lo haya chen, vaafillu ledivre chachamim (Shemot Rabba 1,25) shehaya sibba ledavar ze gachelet shennatan lefiv behavechanat paro, im lo haya Adonai chafetz baddavar lo haya chen achar she hechin veasa peullato bahachanat happe, keamro "mi sam pe" vegomer davar pashut hu shekkesheyyaase illem yihye haddavar letzad eze tachlit hagun o lema shennitchayyev kefi maasav, uchemaamar rabbi ame (shabbat noah,1) en yissurin belo avon, uchevad pe velashon nikraim gam ken yissurin, veim ken haya rauy lo lemoshe ladaat sibbat davar uletakken veyitpallel laAdonai al haddavar, asher lo chen hu ose ella adrabba mare ki haddavar hu tivi veeno taluy mitztziddo. velaze amar elav veatta, veen veatta ella teshuva sheyyachzor bo middaat zo.
Ucheneged chashash shello yaaminu yisrael letzad illeguto, amar elav "anochi ehye im picha vehoreticha" vegomer.
