Od nire sheyyechavven beamro lech veanochi ehye im picha, sheheshivo teshuva nitztzachat, ki chol od shello hitchil bammitzva en makom lehasir illeguto, velaze amar "lech" – perush, lech bishlichut ze ucheshettedabber tire sheyyusar kevedut picha uleshoncha, vehu amro vehoreticha asher tedabber, lo amar "et asher tedabber" ella "asher tedabber" – perush, arecha shettedabber belashon tzach, vehaven venachon. vetaam amro "vehoreticha" velo amar "vearecha", nitkavven lirmoz lo sheyyihye lo tzachut haddibbur kederech haragil baadam behorato, lo lefi shaa yihye haddavar kemaase nissim ella bederech tiviyyut gamur keillu hora gever belashon tzach veragil, velo kemo shekkatavti beferush rishon shello yedabber tzachot ella beet hatztzorech.

rashi: Attem lechu kechu lachem teven. utzerichim attem lelech bizrizut,
Ki en nigra meavodatchem davar, mikkol sechum levenim sheheyitem osim layyom bihyot hatteven nittan lachem mezumman mibbet hammelech:
ohc: Ki en nigra vegomer. taam amro "ki en" vegomer velo amar "veen nigra", hachi perusho: ko amar paro vegomer attem lechu vegomer, udevarim ellu en bahem besora raa, veadrabba hem chafetzim baddavar, lehakel mealehem melechet habbinyan velaasot melacha zo lekoshesh kash latteven. laze amar taam haggezera hi ki en nigra, veen ze ella hameatat hazzeman bedavar ze kede shettaasu avodatchem bizman muat.

Vaered lehatztzilo ulehaaloto vegomer. taam amro vaered, ki lefi erech gedullat el elyon eno mikkevodo laasot kol hannaase sheyyavou devarav leadam naval kefaro velomar elav devarim mishshemo, uma gam kesheyyaggia lemadregat meun ad haggio lomar (Shemot 5:2) "mi Adonai" chas veshalom. vetze ulemad ma sheddarshu berabbot biftichat echa (Eicha Rabba, Petichta 14) befasuk (Mishlei 29:9) "ish chacham nishpat et ish evil" – shafat lo amar ella nishpat vechulei yeuyyan sham divrehem. laze amar Adonai vaered – hiskim al miut kevodo kivyachol letzad hatztzalat yisrael, keamro "lehatztzilo". vechavvanat hatztzala zo hi sheyyatztzilo meachshav mehainnuy umehashshibud, vehu amro miyyad mitzrayim hameshabedim bahem.

Veamro ulehaaloto min haaretz, perush, kesheyyaggia zeman haggeulla mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh aale oto min haaretz vegomer, leval yitakkev sham od afillu belo innuy. vetaam shello heela otam techef umiyyad, hu letzad sheadayin lo higgia zeman haggeulla asher katzav Adonai. uvaze nacha dati bachakira achat lamma heerich Adonai shenem asar chodesh bemakkot hammitzrim, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,12) mehem amru shehammakka hayta meshammeshet shelosha shavuot vehahatraa shavua echad, umehem amru lehefech, velamma yeacher Adonai haggeulla, vehaya lo lehavi hammakkot zo achar zo veyigalem miyyad, vetaspik hahatraa beyom echad o beshaa achat kedin hateraat yisrael sheen tzarich bah zeman, umikkol shekken ummot haolam sheenan tzerichin hateraa. gam lamma lo hispik hateraa achat al kol hammakkot. ella letzad sheadayin lo higgia hazzeman haya Adonai malbish hazzeman hahu lehasebiam merorot bene bene ad shehiggia hazzeman ugealam miyyad belo shum ikkuv. veim tomar uma bechach im haya Adonai goel otam kodem zeman ze. od, lamma Adonai hotziam bezibbula batrayta bizman sheim hayu mitakkevim ketzat hayu nilkadim ad shehutzrach lemaher velo yachlu lehitmahmeah vehaya lo lehotziam bizman meruvvach?

Hinne lema shekkadam lanu ki ikkar haggalut hu levarer hannitzotzot shennitmeu bachamishshim shaare tuma, uchemo shetztziyyanti davar ze kamma peamim (Bereshit 49:9), baze yanuach daat bishte hashsheelot, ki im haya motziam kodem ze hayu mafsidim berur hachelek hahu. veteda sheam Adonai hissigu bivchinat kelalutam hakkalul bemoshe shennityaches beshem ammo hassagat 49 shaare bina, vetaam shello hissig shaar hachamishshim hu letzad sheen hammussag ella behishtaddelut hammassig, uletzad sheyyisrael lo nichnesu bachamishshim shaare tuma levarer oto lo hissigu bechinat hakkodesh shekkenegdo. vehuvtachnu ki leatid lavo yashpia banu el elyon torat chayyim shebbeshaar hachamishshim vehassagato hu beemtzaut haggaluyyot, uvifrat galut haacharon anu massigim haddavar.

Vetaam shennistakkenu yisrael bemitzrayim beverur shaar hachamishshim, letzad shello hayu bene tora, ma sheen ken dorot haacharonim beemtzaut toratam yassigu likkanes leshaar hachamishshim ulehotzi balo mippiv, veaz safu tammu bechinat hattuma. umeatta kol shehaya Adonai motzi yisrael kodem zeman kol shehu hayu memaatim habberur vehayu mitmaatim bammussag, velaze hotziam bannekudda haacharona shel 49 vekodem sheyyikkansu leshaar hachamishshim, vehu amram zichrono livracha ugealam miyyad (fesachim perek 10 mishna 5 lageyresat 287).

rashi: Vaomar elecha. bishlichuto shel makom shallach et beni:

Hinne anochi horeg vegomer. hi makka acharona, uvah hitrahu techilla mippene shehi kasha; veze hu sheamar "hen el yasgiv bechocho" – lefichach "mi chamohu more" (Iyov 36); basar vadam hamevakkesh lehinnakem mechavero, maalim et devarav, shello yevakkesh hatztzala, aval hakkabba yasgiv bechocho veen yecholet lehimmalet miyyado ki im beshuvo elav, lefichach hu morehu umatre vo lashuv:
Vayyishretzu. shehayu yoldot shishsha bechares echad (sham):
Bivosh ketzirah. ketzire sharasheha, kemo "teshallach ketzireha" (tehillim 80:12), "veasa katzir" (Iyov 14:9). kelomar: keshettichle zechut meat shekkibbed et aviv, az tishshavarna seifeha:

Nashim baot meirot otah. am challash kenashim yadlikum, kach tirgem yonatan. meirot kemo (Malachi 1:10) "velo tairu mizbechi chinnam", vechen patar dunash: mechamat shehaetzim yihyu yeveshim yihyu nochim lehadelik. aval menachem (mechubberet: ar) patar: 'melakketot, kemo (Shir HaShirim 5:1) "ariti mori", (tehillim 80:13) "vearuha kol ovre darech". heshiv lo dunash: vahalo ketiv "bivosh ketzirah", uvaanafim yeveshim en melakketin peri. vechen rabbotenu, sheasru lekabbel mehen tzedaka mippene hattaam hazze, sheamru bevava batra perek kamma (bava batra 10 2): let leh "bivosh ketzirah tishshavarna":
targum: Yitkatzar chelehon veyivhatun beovdehon yittabberun neshaya alan levet dechaltehon umalfan yathon are la am sucheltan inun al ken la yerachem alehon deavdinun udevaranun la yachus alehon:

rashi: Vayyigdal moshe. vahalo kevar katav vayyigdal hayyeled? amar rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay, harishon lekoma vehashsheni ligdulla, shemminnahu paro al beto (yalkut shemauni):
Vayyar besivlotam. natan enav velibbo lihyot metzer alehem (Shemot Rabba 1):
Ish mitzri. noges haya memunne al shotre yisrael vehaya maamidam mikkerot haggever limlachtam (sham):

Makke ish ivri. malkehu verodehu. uvalah shel shelomit bat divri haya venatan enav bah, uvallayla heemido vehotzio mibbeto, vehu chazar venichnas labbayit uva al ishto, kisvura shehu valah, vechazar haish leveto vehirgish baddavar, uchesheraa oto mitzri shehirgish baddavar, haya makkehu verodehu kol hayyom (sham):
ohc: Ish ivri meechav. dikdek lomar meechav, yirmoz ki hibbit bo shehaya mehatztzaddikim shebbeyisrael, ki hayu az beyisrael reshaim. vetze ulemad ma sheamru zichronam livracha (mechilta al Shemot 12:29) befasuk "vachamushim alu" vegomer (Shemot 13:18) shearbaa chalakim, uleman deamar yoter, metu bime hachoshech, vehashshear alu letzad heyotam reshaim. vetimtza shekkaasher amar besamuch "shene anashim ivrim nitztzim" lo amar "meechav", letaam shehayu reshaim, ki hem datan vaaviram (Shemot Rabba 1,29).

rashi: Vayyiref. hammalach mimmennu, az hevina sheal hammila ba lehargo:
Amra chatan damim lammulot. chatani haya nirtzach al devar hammila:
Lammulot. al devar hammulot. shem davar hu, vehallamed meshammeshet bilshon al, kemo "veamar paro livne yisrael" (Shemot 14), veunkelos tirgem damim al dam hammila:

Zacharti lach. im heyitem shavim elay, taavati lerachem alechem, ki zacharti chesed neurayich vahavat kelilat chuppatech, shehichlaltich lechuppa; velashon hachenasa hu. kelulotayich notzish belaaz. uma hu chesed neurayich? lechtech achar sheluchay, moshe veaharon; meeretz noshavet (Shemot 16:35) yetzatem lamidbar, veen tzeda ladderech, ki heemantem bi (mechilta ba pischa yad):
targum: Ezil vetitnabbe kodam ama di virushelem lememar kidnan amar Adonai dacherna lechon tavvat yome kedem rachamat avahatchon dehemnu bememri vaazalu batar teren sheliche batar moshe veaharon bemadbera arbein shenin bela zevadin beara dela mizdara:

rashi: Befarech. baavoda kasha, hamefarechet et hagguf umeshabbarto (sham):
Pen yifgaenu. pen yifgaacha hayu tzerichim lomar, ella shechalku kavod lammalchut. pegia zo leshon mikre mavet hi (sham):
ohc: Vayyomru vegomer pen yifgaenu. devarim ellu hem shel yisrael. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 5,14) shehazzekenim nishmetu echad echad, af al pi chen achar kach dibberu devarim ellu. veal shello bau yachad im moshe veaharon neenshu. o ulay shekkol haam nichnesu yachdav el paro veamru lo divre taam, ki yoter tov lo sheyyeshallechem veyesh tikva sheyyashuvu achar kach mishshevet sham veyichlu baddever vegomer, gam davar ze yifchad mimmennu paro ki yigga ad libbo dever vecherev habba lishchunato. veulay nitchakkemu lehafechido pen yifgaehu lefaro vegomer, vehilbishu hakkelala bahem letzad kevodo shel melech.

rashi: Hen rabbim atta am haaretz. shehaavoda muttelet alehem, veattem mashbitim otam missivlotam, hefsed gadol hu ze:
ohc: Vayyomer paro vegomer. perush, letzad shehem rabbim enam bat yachil (Melachim 1 7:26) lehasir mehem morech levav ze shel pegiat cherev mikkullam, vedavar ze yihye gorem shettashbitu otam missivlotam ki yitchammetz veyerach levavam, vetaromet ze hu al moshe veaharon. o yiton keneged hannogsim asher hinnichu otam lavo lefaro uvittelu avodatam, veamar ki hen rabbim hem uzeman muat shel bittul avodatam yaase harebe roshem.

rashi: Vayyomer ki ehye immach. heshivo al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon; sheamarta mi anochi ki elech el paro – lo shellecha hi ki im mishshelli, ki ehye immach – veze hammare asher raita bassene lecha haot ki anochi shelachticha, ucheday ani lehatztzil, kaasher raita hassene oshe shelichuti veenennu ukkol, kach telech bishlichuti veencha nizzok; vesheshshaalta ma zechut yesh leyisrael sheyyetzu mimmitzrayim? davar gadol yesh li al hotzaa zo, shehare atidim lekabbel hattora al hahar hazze lesof 3 chodashim sheyyetzu mimmitzrayim. davar acher: ki ehye immach, veze shettatzliach bishlichutecha lecha haot al havetacha acheret, sheani mavtichacha shekkeshettotziem mimmitzrayim taavdun oti al hahar hazze, shettekabbelu hattora alav, vehi hazzechut haomedet leyisrael. vedugmat lashon ze matzinu: "veze lecha haot achol hashshana safiach vegomer" (Yeshayahu 37), mappalat sancheriv tihye lecha ot al havetacha acheret, sheartzechem chareva mipperot vaani avarech hassefichim:
ohc: Vayyomer ki ehye immach vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma teshuva meshivo el elyon "ki ehye immach", halo vadday ki yada moshe ki mikkocho hu ba, ella shettaan ki letzad miut erko lo yitztaddak. od kashe amro veze lecha haot vegomer, en yadua haot, veim al ot shello ukkol hassene kemo shepperesh Rashi, en haddaat mityashshevet baze, vechi moshe haya safek etzlo chas veshalom hayachol yuchal hatztzil. veod kashe ma sheggamar omer ki anochi vegomer, shemmashma ki haya mistappek im Adonai sholcho, veze eno emet ki lo amar moshe davar sheyyaggid sefeko baze.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech, shebba Adonai lehashivo al rishon rishon. keneged ma sheamarta "mi anochi ki elech el paro", da ki sham ehye immach, umeatta gedullatcha gedola miggedullato vechitrecha gadol mikkitro, veematcha muttelet alav mimma shemuttelet emato alecha, verauy lihyot beenecha hedyot. gam baze satar lo ma sheamar sheeno rauy lehotzi, ki hen herahu Adonai shehassagato gedola. veamro veze lecha haot, perush, veze lecha haot sheatta rauy laasot davar gadol kaze, uma hu haot – "ki anochi shelachticha", veillu lo hayita rauy lo hayiti sholchacha, uma makom lachashashat sheencha rauy. veamro behotziacha vegomer, yechavven lomar lo ki taale beyado hammitzva ad tachlitah veyotzi haam hu veyaavdun et haelohim vegomer, umeatta tamma taanat "vechi otzi", ki hare modio Adonai tachlit haddavar, veen safek kaasher yaggid Adonai mehaatidot.

Od yirtze beamro veze lecha vegomer, al ze hadderech: davar ze sheatta maktin atzmecha veomer "mi anochi", ze lecha leot ki beemtzaut keniyyatcha midda zo "anochi shelachticha". veamro behotziacha vegomer, kemo shepperashnuha besamuch.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, veze lecha haot ki anochi gamarti haddavar sheyyihye shelichut ze al yadcha, behotziacha vegomer al hahar hazze sinay bakkodesh, perush hahar hannamuch shebbaharim, veen ani bocher beharim haramim ketavor vechermon, ha lamadta ki en ani chafetz ella bannemuchim kamocha heanav vehashshafal beenecha uvahar hannamuch hazze, vechol ze teshuva letaanat "vechi otzi" vegomer.

rashi: Vattechayyena et hayeladim. mesappekot lahem mayim umazon. targum harishon vekayyama, vehashsheni vekayyemtun, lefi shelleshon avar linkevot rabbot teva zo vechayyotze vah meshammeshet leshon paalu uleshon pealtem, kegon "vattomarna ish mitzri" (Shemot 2), (leshon avar) kemo vayyomru lizcharim, "vattedabberna befichem" (Yirmeyahu 44), leshon dibbarten, kemo vattedabberu lizcharim, vechen "vattechallelena oti el ammi" (Yechezkel 13), leshon avar chillalten, kemo vattechallelu lizcharim:
ohc: Vattirena hameyalledot vegomer. tzarich ledakdek lamma kafal lomar velo asu vattechayyena. verazal (sota 11,1) amru shehayu mesappekot mayim umazon. vetzarich ledakdek lamma lo hayu osim lahem ken mikkodem. veulay sheyyodia hakkatuv shello pasku mehahatava, vehu sibbat hayyira sheyyaru et haelohim afillu al meniat hahatava shehayu regilin lehetiv besippuk mazon, velo millevad shello asu vegomer ella vattechayyena.

O leolam ki mikkodem lo natnu datam al mitzva zo lesappek mayim umazon, veachar shetztzivva lahem paro chashshu sheyyihyu nechshadim im yamut echad mehannoladim shehem haraguhu, laze lehotzi atzman mehachashad, hishtaddelu lehachayot afillu mi sheyyamut mitat atzmo mechesron hassippuk. veulay ki ze ramaz betevat et haelohim lerabbot yetziat yede chovat chashad bene adam lihyot nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael.

Vetaam amro kaasher dibber kaf haddimmuy, lomar lo hu velo dome lo. o yirtze lomar, leheyot ki min hadderech hu kesheyyigzor melech davar, al kol panim bitchillat haggezera devar melech chazak veemat melech roeshet leval avor aleha, uveorech hayyamim achar haggezera hi rofefet, velaze hodia hakkatuv ki hatztzadkaniyyot hallalu bittelu gezerat melech samuch laggezera, vehu amro velo asu, veematay? kaasher dibber, kemo shettomar ki beet sheyyatzu mishsham vehayu meyalledot laivriyyot lo asu vegomer, veadrabba sippeku mazon leen nachon uvittelu devarav samuch laggezera. veshiur kaasher dibber keshiur (Bereshit 27:30) "kaasher killa yitzchak levarech".

rashi: Alav. al haam:
Missim. leshon mas, sarim sheggovin mehem hammas, umahu hammas? sheyyivnu are miskenot lefaro:
Lemaan annoto besivlotam.‬ shel mitzrayim:
Are miskenot. ketargumo, vechen "lech bo el hassochen hazze" (Yeshayahu 22) – gizbar hamemunne al haotzarot:
Et pitom veet raamses. shello hayu reuyot mittechilla lechach, vaasaum chazakot uvetzurot leotzar:
ohc: Vayyasimu alav vegomer. kan habben shoel: ma chachma nitchakkemu baze? en zo chachma ella raut vachatzifut. od, ech melaam libbam bitchillat hashshibud lasum alehem sare missim? veod, ech bene yisrael natu arpam laavodat avoda nachriyya bechomer uvilvenim? vehinne razal sheamru (sota 11,1) ki haya haddavar behaderaga, bitchilla befe rach ulevassof befarech, umin seder hakketuvim mashma ki bitchilla samu alehem sare missim, uledivrehem zichronam livracha tzarich lomar ki kadmu devarim lesimat sare missim.

Vehinne lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "rav veatzum mimmennu", ki sovrim sheyyecholin lehishtabed bahem bead hattov sheasu lahem bishne raav, efshar shebbau alehem bechoach vael techef umiyyad, veshibedum vayyasimu alehem sarim, veaz hayu muatim beerech hammitzriyyim venatu arpam. uma sheamar hakkatuv "hava nitchakkema" eno al perat hashshibud ella al perat acher, uchemo chen amru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1,18) shehaya al shikkua habbanim bayyam kaamur bedivrehem.
Od nire bedikduk od amro lemaan annoto vegomer, shello haya tzarich vehaddavar muvan shehu lemaan annoto mitkavvenim. od amro besivlotam ma ba lemaet?

Achen nire shennitchakkemu alav lehishtabed bederech ze, ki paro min hassetam yihyu lo bonim arim lashevet veharebe ovdim avodot hatztzerichin lammalchut mehammitzriyyim atzmam umehazzulat, vehaanashim hahemma yikkaru "mas" kemo sheamar hakkatuv (Melachim 1 5:27): "vayyaal hammelech shelomo mas mikkol yisrael", veyaatz etza lasum al yisrael sheyyihyu hem sare missim, yuvan sheyyihyu hem hammemunnim al kol ose melechet hammelech. vedavar ze eno pechitut velo dallut leyisrael veenam yecholin lemaen. vechavvanatam baze hu learma, lemaan annoto leam yisrael besivlotan shel hammissim shehem ovde avdut, keshello yuchelu laavod avodatam asher samu alehem betosefet merubba mimma sheyyuchelu seet, yitztarchu hassarim lehitztaref immahem laavod avodatam lehashelim chukkam, shello hayu makkirim bechok haavoda ella lassarim shehem yisrael shehem hem hammemunnim. vezo hi chachmatam shebbeemtzaut arma zo hichnisum bassevalot, vehu amram zichronam livracha bitchilla befe rach hayu lesarim veachar kach laavadim, "vayyiven are" vegomer.

rashi: Tafriu et haam mimmaasav. tavdilu vetarchiku otam mimmelachtam, sheshshomin lachem usevurim lanuach min hammelacha; vechen "peraehu al taavor bo" (Mishlei 4) – rachakehu, vechen "vattifreu chol atzati" (sham 1), "ki farua hu" (Shemot 32) – nirchak venitav:

Lechu lesivlotechem. lechu limlachtechem sheyyesh lachem laasot bevattechem, aval melechet shibud mitzrayim lo hayta al shivto shel levi; teda lecha, shehare moshe veaharon yotzim uvaim (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vayyomer vegomer lamma moshe vegomer. perush, leheyot shehayu lefanav moshe veaharon vehazzekenim sheamru "elohe haivrim" vegomer, vehechzir panav el moshe veamar: en telunati al zikne yisrael, ki hem nafal alehem pachat vafachad mehacherev vehaddever, vehatteluna hu alechem sheasitem shene devarim: haechad – shebbatem bishlichut elay meelohechem, im ken haddavar taluy bi, im ken ma makom lehafechid haam pen yifgaem baddever, vahalo enam birshut atzmam vaanusim hem. ma tomar, ki hem yecholin latzet birshut atzmam? im ken lamma bata elay bishlichut leshallecham? veulay ki laze nitkavvenu razal (Shemot Rabba 5,15) sheamru veze leshonam: "attem lamma, divrechem lamma?" perush, attem lamma batem elay, divrechem sheamartem laam hazze mippi elohehem pen vegomer lamma? – shehem shene devarim sotrim. veheshiv panav leyisrael veamar lechu lesivlotechem, ki moshe veaharon birshut atzman hayu.

rashi: Divre reshaim erav dam. yoatzim lirtzoach beyadam o al yede edut sheker:
Ufi yesharim. kesheshshomim et atzatam, yatztzilum lannirdafim, shemmegallim et atzatam; o im edim hem, mezimmin otam:
targum: Mile derashie kamnin lidma ufumehon ditritze maftze lehon:

rashi: Lamyalledot. hu leshon molidot, ella sheyyesh la kal veyesh la kaved, kemo shover umeshabber, dover umedabber, kach molid umeyalled:
Shifra. yocheved, al shem shemmeshapperet et havvalad (shem):
Pua. zo miryam, sheppoa umedabberet vehoga lavvalad (shem), kederech hannashim hamefayyesot tinok habboche.
Pua. leshon tzeaka, kemo "kayyoleda efe" (yeshaya 42):
ohc: Vayyomer melech vegomer. hagam shekkol hammaase haamur bainyan amar leshon rabbim, dichtiv "vayyasimu" "vechaasher yeannu" vegomer, "vayyaavidu", "vaymarru", ki lo hammelech levaddo ose ella hu veammo, davar ze asao hammelech levaddo kede sheyyihye haddavar besod, shello yargishu haivriyyot lehasetir heryonam veshello yarchiku hameyalledot milleled otam kaasher avaer besamuch.

Lamyalledot haivriyyot vegomer. tzarich ledakdek ma amar lahem baamira zo. veulay ki haamira hi shekkara veamar haivriyyot asher shem haachat vegomer, ki leheyot shebbau lefanav harebe velo haya makkir ellu hameyalledot, laze kara bishmotam leyached lahem haddibbur letzad shehayu gedolot shel kol hameyalledot veratza lehattil haddavar alehen, ki chen derech hasserara. od yirtze shehu asa otan gedolot vesarot bikria zo al kol hameyalledot, vaasher al ken perat et shemotan, velaze chazar lomar paam acheret vayyomer beyalledchen vegomer, perush shehatztziuuy lo lishtehen levad ella lechol hameyalledot, ella sheellu yihyu alehem sarot.

Od yirmoz hakkatuv leshon gedulla verommut, al derech (Devarim 26:17-18) "et Adonai heemarta vaAdonai heemircha", vehakkavvana baze lehaggid shebbeemtzaut inyan ze garam lahem paro maala vehitrommut lishte hameyalledot, vealu bemaala kaamur besamuch (Shemot 1:20): "vayyetev elohim vegomer vayyaas lahem battim" – batte chehunna, batte leviyya, batte malchut, batte neviut (sota 11:).

rashi: Kodesh yisrael. kitruma:
Reshit tevuato. kereshit katzir lifne haomer, sheasur baachila vehaochlo mitchayyev, ken kol ochlav yeshamu. ken targem yonatan:
targum: Kudeshaya inun vet yisrael kodam Adonai veal bazzehon kedima aramut alla deman daachal mineh chayav lememat ucheshiru chatzad omar aramuta dead la mekarvin mineh kahanaya bene aharon kurebnaya al madbecha man deachil mineh mitchayev af ken kol bazvehon devet yisrael yechovun bishta tete alehon amar Adonai:

ohc: Vaymarru et vegomer. amro baavoda kasha perush, baavoda shehi kasha mitztzad atzmah afillu bemuat mimmenna, vehu avodat chomer ulevenim vaavodat sade.

Veamro et kol avodatam vegomer, ki lo tomar shehirpu yadam mehem mishshiur habbinyan shekkatzvu lahem mikkodem, ella shekkitzvat avoda rishona bimkomah omedet vehosifu lahem. kemo shettomar sheachar shessamu alehem kach vechach sheyyivnu bechol yom achar sheyyihye hachomer vehallevenim muchanim lifnehem, hosifu alehem laasot hachanat hachomer vehallevenim vechol avodat hachanat habbinyan, velo hekellu mitztzad ze shiur avoda rishona asher avdu vahem befarech ella ittah immah. veze mehahitchakkemut pen yirbe, veaf al pi chen lo hoilu lehameitam ki nitrabbu bene yisrael vehispiku ledavar ze, vaasher al ken "vayyomer melech mitzrayim" vegomer lehamit hazzecharim.

Vayyaan moshe vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma makom letaanat "lo yaaminu" achar shehivticho Adonai veamar "veshamu lekolecha". od, lamma kafal lomar "lo yaaminu velo yishmeu bekoli"? vehaya efshar lomar ki letzad sheadam baal bechira veratzon, lo samach libbo alehem sheyyatzdiku beemuna. veamro velo yishmeu vegomer, perush afillu shemiat kolo lo yirtzu lishmoa. veen derech ze maspik bechavvanat hakkatuv, ki lo haya lo lehareher achar middotav yitbarach velachshod kol kach beyisrael. od yesh ledakdek amro hen velo amar "im lo" vegomer.

Veyitbaer al nachon al derech ma shekkatav rambam beferek 7 mehilchot yesode hattora veze leshono: en nevua shora ella al chacham gadol bechachma vechulei shalem begufo vechulei, ad kan, vechatav hakkesef mishne veze leshono: vetzarich iyyun, lamma lo katav shetztzarich sheyyihye ashir gibbor veanav, veteretz sheotam tenaim tzerichin lammitnabbe bikviut, verambam lo nachet lefaresh ella al hammitnabbe shello bikviut. vehinne afillu im nomar shettechashev nevua zo shel moshe akray, ma sheeno chen, af al pi chen toen taana hannishmaat letzad anvetanuto ki hu chaser tenaim shebbahem yeamen navi leyisrael, vehu amro vehen, perush, vechen hu haddin shello yaaminu li ki en ani chacham gadol bechachma umale mikkol hattenaim hameushsharim, veen tzarich lomar im techashev neviat keviut kemo shekken hu kefi haemet, ki hu holech uva mehashshem leyisrael ulefaro ulemitzrayim, im ken tzarich sheyyihye ashir ma shello chen haya, veze lecha haot shehaya roe lechotno tzono velo nitashsher ella bammidbar mehalluchot (nedarim lach,1), veim ken im yavou yisrael lishol leziknehem hammishpat, hen lo yaaminu li kefi haddin.

Uma sheamar velo yishmeu bekoli, kan ramaz od taana hannishmaat ki hu kevad pe, uchemo sheggilla achar kach beferush "ki chevad pe". vedavar ze hu echad mittenae hammitnabbe afillu beakray sheyyihye shalem begufo, veze echad mechesrone hagguf, velaze amar "velo yishmeu" lesibbat kol, ki chevad pe uchevad lashon hu. veamar hattaam ki yomru lo nira elecha vegomer, perush, encha rauy sheyyerae lecha kol ikkar vaafillu beakray. uma shello taan taana zo moshe ad atta velo shaal ella "veamru li ma shemo ma omar", shezze yaggid sheeno choshesh lahem shello yaaminu, sheim haya choshesh laze lo haya mechazzer achar yediat hashshem shehu davar shettechef yomar elav "ze shemi".

Veulay ki nitkavven bishela rishona "veamru" vegomer, sheyyegalle Adonai shemo vesodo asher yaase bo niflaot, ki shem hameforash yafli asot uveemtzauto yikne kol hakkinyanim, ben maalot hammurgashot ben maalot haosher vehachachma, veyashlim atzmo lihyot rauy linvua besod (tehillim 91:14) "asaggevehu ki yada shemi". gam yafli beenehem niflaot middarche hashshem. uvitshuvat Adonai elav efshar shello hodio sode hashshem usegullotav veniflaot asher yafli bahem, laze chazar vetaan "vehen" vegomer kemo shepperashti.

O efshar shello nitraggesh moshe liton taana zo "hen lo yaaminu", ella letzad sheamar Adonai lo davar chadash ma shello shama mikkodem, vehu amro "vaani yadati ki lo yitten etchem melech mitzrayim lahaloch velo beyad chazaka". amar, meatta mashkachat lah shello yachshiv paro shelichuto velo yeshallechem, im ken "hen lo yaaminu li", uchesheyyitrabbe hashshelichut velo yeshallach yosifu shello lishmoa bekoli, vehattaam ki yomru lo nira elecha vegomer, sheim hayu haddevarim meel elyon mi hu ze sheyyemaen laasot devarav velo yashchit lo mashtin bekir (Melachim 1 14:10), ella vadday ki lo Adonai shelachacha, vaafillu nevua lo hissagta.

rashi: Vattiftach vattirehu. et mi raata? et hayyeled, zehu peshuto. umidrasho (sham), sheraata immo shechina:
Vehinne naar boche. kolo kenaar (sham):
ohc: Vattirehu et hayyeled vegomer. tzarich ledakdek amro vattirehu vegomer, shehaya lo lomar vattere vegomer. venire shennitkavven lomar sheyyada shehatteva hi mehayyeladim hammushelachim hayeora, venitkavvena lehatztzilo, uchemo shepperashnu befasuk "vattishlach et amatah", vehu amro vattiftach vattirehu lehayyeled shennitkavvena lehatztzil, veim haya omer hakkatuv vattire yeled yihye hammashmaut ki raata ma shello chashva chen, vehaven.

Verazal darshu (sota 12:) "vattirehu" – raata shechina immo, vehu derech derash. vetzarich lomar shello hikkira hashshechina hi, ki minnayin yada hashshechina mibbet aviha vaavi aviha, ella sheraata immo or gadol, vaAdonai asa chen kede shettigdal maalat hayyeled beeneha. gam lattaam sheddarshu zichrono livracha (zohar 10 12:) bakkatuv "vehinne naar boche", sheramaz al yisrael shehayu bochim baggalut, laze vaygal Adonai et eneha lehareotah haor hassomech lemoshe.

Od efshar sheharegashatah bashshechina hayta letzad shekkeshennaga bo parcha mimmenna tzaraat (Shemot Rabba 1,23), amra: en ze ella ben elohi. veulay sheramaz perichat hatztzaraat beamro vattirehu et hayyeled, perush, vattirehu lehaamur besamuch bechoach, dichtiv "lirchotz" vezichron "besarah" bechoach, uchesheppatcha hatteva vattarehu livsarah et hayyeled, perush, keshennaga bayyeled, vehinne naar, perush, chazar lihyot kivsar naar katon, al derech ma sheamar hakkatuv benaaman (Melachim 2 5:14): "vayyashav besaro kivsar naar katon":

Vattachmol alav. lefi ma shepperashnu ki nitkavvena mittechilla uvarishona lehatztzil hayyeled, taam hachemla chadasha – lo lehatztzilo mehayeor, ella yaggid hakkatuv shebbiksha lahaniko, vehaed ma sheamar besamuch "vattomer achoto vegomer haelech vekarati" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (sota 12:) shehechzirattu al menikot goyot vechulei:

Vattomer miyyalde haivrim vegomer. kashe, ma chiddush omeret miyyalde haivrim ze? peshita shekken hu, ki hen henna hammashlichot yaldehen bayor bigzerat paro. veim lefi ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (sota 12,1) ki beoto yom gazar gam al hammitzriyyim, im ken minnayin yada vehikkira ki eno miyyalde mitzriyyim? vehinne lefi ma sheamru zichronam livracha ki hechezirattu al kamma menikot goyot velo ratza linok, ze lecha haot ki lo miyyalde hammitzriyyot, veal kol panim ma chiddush omeret bidvareha?

Velaamod al haddavar naskil al davar im hatztzalat hayyeled haya letzad shennistappeka heyoto mitzri o afillu yihye ivri. vehinne im nomar shechashva lehatztzil lisfek mitzri, techavven beamrah miyyalde haivrim ze ki nitbarer lah hefech ma shechashva, uvaze gilleta datah ki lo lehatztzil miyyalde haivrim nitkavvena, vedavar ze hassechel yivcharehu, ki setam goya lo terachem ella al bene ummatah, vahagam sheanu roim sheachare sheyyada ki miyyalde haivrim hu hechezika bo vesachra lo meneket, en mizze reaya, ki achar sheyyada maalato gam sherippe otah mitztzaratah richama alav, gam rauy hu mikkoach ze lehattot libbah leemunat yisrael ki hi raata ma nora maasav.

Veim nomar shemmittechilla richama al hayyeled, hagam sheyyada ki mibbene yisrael hu, techavven beamrah miyyalde haivrim netinat taam shello yanak mehannachriyyot, lo shehuchala mehayeor umesukkan hu veeno yachol linok, ella letzad shehu miyyalde haivrim, velaze techef amra lah achoto haelech vekarati lach vegomer mehaivriyyot lehavechin devareha, veamar hakkatuv vattikkach haishsha vegomer vattenikehu.

rashi: Ze shemi leolam. chaser vav, lomar, haalimehu – shello yikkare kichtavo (fesachim 50):
Veze zichri. limmedo heach nikra. vechen david hu omer, "Adonai shimcha leolam Adonai zichrecha ledor vador" (tehillim 135):
ohc: Vayyomer od vegomer ko tomar vegomer. taam shechazar lomar paam sheniyya shem havaya baruch hu velo hispik lo hodaat shem ehye, letzad ki shem havaya hu kolel kol habbechinot hakkedoshot, yachid umeyuchad baruch hu, umittechilla lo hizkir lo ella shem bechina achat mibbechinot hakkedoshot asher yitkanne bah Adonai bizman sheyyihye im yisrael betzara, uvizmanno dibber shehayu betzara laze hizkir shem ehye letzad davar beitto vehizkir shem hameyuchad.

Od taam shechazar lomar "ko tomar vegomer Adonai" vegomer, letzad shechash el elyon sheyyavin moshe sheshshalal Adonai middato lomar leyisrael shem havaya, gam shalal millomar ma sheamar besamuch "elohe vegomer shelachani" vegomer velo yomar ella "ehye shelachani" vegomer, laze chazar lomar ki yomar gam ken Adonai elohe avotechem vegomer. veere ki baamira zo ramaz gam ken shem ehye bitchillat shemot haavot: 1 deavraham ushene yudin, echad beyitzchak veechad beyaakov:

Od yechavven Adonai sheyyedu yisrael ki hu ze hammavtiach lehaavot havetachat haggeulla, ki shem ehye lo huva bakketuvim harishonim habbaim bahavetachot. gam letzad sheadayin yashmiem dibberot kadsho ufetach devaro yomar "anochi Adonai elohecha", laze hikdim lehodiam shem ehye veshem havaya. shem ehye haramuz beanochi, veshem havaya kifshuto, kede sheyyatzdiku divre moshe kesheyyedabber Adonai veyomar "anochi Adonai", vehaven. nimtzenu omrim ki tzarich moshe lomar leyisrael beseder ze "ehye shelachani alechem", uletzad shehu shem chadash lidiatam venikra al shem hammeora, perush, shehaya immam betzaratam, yachzor veyomar lahem Adonai elohe avotechem. veulay sheggam ramaz shalosh otiyyot harshumim bishmot avotam shehu shem ehye natuy al rashehem milmala.

rashi: Vayyishma paro. hem hilshinu alav (Shemot Rabba 1):
Vayvakkesh laharog et moshe. mesaro lakkusetinar lehargo velo shalta vo hacherev (sham), hu sheamar moshe "vayyatztzileni mecherev paro" (Shemot 18:4):
(Vayyeshev beeretz midyan. nitakkev sham; kemo: "vayyeshev yaakov" 0:)
Vayyeshev al habbeer. leshon yeshiva. lamad miyyaakov shennizdavveg lo ziuugo min habbeer (Shemot Rabba 1):
ohc: Et haddavar hazze. amar tevat hazze lomar sheshshama devarim habbaim besamuch, shehem divre harasha sheamar "halehargeni" vegomer, lo sheyyada beverur ki hu hahoreg lammitzri.

Vayvakkesh laharog vegomer. perush, bikkesh lehochiach haddavar im ken asa kede laharog oto, velaze barach moshe mippene faro shemma yitbarer haddavar veyahargennu. o yirtze beamro mippene faro ki hikkir befanav ki zeumim hem vehirgish mizze uvarach, hagam shello yada ki higgiu haddevarim lefaro.

rashi: Oved admato yisba lachem. kemashmao, ulefi meshalo: shechozer al talmudo tamid, shello yishtakkach:
targum: Defalach beareh yisba lachma uderadef batar serikuta chasar rayana hu:

rashi: Ulechohen midyan. rav shebbahen; ufarash lo meaza venidduhu meetzlam (sham):
Et harhatim. et berechot merutzot hammayim haasuyot baaretz:
Yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto. ma behemto uvene veto tzerichim:
targum: Yadea tzadika nafsha divireh verachamehon derashie nachzerayuta:

ohc: Vayyamat yosef vegomer uvene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ledakdek leeze inyan chazar paam sheniyya lehodia mitat yosef, uchevar hishmianu (Bereshit 50:26) "vayyamat yosef ben" vegomer? od tzarich ladaat kavvanat hodaat hakkatuv shemmetu haachim vechol haddor. od ma kesher yesh ben mitat haachim vehaddor leamro "uvene yisrael". vehinne hammaggid shel 355 higgid lo taam semichut ze vehu derech sod. od tzarich ladaat taam amro keseder ze "uvene yisrael" vegomer, sheim ba lehodienu periyyat ureviyyat bene yisrael haya lo lomar keseder ze "vayyifru vayyishretzu vegomer bene yisrael".

Achen shene ketuvim habbaim keechad lehodia hishtalshelut hatechalat hashshibud vesibbotav, vehem bemispar arbaa. ha – mitat yosef, sheim haya yosef kayyam yaspik shello yimshelu bahem hammitzriyyim, ha lamadta shekkol zeman sheyyosef kayyam hayu yisrael beeretz mitzrayim sheketim umeunnagim.

2 – Mitat haachim, shekkol zeman sheechad min haachim kayyam hayu hammitzriyyim mechabbedim otan, uchemo sheppershu zichronam livracha (sota 13,1) befasuk (Bereshit 50:14) "vayyashav yosef vegomer veechav" vegomer achar kavro et aviv, yeuyyan sham divrehem.

3 – Mitat kol haddor. perush: kol hashshivim nefesh, shekkullan hayu chashuvin beenehem, uveemtzautam lo haya lahem panim lehishtabed bahem. o letzad shehayu bene daat, veen metziut lammitzriyyim lehitchakkem chachmatam shemmatchil befe rach, ki hayu bene haddor hahu chachamim veyakkiru hachachma velo yekabbelu asot lahem davar beshum ofen.

4 – Uvene yisrael vegomer, ki im lo hayta hahargasha haggedola shepparu vayyishretzu vegomer bimod vegomer vattimmale haaretz" vegomer – lo hayu notnim lev levakkesh tachbulot, ella hahergesh haggadol hu hassovev beemtzaut heder hammonea shehu yosef veechav vechol haddor. uvaze nityashshev amro uvene yisrael velo amar "vayyifru" vegomer, ki lo ba lehodia inyan haribbuy ella lehodia ki hu ze sovev haggalut.

Veod vayyakam melech chadash vegomer, vezulat achat mikkol devarim hassedurim lo haya hashshibud, uleman deamar (sota 11,1) "chadash" shennitchaddeshu gezerotav, hassibbot hakkodmot hem sibbevuhu lechaddesh dato meshunna mikkodem, vehaven.

Vehinne lefi peshatan shel devarim yaggid ki kol od shehaya echad mehaddor hahu kayyam haya monea hashshibud, vekashe im ken lo haya lo lomar hakkatuv ella "vayyamat kol haddor hahu", sheafillu kol yeme echad mehaddor lo haya shibud, velo haya tzarich lomar lo mitat yosef velo mitat echav, dekal vachomer shello yihye hashshibud bimehem. vaafillu ledivrehem zichronam livracha (seder olam Rabba 3) sheamru kol zeman sheechad mehashshevatim kayyam lo haya hashshibud, kashe lamma hutzrach lehazekir mitat yosef, kal vachomer hu mehaachim.

Veulay ki yechavven hakkatuv lomar ki hayu hadderagot baddavar, ki bemitat yosef yardu miggedullatam shehayu meullim yoter mimmitzriyyim venaasu shavim lahem, uvemitat haachim yardu lematta mimmadregatam shehayu beenehem nivzim aval lo hayu mishtabedim bahem, uvemitat kol haddor hitchilu lehishtabed beemtzaut kinatam asher rau hafelagat ribbuyam shel yisrael shennitmallet eretz mitzrayim bahem.

Veim tomar, vahalo rabbotenu zichronam livracha lo amru ella kol zeman sheechad min hashshevatim vechulei, velidvarenu afillu min hashshivim. da ki davar ze lo huchlat lerabbotenu zichronam livracha, veze leshon rabbotenu zichronam livracha beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 3): mishshemmet levi ad sheyyatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim 116 shana, en shibud yater alav velo pachot mifv, kishnoteha shel miryam shennikrea al shem hammerur, ad kan. hare ki en hacheraat davar shemmishshemmet levi shehu acharon shebbashshevatim hitchil hashshibud. ufeshat hakkatuv ani roe shello amru "hava nitchakkema lo" ella achar mitat kol haddor hahu, vehishva hakkatuv lechol echav.

rashi: Vayyichar af. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer kol charon af shebbattora ose roshem veze lo neemar bo roshem velo matzinu shebba onesh ay oto charon; amar lo rabbi yose af bezo neemar bo roshem – halo aharon achicha hallevi – shehaya atid lihyot levi velo kohen, vehakkehunna hayiti omer latzet mimmecha, meatta lo yihye chen ella hu yihye kohen veatta hallevi, shenneemar "umoshe ish haelohim banav yikkaru al shevet hallevi" (20 23) (zevachim 102):
Hinne hu yotze likratecha. keshettelech lemitzrayim:
Veraacha vesamach belibbo. lo chesheatta savur, sheyyehe makpid alecha sheatta ole ligdulla; umishsham zacha aharon laadi hachoshen hannatun al hallev (shabbat 139):
ohc: Vayyichar af vegomer bemoshe. omer ani sheharoshem sheasa charon appo hu shennishar moshe kavua bo mum kevedut pe velashon, vehu amro bemoshe perush bo begufo, venachon. uderashat chachamim (zevachim kav,1) sheamru shehu amro "halo aharon" vegomer, en devarenu machchish otah. veulay ki shenehem ramaz hakkatuv, uremazam beamro vayyichar af shehaya lo lomar "vayyichar Adonai", umeamro "vayyichar af" ramaz lishne devarim.

Ki dabber yedabber. taam hakkefel lomar elav: dabber atta, yedabber – perush, hagam sheyyihye kevad pe velashon kemoto yedabber. o yirmoz devarenu atzmam shepperashnu befasuk "vayyichar af", vehu amro "dabber yedabber" – perush, amro "dabber" legufo, veamro "yedabber" lehasemich lah tevat "hu", lomar hu yihye dibburo tzach velo atta, ki tishshaer kemot sheatta.

Vegam hinne hu vegomer. lefi ma shepperesh beamro "dabber yedabber", ki yaggid shivcho shel aharon shehaya ose shelichuto hagam shehaya kevad pe, yutzdak lomar "vegam hinne" vegomer, ki hu tosefet shevach.

Ulefi ma shepperashti ki hechlit mimmoshe tikvat hasarat hakkevedut pe, yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet shabbat kalat, 1 veze leshonam: "bischar 'veraacha vesamach belibbo zacha lechoshen hammishpat al libbo" ad kan. kefi ze nitkavven beamro vegam ki millevad shehechlit mimmoshe refuat haddibbur kemo shekkatavnu, gam hesir mimmennu hakkehunna unetanah leaharon, vehu amro "vegam vegomer vesamach belibbo", kan ramaz hasarat hakkehunna, vehem divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha.

Od nitkavven lehaggid shivcho veanvetanuto, ki min harauy haya lo lehakepid al heyoto hu lefe veachiv hakkaton yigdal mimmennu, veamar ki millevad shello yakpid al haddavar ella "vegam vegomer vesamach". uveemtzaut devarim ellu yaggid ki hagam shehu anav, dabber yedabber, vahagam shehaya kevad pe, uchemo shepperesh shehaanava lo tigrom harechakat asot retzon hammelech. veamar vesamach belibbo, lomar hagam shello yarecha simcha lefanim, hu baruch hu haed sheyyismach belibbo. o yirtze shello lefanim bilvad ella lefanim uvallev.

rashi: Vattagga leraglav. hishlichattu lifne raglav shel moshe:
Vattomer. al benah:
Ki chatan damim atta li. atta hayita gorem lihyot hechatan shelli nirtzach alecha – horeg ishi atta li:

Vesamti mishpat lekav. lifne bo oto melech avi alechem gezerot lehatem happoshim shebbachem, vesamti mishpat yissurin lihyot lekav, kelomar: asim kav middat yissurin lehavi alechem, veet tzedaka asim shettehe mishkolet hameyashsheret binyan habbonin bachomot, kelomar: shettehe tzedaka mehallechet lifnehem umeyashsheret darchehem, sheyyichlu happoshim venotru hatztzaddikim:
Veyaa varad machse chazav. oto kissuy sheamartem ki samnu chazav machsenu, yavo varad vitatenu. veyaa leshon 'tiut, kemo "et hayyaim" (Melachim 1 7:40) sheggorfin bahen efer hakkirot:
Veseter, sheamartem alav uvashsheker nistarnu hammayim yishtefuhu, kelomar: avi hamon ummot sheyyishberu matztzevotechem ufesilechem. velashon mishpat haamur kan 426 109:
targum: Veeshave dina takin deitamartun kechut binyana uzechuta keeven mashkuleta veyidlak rugezi berochatzan kidvechon veal deitamartun min kodam meika yatchon ammaya yiglon:

rashi: Yafiach emuna yaggid tzedek. mi shemmedabber emuna maggid bedin edut tzedek lezakkot hazzakkay:
targum: Man demashed hemanuta nitne tzadikuta vesahed deshikra ramaa hu:

rashi: Karatnu verit et mavet. shello yavo alenu:
Asinu choze. gevul shello yaavrenhu, vechen "mechoz cheftzam" (tehillim 107:30), vechen "mecheza el mecheza" (Melachim 1 7:5), kullam leshon 'gevul hem vechitzono shel davar, 567 109:
Shot shotef. makka hammithallechet baaretz:
Lo yevoenu. lo yavo alenu:
Samnu chazav. samnu avoda zara:
Machsenu. machase shellanu:
Uvashsheker nistarnu. beavoda zara batachnu lehasetirenu:
targum: Are amartun gezarna keyam im ketola veim machbela avadna shelama mechat sana are tete alechon kenachal magbar deattun amrin la tete alana are shavena bichdiv rachatzanana uvegin shikrin itamarna:

rashi: Monea bar. melammed tora:
targum: Man dechale ibbura beuletzana nishbekuneh livel devavoy uvirketa teheve leina dimzabben:

rashi: Lo yikkon adam beresha. lo yitbasses:
targum: La nitkan bar nasha berisha veikarhon detzadike la nezua:

rashi: Vetochen levenim. cheshbon hallevenim; vechen "et hakkesef hametukkan" (Melachim 2 12) – hammanuy, kemo sheamur bainyan "vayyatzuru vayyimnu et hakkesef":

Yachbot Adonai. tirgem yonatan: "yitremon ketilin". vaani omer: shete leshonot hallalu, 'chibbut ulekita, noflin ze al ze, kechovet zetav vechozer umelakketan, vaacherim melakketin oto min haaretz. kach hakkadosh baruch hu yatchil haasifa, kemo shenneemar: yittaka beshofar gadol:
Mishshibbolet hannahar. hem haovdim beeretz ashshur:
Ad nachal mitzrayim. hem hanniddachim beeretz mitzrayim:
Hannahar. perat, hem bene ashshur hayyoshvim al perat:
Ad nachal mitzrayim. hem yoshve mitzrayim, yachbot otam kechovet zetim:
Veattem telukketu. min haggaluyyot:
Leachad echad. hammotze echad mikkem yeviehu mincha:
targum: Vihe beidana hahi yitremun ketilin kodam Adonai mikkef nahara perat ad nachala demitzrayim veattun titkarvun chad listar chad bene yisrael:

rashi: Besassea. beotah midda:
Beshalchah terivenna. kesheshshillecha mitzrayim et yisrael, terivenna hammidda bisa shellah:
Haga berucho hakkasha. 'haga dibber bedibburo hakkashe:
Beyom kadim. beyom "vayyolech Adonai et hayyam beruach kadim azza" (Shemot 14:21):
targum: Besata dahaveta cheel bah yechilun lach dahaveta shalach umeik lehon hage alehon vemila matkef alehon beyom levat:

rashi: Atzim. dochakim:
Devar yom beyomo. cheshbon shel kol yom kallu beyomo, kaasher asitem bihyot hatteven muchan:
Ucherakav. tolaat hannichnas toch haatzamot vetochen otam, ken ishsha mevisha veraa, shemmaaseha boshim:
targum: Itteta chesharta kelila levaalah veinteta bishta hech maltita bekaysa hechna mevda garmoy degavrah:

rashi: Ki metu kol haanashim. mi hem? datan vaaviram; chayyim hayu, ella sheyyardu minnichsehem veheani chashuv kammet:
ohc: El moshe bemidyan. kavvanat hakkatuv bahodaa ki haddibbur haya bemidyan, lehaggid shivcho shel moshe shello chash al sonav shehayu bemitzrayim beet shettaan taanotav harabbim, ki lo haya choshesh bechol taanotav ella letzad horaat koach hashshelichut lo letzarat atzmo, veharaya shello taan ki yare mimmevakshe nafsho. veim lo haya omer hakkatuv bemidyan, tavo hassevara ki lo hechlit bedato shel moshe lalechet bashshelichut ad shehuvtach mippi el ki metu mevakshe nafsho. laze amar bemidyan, lomar sheachar sheggamar bedato vehiskim im Adonai lalechet hu shennitbasser, velo haya davar ze meakkevo.

rashi: Ki chayot henna. bekiot kamyalledot, targum meyalledot chayyata. verabbotenu darshu hare hen meshulot kechayyot hassade (sota 11), sheenan tzerichot meyalledot. vehechan meshulot lechayyot? gur arye, zeev yitraf (Bereshit 49), bechor shoro (Devarim 33), ayyala shelucha (Bereshit 49), umi shello nichtav bo, hare hakkatuv kelalan vayvarech otam (sham), veod ketiv ma immecha leviyya (Yechezkel 19):
ohc: Ki lo channashim vegomer. tzarich ledakdek lamma heerich kol kach lashon, velo hispik lomar "lo chammitzriyyot haivriyyot" o "haivriyyot lo chammitzriyyot". od tzarich ledakdek ma maane befihem al sippuk hammazon, veroani ki kibbel paro teshuvatam. od kashe amro veyaladu shehaya tzarich lomar yoldot.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu sheheshivuhu shello yikkach shiur laivriyyot mehameyuchadot shebbammitzriyyot, ki chullan chachamot mikkol hammitzriyyot, vehu amro ki chayot henna umeyalledot zo lazo o enam tzerichin meyalledet.

Veulay sheramzu ki hannashim shel bene yisrael hayu bahem shete limmudiyyot behahaskala: haachat heyotam meikkaram ivriyyot, vehashsheniyya shehen atta mitzriyyot, uveemtzaut ze nitchakkemu shene mine hasekala. veze hu shiur hakkatuv "ki lo channashim" hargilot bannimtza hem ellu shehem mitzriyyot ivriyyot, uvaze lo tihye hochachat hassetira lo meivriyyot velo mimmitzriyyot ki ellu yesh bahem shete hadderagot, vehaven. veamro beterem vegomer nitkavvenu lehashiv im yomar velamma lo yihyu hem meyalledot otam beal karchan letzad shehem hammemunnot mehammelech, veamru "beterem" vegomer, perush, ki anu mitchakkemin lavo etzlam kodem sheyyaggia zeman halleda kefi cheshbonam leyalled otam, veaf al pi chen anu motzim otam shekkevar yaldu, ki hayyoldot hayu mitchakkemot leharechik lahem zeman ledatam ki hirgishu baddavar, vechol ze nichlal betevat "chayot". umeatta kefi hannacha zo parcha lah meatzmah hachashada, hagam sheyyaviu beyadam mayim umazon haya lechashvam sheadayin lo yaldu vehem baim leyalled otam, vechol ma sheyyaasu mehoraat chibba lahem adrabba kashshura vechahogen osin kede sheyyitkarvu hallevavot shel hayyoldot velo yihyu nechshadim beenehem keratzchaniyyot veyimtzeu makom lekayyem gezerat hammelech lehamit habbanim. veachar shehayu meviin lechashvan sheadayin lo yaldu kannizkar, vehayu motzim ki kevar yaldu, eno mehammusar lehashiv hammuva, uvaze safa tamma telunat vachashad paro hagam shetztzadku divre holche rachil sheamru shehameyalledot sippeku mazon.

rashi: Veatta lecha veeshlachacha el paro. veim tomar ma toil? vehotze et ammi. yoilu devarecha vetotziem mishsham:
ohc: Lecha veeshlachacha vegomer. taam shehutzrach lomar veeshlachacha lelo tzorech, ki min hassetam kesheyyomar lo "lecha" vadday ki hu hammeshallecho. gam hikdim hahalicha kodem hazekarat hashshelichut, lomar ki lo halicha zo levad hi hashshelichut, ella achar hahalicha tihye hatemadat hashshelichut, kemo shekken haya sheachar shehalach hu shehaya sholcho paam achar paam lehotzi vegomer.
Od ramaz lo ki lo bahalicha zo lechud yotzi bene yisrael, ella sheyyachzor shelichut achar shelichut, vehakkavvana baze ki atidot yashmiehu shello yitratztze paro leshallecham techef umiyyad.

Od yirtze al derech amram (makkot 10.) bederech sheadam rotze lelech bah molichin oto, laze amar elav lecha perush, im atta chafetz bemitzva zo lalechet az ani ashlim cheftzecha veeshlachacha, umizze atta lamed sheim hu yimas mehaloch lo yishlachennu.

Veulay ki laze haya moshe meshiv bitanot, kevan shello raa devar melech shilton, ella im yirtze haya megalle dato ki yesh lo teanot monot, vehaya Adonai meshivo al kol taana vetaana kede sheyyelech middato uretzono kaasher avaer besamuch.

Od yirtze al derech ma shepperashti befarashat vayyeshev bishlichut yaakov leyosef (Bereshit 37:13), perush "lecha", veim tachush lemikre ra "veeshlachacha", usheluche mitzva enan nizzokin, vehi sheamda lo badderech bammalon (Shemot 4:24) shello hemito hammalach.

"Asher eshma vegomer leshallach" vegomer. yechavven lomar: ma kocho haggadol lishmoa bekolo bedavar gadol kaze leshallach vechulei? vechazar lomar sheddevarav lirvuta neemru, hagam sheyyihye gadol ad meod lo yoil ze leshallach yisrael. veen kavvanato baze shehu yodo, ella sheeno gadol beenav leshallach yisrael, ella sheeno yodo kol ikkar, vehu amro "lo yadati" vegomer. veamro "vegam", perush, vahagam sheyyodiehu veyaskil ki gadol hu, af al pi chen "et yisrael lo" vegomer, vehem techillat devarav, vehaven.

rashi: Vayyakom melech chadash. rav ushemuel, chad amar chadash mammash, vechad amar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav:
Asher lo yada. asa atzmo keillu lo yedao (sota 11):
Lachen. gam atta bezot haya mitkapper avon yaakov lizkot lehiggael kemeaz:

Veze kol peri hattov lo lhasir chattato, im yasim kol avne mizbechot bamotav keavne gir menuppatzot medukkarot. vechen (tehillim 137:9) "venippetz et olalayich", vechen (Yirmeyahu 13:14) "venippatztim ish el achiv". gir min tzeva hu:
Lo yakumu asherim vechammanim. lemaan lo yakimu lahem avoda zara:
targum: Bechen beda yishtevekun chovay bet yaakov veden kol ovade astiut chovohi beshavyute kol avne egora keavna gir menaftzan la yitkaymun asheraya vechanisnesaya:

ohc: Veatta hinne tzaakat vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal haamur, shekkevar amar "veet tzaakatam" vegomer. od dikduk amro veatta. od amro hinne. od amro baa elay ki lo haya tzarich lomar "elay". od amro vegam raiti shekkevar amar ze lemala.
Venire ki modio Adonai lemoshe ki az beodo medabber immo baa tzaakat bene yisrael mechadash, velaze dikdek lomar veatta, vegam amar hinne kemare lomar hinne hu lefanay.

Veamar baa elay, letzad sheyyesh haderagot battefillot hammuggashot lifne hannetar: yesh mehem shemmeviin otam mesharte elyon umaggishim otam lefanav yitbarach, veyesh mehem shehem meullim sheyyesh bahem koach sheen tzerichin emtzai lehaggiam lifne habbore ella hem meatzmam niggashim lefanav. laze amar baa elay perush, belo emtzai.

Veamro vegam raiti et hallachatz, lefi divre hattanna (bahaggada shel pesach) sheamar ze haddochak, hu perat shello nirsham bedivre Adonai hakkodmim laze, hutzrach Adonai leamro. venitkavven beamro raiti lehagedil medurat chefetz happidyom, uchemo shepperesh bappasuk (Shemot 2:25) "vayyeda elohim". vehakkavvana behodaat kol ze lomar veatta lecha vegomer, perush techef umiyyad belo shum ikkuv, letzad haddochak asher hem nidchakim en lehametin shum zeman.

rashi: Sefat emet tikkon laad. titbasses utekayyem:
Vead argia. limat rega hu kale veholech, shehashsheker en lo raglayim:
targum: Sifta dekushta tittaken laalam vesahada mistarhev kelishna deshikra:

rashi: Teven. shtvblo, hayu govlin oto im hattit:
Levanim. 361 belaaz, sheosim mittit umeyabbeshin otan bachamma; veyesh shessorfin otan bakkivshan:
Kitmol shilshom. kaasher heyitem osim ad henna;
Vekoshshu. velaktu:
Ki tov hu. keshennolad nitmalle habbayit kullo ora (sota 12):
ohc: Ki tov hu vattitzpenehu vegomer. tzarich ledakdek ma hi hattoviyyut sheraata bo. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sota 12,1) amru nolad mahul vattimmale habbayit ora. veze derech derash. od tzarich ledakdek kesher "vattitzpenehu" im "vattere oto ki tov" vegomer, vechi im lo haya tov lo tachmol al peri bitnah litzpon oto meanshe damim?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu, ki mimma sheamar hakkatuv "vattitzpenehu" vegomer "velo yachla od" vegomer, amru zichronam livracha (sota 12,1) ki manu lah hammitzriyyim meet heryonah vehi yeladattu ben shishsha chodashim veyom echad. vehinne hayyoledet leshishsha peshita sheeno mitkayyem, vehayyoledet leshiva mitkayyem, vehinne en haishsha medakdeket bemispar yom echad, uchesheyyeladattu bechezkat nefel yeladattu. vehodia hakkatuv ki raathu tov, perush bari vechazak sheen bo simanim shel nefel, velaze tarcha bishvilo vesikkena atzmah mehammitzriyyim shehayu bodkim habbattim bakketannim kemaamaram zichronam livracha (sham), vehu amro vattere vegomer vattitzpenehu. uderashat razal tiddaresh mimma shellakach lashon ze ki tov velo amar lashon acher. vechavvanat razal sheddarshu tov hu mahul, kevar gillu datam bemakom acher (sanhedrin lach,2) ki adam harishon kodem shechata haya tov muchlat, uvemaase hara sheasa mashach haarla mibbechinat hara, velaze kesheamar hakkatuv "ki tov" hare ze mare baetzba ki meshullal mehekker ra shehi haarla.

rashi: Haovdim beeretz ashshur. lefi shennafotzu beeretz rechoka, lifnim min hannahar sambatyon keraam 'ovdim (Bereshit Rabba 73 5):
targum: Vihe beidana hahi yitka beshofara rabba veyetun di gelo leara deattur udeitaltalu leara demitzrayim veyisgedun kodam Adonai betura dekudesha birushelem:

rashi: Vayhi vayyamim harabbim hahem. shehaya moshe gar bemidyan, vayyamot melech mitzrayim, vehutzrechu yisrael litshua, umoshe haya raa (Shemot 3:1), uvat teshua al yado, lechach nismechu parashiyyot hallalu:
Vayyamot melech mitzrayim. nitztara vehaya shochet tinokot yisrael verochetz bedamam (Shemot Rabba 1):
ohc: Min haavoda. perush, lo shetztzaaku lael sheyyoshiem, ella tzaaku min hatztzaar keadam hatztzoek mikkeevo. umodia hakkatuv ki otah tzeaka alta lifne Adonai, vehu amro shavatam vegomer min haavoda, perush mitztzaar haavoda. vayyishma Adonai et naakatam (Shemot 2:24), perush, haramat kol keevam.

Od yirtze al derech amro (tehillim 118:5) "min hammetzar karati yah anani vammerchav yah", ki achat mehattefillot hammitkabbelot hi tefilla shemmittoch tzara, vechen hu omer (Yona 2:3) "karati mitztzara", vehu amro vattaal shavatam vegomer min haavoda, perush, letzad shehayta mitztzarat haavoda. uchefi ze shava zo hi tefilla vetzaakat keev hatztzara, hinne hi remuza beamro "min haavoda vayyizaku". uvaze yeduyyak al nachon taam sheshshinna hakkatuv leshono shehitchil lomar "vayyizaku vattaal shavatam" vegomer, shehaya lo lomar "vattaal zaakatam" vegomer, ella nitkavven lomar shehem zaaku mehatztzara vegam shivveu laAdonai, keamro "vattaal shavatam". uchefi ze shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: "vattaal shavatam" sheshshivveu lelohim min haavoda.
Od ulay amro min haavoda yirtze, shello higgia hashshava lifne Adonai al yede emtzai, ella beyosher alta min haavoda el haelohim, shello al yede baal kenafayim yagged davar (Kohelet 10:20).

rashi: Min haivriyyot. shehechezirattu al mitzriyyot harebe linok velo yanak, lefi shehaya atid ledabber im hashshechina (sham):

Vayyikkach et bat levi. parush haya mimmenna mippene gezerat paro, vehechezirah veasa vah likkuchin sheniyyim, veaf hi nehefcha lihyot naara; uvat 130 shana hayta, shennolda bevoam lemitzrayim ben hachomot, umatayim vaeser nishtahu sham, uchesheyyatzu haya moshe ben shemonim shana, im ken keshennitabbera mimmennu hayta bat mea usheloshim vekore otah bat levi (80 sota 12, bava batra 119 ushemot Rabba):
Belaage safa. vechen kol leshon leagim, vechen (Yeshayahu 32:4) "illegim", shenehem leshon hafuch sheeno meyushshar lehishshama:
Yedabber el haam hazze. kol hamedabber alehem devar nevua vetochacha, dome lahem lelashon nilag, sheen yecholin lehavin bo:
targum: Are beshinuy mamlel uvelishan tolava havo maligin lekavel neviyaya demitnabban lehon ama haden:

rashi: Vayyashov el yeter chotno. littol reshut, shehare nishba lo (nedarim 65). vez shemot hayu lo, reuel, yeter, yitro, keni, chovav, chever, putiel:
ohc: Elcha na. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1,29) sheamru shemmushba haya leyitro, hutzrach lechallot panav limchol lo al hashshevua.
Veere haodam chayyim. velo gilla lo devar hashshelichut, ki lo amar lo Adonai lemor, veamru betorat kohanim (yoma 4,1) shekkol shello amar lo lemor hare hu beval tomar.
Lech leshalom. perush, machal lo hashshevua, vechol kayyotze baze eno tzarich hattara, ella kol shemmochel hammashbia en kan shevua.

rashi: Beyalledchen. kemo beholidchen:
Al haovnayim. moshav haishsha hayyoledet, bemakom acher (Yeshayahu 37), koro mashber; vechamohu "ose melacha al haavnayim" (Yirmeyahu 18), – moshav keli ummanut yotzer cheres:
Im ben hiv vegomer. lo haya makpid ella al hazzecharim, sheamru lo itztagninav sheatid lehivvaled ben hammoshia otam:
Vachaya. vetichye:
ohc: Vayyomer vegomer ureiten al vegomer. tzarich ledakdek leeze inyan reiyya zo, velo haya lo lomar ella "im ben" vegomer, uma gam ledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sota 11:) sheamru siman masar lahem – ben panav lematta, bat paneha lemala, lo yadati lamma hutzrach lesimanim ellu. od tzarich ledakdek tamo lamma lo gazar al hakkol, veen lehaamin alav ki bemiddat rachamim nahag lasum lahem sheerit baaretz, ki sharsho shoresh achzari hiv. od kashe amro vahamitten oto betosefet vav mibbeli maase kodem laddavar. od lamma hutzrach lomar veim bat hi vachaya, kevan shepparo lo gazar ella al hazzecharim, peshita shello yevakkeshu hameyalledot laakor et hakkol.

Achen rasha ze nitchakkem kede shettaale beyado haetza, ki mi zot haishsha asher tazmin atzmah limyalledet laharog baneha, laze nitchakkem veamar lahen sheyyitnahagu beseder ze veyaasu behelem davar velo yargishu hayyoldot al ze hadderech, ki kodem sheyyivvada hannolad ma hiv im ben im bat yiru hameyalledot al haavnayim im ben hiv yemituhu veyomru nolad met, velo yannichu ad sheyyetze veavve (tzoek; raa sota 12,1) ella sheyyiru al haavnayim kodem sheyyetze laolam im ben hiv, uminnayin yedu, laze amru zichronam livracha siman masar lahem, velaze amar "vahamitten" betosefet vav, ki mitzva rishona tzivva otan lehavechin ladaat im ben hiv kodem sheyyetze laolam veyitten kolo, vehashsheniyya "vahamitten oto" betzeto mibbeten immo.

Veamro veim bat hi vegomer, nitkavven gam ken baze kede shebbeemtzaut inyan ze lo yargishu baddavar hannashim hayyoldot, kesheyyiru shellifamim valdotehen mitkayyemin lo yachshedu bamyalledot, vehem lo yavchinu ki horgot hazzecharim velo hannekevot. veulay shetztzivva alehem leval yodiu hazzachar ella yomru shehannolad nolad met, shebbeemtzaut ken yustar hachashad, uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim.

Vehinne etza chachama yaatz paro bedavar ze leval yuchelu alot mehaaretz, vehu ki beemtzaut sheyyahargu kol zachar veyitrabbu hannashim, vehen haishsha tav lemetav tan du, veyitchabberu neshe yisrael im hammitzriyyim veyitchattenu bahem, umeatta en metziut laalot min haaretz kesheyyihyu leam echad. gam yafgimu hannefashot hakkedoshot beirbuv hannefashot hattemeot veyihyu sham ad olam, bar minnan. vetimtza sheamru razal (Vayikra Rabba 32,5) shello nigalu yisrael ad shehayu bahem arbaa devarim, veechad mehem sheshshamru atzmam min haarayot, veal ze meforash bakkabbala (Shir HaShirim 4:12) "gan naul" vegomer, veim hayu mitchattenim im hammitzriyyim lo hayta bar minnan tekuma lesonehem.

rashi: Vayyukku shotre bene yisrael. hashshotrim yisreelim hayu vechasim al chavrehem milledachkam, ucheshehayu mashlimim hallevenim lannogsim shehem mitzriyyim, vehaya chaser min hassechum, hayu malkin otam al shello dachaku et ose hammelacha; lefichach zachu otam shotrim lihyot sanhedrin veneetzal min haruach asher al moshe vehusam alehem, shenneemar: "esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael vegomer" – meotan sheyyadata hattova sheasu bemitzrayim – ki hem zikne haam veshotrav (Bamidbar 11), (Shemot Rabba):

Vayyukku shotre bene yisrael asher samu nogse faro otam leshotrim alehem, lemor maddua vegomer. lamma vayyukku? shehayu omrim lahem maddua lo chillitem gam temol gam hayyom chok hakkatzuv alechem lilbon kitmol hashshelishi, shehu yom shellifne etmol; vehu haya bihyot hatteven nittan lahem:
Vayyukku. leshon vayyufalu, hukku miyyad acherim – hannogsim hikkum:
Helichi. nitnabbea velo yada ma nitnabbea – he shellichi:
Mi anochi. ma ani chashuv ledabber im hammelachim?
Vechi otzi et bene yisrael. veaf im chashuv ani, ma zachu yisrael sheyyease lahem nes veotziem mimmitzrayim?:
ohc: Mi anochi ki elech vegomer. perush, afillu bishlichut sheenah hefech retzono, ki eni chashuv ledabber lifne melech, umeemtzaut ken lo yeamen bishlichuto veyistakken, shehaadam baal bechira veratzon. vetze ulemad mimmaamar shemuel (Shmuel 1 16:2) "ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani", vetimtza shello yeamen adam binvua letzad bechinat hashshiflut, kaamur binvuat amos (Kohelet Rabba 1 1 2) shehayu mezalzelin bo bene doro vechulei. veod ki otzi vegomer, ki laze tzarich adam gadol bemaasim sheyyizke lizchut gadol kaze, vechash shemma yeera takkala leyisrael beemtzaut meniat zechuto, veze mehaanava vehashshiflut.

rashi: Vayyeda elohim. natan alehem lev velo heelim enav:
ohc: Vayyar vegomer vayyeda vegomer. perush, achar shetztzaaku vealta tzaakatam zachar Adonai berit haavot, veze haya sibba lifnot lahem velirot otam, ki reiyyat Adonai bammitztaer toil lahasarat hatztzaar, ki hu rachman male rachamim verachamav al kol maasav, vehu amro "vayyeda" vegomer belaaz 102. vetimtza ki beet kaaso yastir panav, vehu amro (Devarim 31:18) "veanochi haseter astir" vegomer. od yirtze beamro vayyeda devarim nistarim shehereu.

rashi: Hera. leshon hifil hu – hirba raa alehem, vetargumo "avish":
ohc: Ledabber bishmecha vegomer vehatztzel vegomer. perush, millevad taanot harishonim, od hu kovel lifne melech ech yihye haddavar hazze, ki meaz dibbarti larasha ze bishmecha lo day shello asa ella hosif lehara. vedikdek lomar meaz, perush, mishshaa atzmah shehizkir lo shemo yitbarach nitmalle chema, ki baze yukkar haddavar ki ma sheasa hu missinato et Adonai umimmiut erko beenav nitkavven lezalzel chas veshalom, veen lecha merim yad bammelech venogea bichvodo kaze. venitkavven moshe baze lomar, ki ech lo nitkanna el elyon lichvod shemo lehatztzil leyisrael miyyado lemano mehara leammo techef umiyyad, hagam shello yihyu reuyim yisrael lenes mitztzad atzman – yihyu reuyim lemaan shemo yitbarach asher chillel rasha begova libbo, vehu amro vehatztzel lo hitztzalta bitmiha, ech lo hitztzalta otam lemaan menaetz shemecha. vechafal lomar shete hatztzalot, lirmoz ki belo taam ze hem omdim lehatztzala velaze shelacho.

rashi: Vechaasher yeannu oto. bechol ma shehem notnin lev leannot, ken lev hakkabba leharebot ulehafritz:
Ken yirbe. ken rava vechen paratz. umidrasho, ruach hakkodesh omeret ken, attem omrim pen yirbe vaani omer ken yirbe (sota 11):
Vayyakutzu. katzu vechayyehem. verabbotenu darshu kekotzim hayu beenehem (sham):
ohc: Vechaasher yeannu oto ken yirbe vegomer. ma yeerav neimut hakkatuv al pi ma shekkatav bazzohar (chelek 2 95:) befasuk (Kohelet 8:9) "et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo", ki beemtzaut hainnuy vehatztzarot titbarer bechinat hattov mehara vetissamech el chelek hattov, vetitbarer bechinat hara mechelek hattov vetissamech el bechinat hara, ushene peratim ellu remuzim beamro "lera lo". vehu atzmo sheamar hakkatuv "vechaasher yeannu oto ken" – keshiur hainnuy hayu motziim umevarrim chelek hattov umitrabbe chelek hattov "vechen yifrotz". o yirmoz vechen yifrotz shehaya nifratz mimmennu chelek hara shehaya davuk bo, vehu hatztzeruf asher tzeraf Adonai otam bechur habbarzel bemitzrayim.

Uchefi peshat hakkatuv yirtze, ki keshehayu hammitzrim marbim leannot, haya Adonai marbe et yisrael kede sheyyihyu neezarim al haavoda vehaya noten bahem koach, vehu amro ken yirbe leshiur asher yaspiku haovdim baavoda, vegam Adonai noten bahem koach leshiur asher yitmaet mikkocham mehainnuy. uchesherau hammitzrim ken, hayu maavidim otam befarech, ketargumo bekashyu.

rashi: Ki kol shulchanot. shellahem, shel zivche metim hem, shehem kki tzoa:
Beli makom. en haddaat sovaltan:
targum: Are chol patorehon melan mechal migal umeshaketz let lehon atar di naki min onas:

ohc: Maddua vegomer vattechayyena vegomer. tzarich ledakdek ma hu hammaase sheasu, shealav hu omer maddua asiten, veim shello hemitu et hayeladim, ze yikkare shelilat hammaase vehaya tzarich lomar maddua lo asiten. od tzarich ledakdek amro vattechayyena, veim al sippuk hammazon layyeladim hu omer kemo shepperashnu beamro "vattirena hameyalledot vegomer vattechayyena" vegomer, im laze nitkavven ma maane bilshon hameyalledot al ze, vahare hen mordot bammelech.

Veulay ki lo yada paro beferush shehayu mesappekot mazon layyeladim, ki min hassetam lo yaasu chen bifne hammitzriyyim, velivne yisrael en lachshod bahem delatorin, keamram zichronam livracha (vayyikra Rabba 32,5) befasuk "veshaala ishsha" vegomer, ki shenem asar chodashim haya benehem davar ze velo gilla adam meolam. ella shehammitzriyyim higgidu lo shehayu hameyalledot mesappekot mayim umazon levet hannashim chayot, vedavar ze yecholin haggoyim hashshechenim lehakkir baddavar keshettachnis hameyalledet immah divre sippuk, veyadu gam ken ki hannashim hechayot hayu benehem zecharim. laze amar paro maddua asiten et haddavar hazze, perush sippuk mayim umazon shehu maase hannigle. vehen emet im lo hayu mechayyim hayyeladim hayiti tole ki labbanot attem mesappekim, ella kevan shehassippuk hu limkom hayyeladim vehayyeladim hinnam bachayyim, ze lecha haot ki lahem attem mesappekim. vehu amro vattechayyena et hayeladim, veen ze ella meiyyun sichli kannizkar, ki hayyadua lo beverur eno ella maase hassippuk levet hayyoldot.

rashi: Ehye asher ehye. ehye immam betzara zo asher ehye immam beshibud shear malchuyyot. amar lefanav, ribbono shel olam, ma ani mazkir lahem tzara acheret? dayyam betzara zo, amar lo yafe amarta, ko tomar vegomer (berachot 9):
ohc: Vayyomer ehye vegomer. perush, hodio midda shebbah medabber immo, veshem ze yityaches lemiddat harachamim vaasher hi bechinat hammotzi meavdut lecherut, vetze ulemad ma sheamru besefer hattikkunim (tikun 30) sod chamishshim peamim shennizkera yetziat mitzrayim battora, vegam hu taam shellaku hammitzriyyim chamishshim makkot keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 85). veshem ze kevar ramzo el elyon benoam devarav beamro lo "ki ehye immach". veulay ki laze samach veamar veze lecha haot ki anochi shelachticha, perush, bechinat "anochi", vehu shehizkir Adonai behar sinay petach devarav "anochi vegomer asher hotzeticha" vegomer, ella shemmoshe lo hevin amkan shel devarim ki Adonai yada ki yavo moshe lishol al haddavar venatan omer hamevasser tzava rav bechina hamedabberet vesodah.

Veulay ki moshe hiskil vehevin, ella sheshshoel im yazkir shem ze leyisrael. veamro asher ehye hu taam hashshem shennikra ken letzad sheyyihye im yisrael betzaratam, kemo sheamru zichronam livracha (chagiga 12,1) taam shem shadday – sheamar leolamo day, taam tzevaot – shehu ot bitzvao (chagiga 16,1), taam shem havaya – letzad shehaya vehove veyihye (zohar 11 297,1), kemo chen ehye – letzad sheyyihye, vehu amro asher ehye vechan hodio lemoshe sod hashshem haggadol. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot 9,1) darshu ehye immam betzara zo asher ehye immam betzara acheret. gam yesh baze sod shelosha ketarim, vehammaskil yavin:

Vayyomer ko tomar vegomer. perush, hagam sheggilla el moshe avdo sod hashshem kemo sheamar "asher ehye", chazar lomar sheeno baamur ella hazekarat hashshem, vehu gam ken amro ehye shelachani alechem, aval ma shehosafti legallot lecha "asher ehye" hu beval tomar.

Verazal amru (berachot 9,1) shehechzir moshe lekono betaanat "dayyah letzara bishatah", vehitztzatzti veraiti ki devar chachma vetzedek dibberu mikkoach hakkatuv atzmo, ki im sof dibbur kitchillat dibbur velo hayta chazara middibbur rishon ella sheggomer devarav linvio neeman bayit – lo haya lo lomar "vayyomer" beemtza dibbur rishon, laze amru ki hashshem baruch hu beamro "ehye asher ehye" gamar omer hainyan, uletzad sibba chazar lomar amira acheret. vehammaskil yavin hahefresh shebben dibbur rishon ledibbur sheni vehamedabber elav, veyeda hammenia vehammonea.

Veim tomar, ech mittechilla lo chash Adonai al haddavar ad shehutzrach moshe lomar lefanav vechulei? hinne bema shennedakdek devarav yitbarach teda ki yodea taalumot chachma hiskil al davar, vehu shehaya tzarich lomar bitchillat devarav ko tomar livne yisrael, letzad shetteshuva zo ba al taanat moshe "veamru li ma shemo", haya tzarich lahashivo "ko tomar". ella letzad sheyyada ki lo yaamod haddavar hazze ken bema sheyyiton moshe kemo shettaan achar kach, dayyah letzara, laze kede shello yetzu devarav levattala lo amar "ko tomar", veamar devarav shekulim sheyyesh bemashmautam shehakkol hu teshuvat "ma omar alehem". ucheshebba moshe vetaan, amar ki lo yomar ella "ehye", uma sheamar "asher ehye" hu hodaa lemoshe, gam hodaa ledorot kede sheyyitmechu libbam birot ki shochen sene yihye im yisrael bechol tzaratam. veim haya mefaresh devarav mittechilla veomer "ko tomar vegomer ehye shelachani alechem", hayta nederet yedia zo miyyisrael, beofen ki techillat hammachshava hayta sof haddibbur. ella moshe chaser meat meelohim, veulay sheyyada vehivchin ella shello samach al iyyuno veratza sheyyegalle lo Adonai dato beferush.

rashi: Kevikkurah beterem kayitz. kevishshulah shel teenat tzitz novel:
Beterem kayitz. et bishshul shear hatteenim, asher mittoch shehi bechura kofetz aleha uvolah beodah bechappo, kach "vayyishkod al haraa vayvieha alenu" (Daniel 9:14):
targum: Vihe deyahiv mitznafta lerashiaya devet makdesha tushebachte di al resh chela shemena kevikkura ad la kayta deim yecheze dechaze yatah keilu hi bide yevalinah:

rashi: Vayhi lenachash. ramaz lo shessipper lashon hara al yisrael vetafas ummanuto shel nachash (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vayhi lenachash vegomer. kavvanat ot ze hu lirmoz ki bechinat hakkelippa tityaches lenachash, vetze ulemad minnachash hakkadmoni ki hu bechinat 100, veramaz lo ki beemtzaut yede moshe bechocho heatzum meabbed koach hannachash veyihye leetz yavesh, uchesheyyarpe yado mimmennu umashlicho yihye lenachash ad shennas moshe mippanav. veulay ki laze nitkavven beamro ma ze veyadecha, perush sheyyaskil hasekala dakka bo im hitchil lehitnoea keachbera dedavra sheyyatchil lichyot meat meat, velifamim yimmatze miut miuto achbar velifamim miuto velifamim chetzyo, veheshiv moshe matte perush, kullo etz yavesh; vayyashlichehu artza vayhi lenachash, perush havaya, befaam achat haya nachash.
Veamro artza, ramaz ki beerech hannachash tigdal maalat haaretz, ki hu lachmo venechshevet lo (Bereshit 3:14), veherahu baze devarim rabbim lemoshe, gam sheyyaase haot atzmo leyisrael.
Veamro shelach yadcha vegomer, perush, herahu shehagam sheyyatza mershuto, yesh koach bemoshe lehitchazzek alav ulehasir mimmennu kocho.

Veamro veechoz biznavo velo amar "bo", nitkavven Adonai lomar elav, leheyot shechashashat hannachash hi im yikkachehu mizzenavo, ki im yitchakkem lakachat rosho veyidchok hannoshech en mechush mikkol hazzanav, laze amar elav Adonai echoz afillu biznavo been pachad. vechen hu omer vayyachazek bo perush bammakom shennizdammen lo been pachad, vehaya lematte bilkichato bechappo, perush bingiato bechaf moshe yavash kocho keachat velo notar bo shum chayyut, vehu amro "vayhi lematte bechappo".

rashi: Hava nitchakkema. kol hava leshon hachana vehazemana ledavar hu, kelomar, hazeminu atzmechem lechach:
Nitchakkema lo. laam; nitchakkema ma laasot lo. verabbotenu darshu nitchakkem lemoshian shel yisrael ledunam bammayim, shekkevar nishba shello yavi mabbul laolam (sham):
Veala min haaretz. al karchenu. verabbotenu darshu keadam shemmekallel atzmo vetole killato baacherim (sham), vahare hu keillu chatav vealinu min haaretz – vehem yirashuha:
Nefesh beracha. shehu vatran bemamono. vechol leshon beracha – pishon belaaz:
Umarve. shemmasbia et haaniyyim:
Gam hu yore. yisba tov:
targum: Nafsha devirketa tidhan uman dimalef af hu yelif:

rashi: Et zikne yisrael. meyuchadim lishiva. veim tomar zekenim setam, heach efshar lo leesof zekenim shel shishshim ribbo? (yoma 28)
ohc: Lech veasafta vegomer. taam kefel haddevarim paam sheniyya, nire sheyyechavven Adonai lomar ki beet biato lemitzrayim battechilla uvarishona yomar lechol ish yisrael ki hu ba shaliach meAdonai leyisrael, veachar kach yekabbetz kol zikne yisrael yachad veyomar lahem shelichuto yitbarach ki fakad et ammo vegomer.

Vetaam kedimat hodaat lakkol ki ish shaluach hu lahem meAdonai, kede shebbeemtzaut ken yitkabbetzu elav, ki zulat ze mi yatte elav ozen lehitkabbetz. gam nitchakkem Adonai lehodio devarim sheyyomar lechol ish veish miyyisrael udevarim asher yomar baasifat zekenim, vetaam hazzekenim levad, letzad hakkavod, keamram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 11,8) lo makom echad vechulei:

Pakod pakadti. amar shete pekidot keneged pekidat ketz haggeula ucheneged pekidatam mitztzaratam, vehu amro etchem keneged ketz haggeula, veet heasuy lachem keneged tzaratam bemitzrayim kede ligol otam mehatztzara ulehaalotam el haaretz asher nishba. veramaz lahem ki zulat heasuy lahem bemitzrayim shehu hallachatz vegomer odennu zeman hakketz. gam ramaz beamro heasuy ki ba lippara mehammitzriyyim et asher kevar asu lahem.

rashi: Umiggarat betah. meotah shehi gara ittah babbayit:

Venitztzaltem. ketargumo "uterokinun", vechen "vayyenatztzelu et mitzrayim" (Shemot 12), "vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael et edyam" (sham 33), vehannun bo yesod; umenachem chibbero bemachberet tzadi im "vayyatztzel elohim et mikne avichem", "asher hitztzil elohim meavinu" (Bereshit 31), velo yeamnu devarav, ki im lo hayta hannun yesod vehi nekuda vechirik, lo tehe meshammeshet bilshon ufealtem ella bilshon venifaltem, kemo "venissachtem meal haadama" (Devarim 28), "venittattem beyad oyev", veniggaftem lifne oyvechem (Vayikra 26), "venittachtem betochah" (Yechezkel 22), "vaamartem nitztzalnu" (Yirmeyahu 7), leshon nifalnu, vechol nun shehi vaa beteva lifrakim venofelet mimmenna – kenun shel nogef, nose, noten, noshech – keshehi medabberet leshon ufealtem tinnaked bachataf, kegon "unesatem et avichem" (Bereshit 45), "unetattem lahem et eretz haggilad" (Bamidbar 32), "unemaltem et besar arlatchem" (Bereshit 17), lechach ani omer shezzot hannekuda bechirik min hayesod hi, visod shem davar nitztzul, vehu min halleshonot hakkevedim, kemo dibbur, kippur, limmud, kesheyyedabber bilshon ufealtem, yinnaked bechirik kemo "vedibbartem el hassela" (Bamidbar 20), "vechippartem et habbayit" (Yechezkel 45), "velimmadtem otam et benechem" (Devarim 11):
ohc: Venitztzaltem vegomer. kan ramaz hetter hatztzalat adam mamono meannas. o yirmoz shebbaze yesovvu lemitzrayim laredet bimtzulot yam, ki beemtzaut shete hametzaot sheyyedabberu lalechet derech sheloshet yamim, gam kesheyyishalu mehem kelehem, ze yesovev otam lirdof acharehem veyerdu bammetzulot:

rashi: Vayhi moshe vadderech bammalon:

Vayvakkesh hamito. (hammalach 30)moshe: lefi shello mal et eliezer beno, veal shennitrashshel neenash mita. tanya amar rabbi yose: chas veshalom, lo nitrashshel ella amar, amul veetze ladderech, sakkana hi lattinok ad sheloshet yamim, amul veeshhe 3 yamim, hakkabba tzivvani lech shuv mitzrayim umippene ma neenash? lefi shennitassek bammalon techilla (mechilta). bemassechet nedarim: vehaya hammalach naase kemin nachash uvolo merosho vead yerechav vechozer uvolo meraglav vead oto makom, hevina tzippora shebbishvil hammila hu (nedarim 32):
ohc: Vayvakkesh hamito. amar vayvakkesh, ulay ki letzad shehaya sheliach mitzva haya lo monea, al derech amram zichronam livracha (fesachim 8:) sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin, vehammitzva shehaya asuk bah kana lo bah peraklit echad, vehu hammelavvehu vehashshomer oto umenao lammashchit bal kerov elav. veulay ki laze nitkavven beamro vadderech bammalon, lomar shello haya osek bahalichat hammitzva ella bammalon, velaze hu shebbikkesh hamito. veaf al pi chen haya lo monea, ki sof kol sof chashuv kishluche mitzva gam bazzeman hahu, uvene bene ki hammalachim noadu yachdav nitchakkema tzippora veherima michshol, aval beodo asuk bammitzva peshita ki lo yikrav elav mashchit.

rashi: Evil bayyom yivvada kaso. beyom shehu koes, bo bayyom hodia kaso, shehu mitgare umecharef chavero barabbim, veen matzar lerucho. aval hearum kose kalon veeno memaher lariv. umidrash aggada: beyom shennivra adam harishon noda surechano (avoda zara 8.), vehakkadosh baruch hu, shehu arum, lo ratza leshachet beriyyotav, kissa kelono (chagiga 12.) vedacha ligzerato miyyom shel adam leyom shello, shehu elef shana (tehillim 90:4; Bamidbar Rabba 14:12):
targum: Shatya kad yomeh moda rugezeh vaarim mechase tzaareh:

rashi: Al hachamor. chamor hameyuchad, hu hachamor shechavash avraham laakedat yitzchak, vehu sheatid melech hammashiach lehiggalot alav, shenneemar "ani verochev al chamor" (Zecharya 9) (pirki derabbi eliezer 31):
Vayyashov artza mitzrayim, vayyikkach moshe et matte. en mukdam umeuchar medukdakim bammikra:

targum: Dimsabber beutereh hu nafel veech tarfa tzadike mafrechin:
Man derachem marduta rachem yediata vesane machsanuta bura hu:
Beriglin yittedash kitra degevtana tippesha rabba deyisrael:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Archeh desachla teritza beappoy udeshamea leetzta chakkima hu:
Machshevathon detzadike dina madberanuta derashie ramayuta:

bart: Vered chadash shekkevasho beshemen yashan. vered shel sheviit shekkevasho beshemen shel shishshit, yilkot et havvered kodem sheyyaggia zeman habbiur vehakkol muttar. aval vered shel sheviit shekkevasho beshemen shel sheminit uchevar higgia zeman habbiur shel havvered, chayyav levaer et hakkol, kidkatane sefa dishviit oseret min besheeno mino benoten taam:

Vecharuvin chadashim vechulei. hacha mayre beva lishtot hayyayin achar zeman habbiur, divchol inyan chayyav levaer. veim lo nishtahu hecharuvim bayyayin ad zeman habbiur yilkot hecharuvin vehayyayin muttar kemo bevered, vehachi tanya behedya battosefta:
Ze hakkelal vechulei. bechol issurim shebbattora mayre, divchullan bemino bemashshehu umin besheeno mino benoten taam. veenah halacha:

Hashsheviit oseret bechol shehu beminah. leachar habbiur, aval kodem habbiur en bahem kedushshat sheviit sheyyehe asur lehafesidah velaasot bahem sechora ad sheyyehe vahem benoten taam, ben beminah ben shello veminah:
Veshello veminah. afillu leachar habbiur benoten taam:
Litzfono shel mizbeach. detamid ola hu, veola teuna tzafon:
Shemona ammudim. ammudim shel even nemuchim:
Ureviit shel erez. chatichot merubbaot shel erez hayu al haammudim:
Unkelayot. keen vavim. 521 belaaz: hayu kevuim. beotan reviiyyot shel erez, vetolin bahen habbehema:
Ushelosha sedarim. shel unkelayot zo lemala mizzo haya vechol chatichat etz, litlot behema gedola o ketanna:

Al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim. shealehem medichin hakkeravayim. vehaya efshar laasotan shel zahav, sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut, velo asaum ella shel shayish lefi shehazzahav martiach umasriach, vehashshayish mekarer umetzannen umaamido shello yasriach:

Maaracha gedola. lefi sheyyesh od maaracha acheret, kare lehach maaracha gedola. shalosh maarachot hayu sham bechol yom, achat maaracha gedola shessorfim aleha hattamid, vehashshenit maaracha fechuta mimmenna vehi keruya maaracha shel ketoret, shennotlim mimmenna gechalim bammachta lakketoret shemmaktirim babboker uven haarbayim, vehashshelishit enah meshammeshet kelum ella lekiyyum haesh, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo, zo maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh:
Vachazitah mizracha. marit paneha dehaynu happetach vehachallon shel maaracha, letzad mizrach shel mizbeach:
Verashe haggizrin. happenimiyyim hayu arukkim ad shehayu nogim battappuach:
Et haalita. chariyyot vekismin dakkin tochavin ben haggedolim lehatztzit haesh. vaalita leshon alya, al shem zanvot haudim:
Hakkovesh shelosha chevashim. shelosha mine yarak:
Bechavit achat. shel chometz o shel tzir, kede sheyyitkayyemu shelosha mine hayyarak yachad:

Rabbi eliezer omer ochlim al harishon. vechevan dechala min echad mehen min hassade neesru chullam vaafillu otan shello chalu, sheoto min shekkala natan taam beotan shello chalu vaasaran, ditnan leel perek 7‏ sheviit oseret beminah bemashshehu, shello veminah benoten taam:

Rabbi yehoshua omer af al haacharon. al semach min hakkale acharon yochal mishshelashtan af al pi shekkevar kalu hashshenayim lachayya shebbassade. vetaama derabbi yehoshua, hoil veellu shekkalu beluim mittaam oto shello chala, deamar kera (Vayikra 25) min hassade tochlu et tevuatah, kol zeman sheatta ochel min hassade atta ochel min habbayit, vehay kera yetera hu, deha darshinan la min velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha, kol zeman shechayya ochelet bassade haachel livhemtecha min habbayit vechulei, ella kera lichvushim hu daata, vehachi kaamar min hassade tochlu et tevuatah, im yesh bassade miktzat min haddavar hannichbash babbayit, shehattaam habbalua baddavar hannichbash yesh bemino adayin bassade sheadayin lo chala, af al pi sheikkar happeri kala, af al pi chen tochlu et tevuatah veeno zakuk levaer:

Kol yarak echad hu. lo natnu chachamim shiur lechol yarak veyarak bifne atzmo, ella af al pi sheshshelashtan kalu min hassade, hoil veikka shear yerakot shello chalu ochel al yede shear yerakot, velo yevaaram min hechavit ad sheyyichlu kol hayerakot kullan min hassade, vahalacha kerabban gamliel dechol shekkala mino min hassade yevaer mino min hechavit veochel et hashshear:
Nazir sheggillach. shehevi karbenotav vegilleach alehen veachar kach noda lo shennitma bime neziruto:
Im tuma yedua. tuma sheefshar shehayta yedua, kegon sheenah kever hattehom:
Soter. vechozer umone nezirut acheret:

Veim tumat hattehom eno soter. im noda lo shebbammakom sheavar hayta tumat hattehom vehi tuma sheen echad makkirah afillu besof haolam, af al pi shevvadday tame haya, eno soter, dahalacha hi kach bannazir:
