Im ad shello gillach. tiglachat tohora, af al pi shekkevar hevi karbenotav. hoil venoda lo kodem haggilluach:
Ben kach uven kach. ben tuma yedua ben tumat hattehom, soter. deha digmire detumat hattehom enah soteret, hayenu davka achar gilluach shel tohora:
Ketzad. din tumat hattehom:

Yarad litbol bimara. shehaya tame tumat sheretz o tuma acheret kayyotze bah sheenah shel met, veyarad litbol mittumato, venimtza kazzayit min hammet tzaf al pene hammayim safek nitma bo o lo nitma, tame. veha dekayma lan sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim tahor, hane mille betumat sheretz, aval betumat met, tame. veim noda lo safek ze af achar sheggillach, tame, dehaynu tuma yedua, hoil vehayta bemakom sheefshar sheyyiruha bene adam. vehay denakat yarad litbol, revuta ka mashma lan, deaf al gav dehattovel mittuma letohora nizhar mikkol davar hammetamme, afillu hachi tame:
Nimtza meshukka bekarka hammeara. bammakom shettaval uvevadday nitma. im noda lo achar sheggillach, tahor veeno soter, dehaynu tumat hattehom, shehayta bemakom shello hayta yedua leshum adam:

Yarad lehaker tahor. af al pi sheyyarad lehaker ulehitztannen velo yarad litbol kede sheyyihye nizhar mittuma, afillu hachi tahor im lo haya teme met. aval im yarad littaher mittumat met vetaval bammeara shehaya hammet meshukka bah vehishlim neziruto, o teme met shettaval veachar kach kibbel alav nezirut, tame vesoter, shechezkat tame tame vechezkat tahor tahor:
Sheraglayim laddavar. kelomar taam veikkar yesh laddavar lomar delo gemire hilchata letumat hattehom shehi tehora benazir ella cheshehaya hannazir bechezkat tahor velo cheshehaya bechezkat tame:
Vered. shoshan:
Vehakkofer. hu shekkorim lo baaravi 90. veyesh omrim shehu bosem shekkorin 335:
Vehakketaf. ilan afarsemon:
Lotem. targum lot valtos. yesh omrim shehu 358 baaravi, 486 belaaz:
Yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit. vehu haddin deyesh lahen biur velidmehen biur, veaf al pi shello nizkar bammishna:

Mippene sheeno feri. vedinan keetzim deen lahem kedushshat sheviit mishshum dahanaatan achar biuran, vehattora amra leachla, dumeya daachila, shehanaatan uviuran shave, yatzu etzim dahanaatan achar biuran. vetanna kamma sever diktafo zehu piryo. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:

Hayu maalin otah levet din haggadol. dichtiv besota (sham) veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot, uchetiv hatam (Devarim 17) al pi hattora asher yorucha, ma lehallan bevet din haggadol af kan bevet din haggadol:
Umeayyemin aleha. kede shettode:
Harebe yaldut osa. vegorem leyalda shettavo lide kilkul:
Devarim sheenan keday leshoman. sheenah reuya lishmoa otan haddevarim sheomrim lefaneha mimmaasehen shel tzaddikim, kegon yehuda hoda velo bosh bemaase tamar, reuven hoda velo bosh bemaase bilha:
Miricho hayu shomim kol shaar haggadol. umirushalayim ad yericho eser parsaot:
Hammagrefa. min keli niggun shehaya vammikdash, asara nekavim hayu vo, vechol echad veechad motzi mea mine zemer, vekolo nishma ad lemerachok:

Ben katin. shem adam vechohen gadol haya, veasa galgal lakkiyyor leshakkeo vabbor shello yihyu memav nifsalim belina, shekkol davar shennitkaddesh bichli sharet nifsal belina uveyotze uvitvul yom, ucheshehayu maalim oto min habbor lekaddesh bo yedehem veraglehem haya kol haggalgal nishma ad yericho:
Gevini karoz. kohen sheshshemo gevini, shehaya machriz bechol boker bevet hammikdash imdu chohanim laavodatchem:
Chalil. 600 belaaz, baaravi 288, vekolo nishma lemerachok. veyesh omrim 380 velaaz:
Tzeltzal. 172 velaaz:
Michvar. shem makom:
Kelal gadol. melugema. tachboshet uretiyya, uferush melugema melo lugema, shedderech adam lilos melo lugemav chittim o teenim venoten al gabbe makkato:

En osim mimmennu melugema. dichtiv (Vayikra 25) vehayta shabbat haaretz lachem leachla, ma shehu meyuchad lachem dehaynu lemaachal adam yihye leachla velo limlugema, aval ma sheeno meyuchad lachem yihye ben leachla ben limlugema, hilkach kol sheeno maachal adam osin mimmenu melugema leadam:

Osin mimmenu melugema leadam aval lo livhema. dichtiv (sham) velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye kol tevuatah leechol, davar harauy lachayya velabbehema tihye leechol labbehema velo laasot lah melugema:
Chumre adam. sheen osin mehem melugema:
Vechumre vehema. sheasur leshalkan:
Hassia. esev shekkorin lo baaravi 307:
Veezov. 760 baaravi uvelaaz 157:
Vekurenit. baaravi 309 uvelaaz 585:
Amar lahem hamemunne vechulei. beferek kamma divrachot meforash shehi ahava rabba. veachar sheheir hayyom vezarcha hachamma mevarchim yotzer or. veseder berachot eno meakkev:

Karu aseret haddevarim. lefi shehen ikkar hattora. uvedin haya sheyyihyu korin otan bechol yom af baggevulim, ella shebbittelum mippene taromet hamminim, shehayu omrim ellu levaddam nittenu vesinay velo shear hattora:

Vehem berchu shalosh berachot. veellu hen shalosh berachot, emet veyatztziv, vaavoda, uvirkat kohanim keriat happesukim bilvad, velo nesiat kappayim, shello hayu hakkohanim nosim et kappehen ella leachar hakeravat hattamid uketoret, kidamrinan beidach pirka, vehaidna lo hayu mevarchim hanach berachot ella chede sheyyehe hattamid mekubbal beratzon, velo hayu niftarim bechach mittefillat shemone esre:

Mosifin beracha achat. shemmishmar hayyotze omer lammishmar hannichnas, mi sheshshikken et shemo vabbayit hazze hu yashkin benechem ahava veachva shalom vereut, shebbechol yom shabbat haya nichnas mishmar laavoda veyotze hammishmar sheavar:
Veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) veachar yishte hannazir yayin, achar hammaasim kullam:

Rabbi shimon omer kulei. ketiv hacha veachar yishte hannazir yayin, uchetiv hatam (sham) achar hitgallecho et nizro, ma lehallan achar maase yechidi, af kan achar maase yechidi, ha lamadta shekkevan shennizrak alav echad min haddamim muttar lishtot yayin ulehittamme lemetim. vechen halacha:
Vehannetz shello. perach sheal happitma:
Ukelippe egozim. kol hanne tzovim bahen:
Vehaggalinim. garine ferot, kegon haggarinim shebbazzetim shemmotziim mehen shemen, vegarine temarim sheruyin lemaachal behema:
Tzovea leatzmo. dichtiv lachem, lechol tzarchechem:
Sheen osim sechora beferot sheviit. utzevia besachar hayenu sechora:
Lo vivchorot velo vitrumot. dilma mashhe lehu legabbeh veate vehu lide takkala. vedavka bivchor chay gazru, aval shachut share lemachro afillu midderabbanan, uvilvad shello yimkerennu veitliz:

Lo vinvelot velo vitrefot. demeachar dechatav rachamana temeim hem, ma tzarich lomar tu utemeim yihyu lachem, ella echad leissur achila veechad leissur hanaa. veim tomar hare chamor hare gamal vesus vafered, shane hanne delimlachtan hen gedelim, velo asru laasot sechora ella vedavar haomed laachila. vechol davar sheissuro min hattora asur laasot bo sechora, aval davar sheissuro middivrehem en asur laasot bo sechora ella setam yenan, deaf al gav deissuro middivrehem asur laasot bo sechora:
Velo yehe lokeach. kelomar loket umocher bashshuk, denire kischora. aval keshebbeno mocher al yado, perush bishvilo, af al pi shehu lekatan lemachran lo mechaze kischora:
Lakach leatzmo. lakat leatzmo leechol vehotir, muttar lemachran afillu hu atzmo:

Hechellu maalin baefer. leachar shessilleku latztzedadim o lassovev evarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu, hayu moshchin et haefer bammagrefot shebbeyadam umaalin oto lattappuach, kemin keri gadol shel efer shehaya veemtza hammizbeach tzavur veasuy chetappuach:
Peamim alav kishlosh meot kor. guzema katane, demeolam lo hinnichu lihyot alav shelosh meot kor:
Uvargalim lo hayu medashshenim oto. lo hayu motziin et haddeshen lachutz af al pi shehu rabbe al hammizbeach:
Mippene shehu noy lammizbeach. sheyyihye nire shekkarbanot harebe hayu al gabbe hammizbeach:
Miyyamav lo nitatztzel. kelomar ma shehaya deshen kol kach, lo mechamat atzlut hakkohanim, ella lenoy lehareot shekkarbanot harebe karvu al gabbe hammizbeach:
Pishpash. petach katan shebbetoch gufo shel petach gadol, uvo hayu nichnasim mibbet hammoked laazara:

Ellu. hayu holchin: baachsadra. shebbaazara: derech hammizrach. shehayu achsadraot saviv laazara mibbifnim, ammudim yotzim chutz lechatle haazara, umin haammudim vead katle haazara haya sechach al gabbehen vehen keruyin 455 belaaz, umin haammudim velachutz haya velo sechach, vehammizbeach haya shello vimkom hassechach. vehayu mitchallekim lishte chittot, kede sheyyihyu vodkim veroim kol kele sharet sheyyihyu chullan bimkoman beshalom. vehayu holchim baachsadraot haasuyot letzad ruach tzefonit, ellu mehallechim bah bechetzyah shel tzad mizrach veellu mehallechim bah bechetzyah shel tzad maarav, ad sheppogim ze vaze vammakom sheosim minchat chavittin shel kohen gadol, shehaya mevi vechol yom machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baerev, vehi hayta samuch leshaar nikkanor, vesham hayu omrim ze laze shalom hakkol shalom, kelomar matzanu chol hakkelim beshalom velo nifkad mehem keli:
Shello yeviennu lide fesul. sheim nifsal, bishvil shemen shel teruma yissaref hakkol, venimtza gorem leferot sheviit shello yeachlu:
Verabbi shimon mattir. lehavi kadashim levet happesul. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Vehaacharon acharon nitpas bashsheviit. ketzad, lakach beferot sheviit basar, habbasar vehapperot mitbaarin bashsheviit, lakach babbasar dagim, yatza basar venitpas dagim, lakach baddagim shemen, yatzu dagim venitpas hashshemen, vechayyav levaer happerot vehashshemen, nimtza acharon acharon nitpas. vehapperi shel sheviit atzmo asur leolam, umappekinan la middichtiv (Vayikra 25) ki yovel hi kodesh, ma kodesh tofes et damav af sheviit tofeset et dameha, i ma kodesh tofes et damav veyotze lechullin af sheviit tofeset dameha veyotzet lechullin, talmud lomar (sham) tihye, bahavayatah tehe:
Millishkat hattelaim. lishka shehayu hattelaim shel temidim sham:

Lishkat hachotamot. shel lokche solet lemincha veyayin linsachim, shehayu holchim etzel hamemunne al hachotamot venotnim lo maot kefi hannesachim shehu tzarich, vehu noten lo chotam umolich hachotam etzel hamemunne al hannesachim umekabbel mimmennu nesachim. veotah lishka shehamemunne al hachotamot yoshev bah hi keruya lishkat hachotamot. uvemassechet shekalim meforash shearbaa chotamot hayu vammikdash, vechatuv alehem, egel, zachar, gedi, chote. keshemmevi chotam shekkatuv bo egel, beyadua shennatan maot leniske far. zachar, beyadua shennatan maot leniske ayil, shettargum ayil, dichra. gedi, beyadua shennatan maot leniske cheves. chote, beyadua shennatan maot leniske metzora:
Lishkat bet hammoked. al shem hammedura sheddoleket bah tamid keruya vet hammoked:
Chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. im nitma veotah tuma venichnas lammikdash, o ochel kadashim kodem shettahar mittumato, chayyavin aleha karet im haya mezid, o karban ole veyored im haya shogeg:

Lo tehe zo kalla min hashsheretz. dechayyavin aleha al biat mikdash, kedichtiv bevayyikra o venivlat sheretz tame. umilleta derabbi meir leta, shehare magga umassa shel etzem kasseora shehu kal sheeno metamme vaohel, hannazir megalleach aleha keditnan bematnitin, ureviit dam shehi chamura shemmetamme vaohel en hannazir megalleach aleha:

En danin kan kal vachomer. sheen danin kal vachomer al davar shehu halacha lemoshe missinay, sheetzem kasseora eno katuv battora ella halacha hi, veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha. vehen hen divre rabbi eliezer hen hen divre rabbi yehoshua sheamar ella kach amru halacha:
Keochel besar chazir. lav davka, sheen haochel pat kuti loke min hattora, ella makkat mardut midderabbanan:
Ma sherabbi eliezer omer bo. demekel bo tefe:
Hamelakket asavim lachim. ochlan belo viur: ad sheyyivash. lachluchit haaretz hamemattek et happerot, mishsham veelach chayyav levaaran:
Hamegabbev bayyavesh. hamelakket baasavim yeveshim, ochlan belo viur:
Ad shettered revia sheniyya. shehi beshana benonit bechg bemarcheshvan, mishsham veelach chayyav levaer:
Megabbev. targum lekoshesh kash, legabbava:
Revia. al shem shehammatar rovea et haaretz umolidah kezachar ze sherovea et hannekeva. perush acher shemmarbitz heafar umashkivo, targum rovetz, revia:
Vaale gefanim. lachim, ochlim bahen kol zeman shennimtzaim baavihen, kelomar bimchubbar lailan:
Sheyyishshoru. sheyyippelu:
Vehamegabbev bayyavesh. baale kanim ugefanim yeveshim, ochel ad shettered revia sheniyya, veachar kach yevaer:
Bechullan. ben asavim ben kanim ugefanim, ben lachim ben yeveshim. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Kol sefek negaim battechilla tahor. kegon shenayim shebbau etzel kohen, baze baheret kigris uvaze baheret kesela, uvesof shavua baze kesela uvaze kesela, veen yadua beeze mehen pasa, shenehen tehorin, veaf al gav devadday echad mehen tame:

Mishshennizkak lattuma sefeko tame. kegon shenayim shebbau etzel kohen, baze baheret kigris uvaze kesela, uvesof shavua baze kesela veod uvaze kesela veod, chazru lihyot kesela, af al pi shehaechad mehem vadday tahor, shekkevar halach happisyon, shenehem temeim, kevan shennizkeku lattuma, ad sheyyachzeru lechigris:
Beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav. sheim raa mechamat ones, tahor, dedarshinan zav mibbesaro, velo mechamat anso:

Ad shello nizkak lattuma. dehaynu kesheroe reiyya sheniyya shebbah naasa zav gamur letamme mishkav umoshav. aval reiyya rishona metammea beones tumat erev kedin beal keri, umitztarefet im hashsheniyya afillu hayta beones:
Bemaachol. im ochel devarim hammeviim lide ziva, kegon basar shamen, chalav ugevina, betzim, yayin yashan:
Uvemishte. beribbuy shetiyya:
Bemassa. kaved shennasa:
Bemare. raa ishsha afillu lo hirher:
Uvehirhur. af al pi shello raa. im era lo echad meellu hashshiva kodem sheraa reiyya sheniyya, eno naase zav, vehattippa enah metammea bammassa:
Mishshennizkak lattuma. sheraa reiyya sheniyya shello beones:
En bodkin oto. veaf im raa shelishit beones naase zav lekarban:

Usefeko veshichvat zaro temeim. sefeko mechamat shichvat zaro. kegon im raa shichvat zera techilla vetippat ziva habbaa achar kach, enah metammea sheharoe keri eno metamme beziva meet leet. vead shello nizkak lattuma hakkeri metaher et hazziva, mishshum dahave ones, uleachar shennizkak lattuma en hakkeri metaher et hazziva, sheen tolin shemmechamat hakkeri baa hazziva:
Sheraglayim laddavar. sheen otah reiyya mechamat ones, kevan shekkevar naasa zav:
Rabbi nechemya foter sheraglayim laddavar. shello mechamat makka met, kevan shehekel mimma shehaya. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Veellu asurot leechol batteruma. leolam. vaafillu hi bat kohen. veillu shear sotot enan asurot ella ad sheyyishtu veyimmatzu tehorot:

Veshebbau edim shehi temea. vaafillu leachar sheshshatta velo badkuha hammayim, asura issur olam. lefi sheen hammayim bodkim beishsha sheyyesh bah edim shennitmet, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) venistera vehi nitmaa veed en bah, delekka deyada bah hu shehammayim bodkim, aval ikka deyada bah, afillu haedim hem bimdinat hayyam, en hammayim bodkim:

Veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech. deshuv en hammayim bodkim otah, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) venikka haish meavon, bizman shehaish menukke meavon, shello ba aleha leachar setira, az vehaishsha hahi tissa et avonah. en haish menukke meavon, en hammayim bodkim et ishto:
Shene talmide chachamim. sheyyedu lehaterot bo:

Rabbi yehuda omer balah neeman aleha. im habbaal neeman al ishto beissur chamur shel nidda, lo yehe neeman beissur kal shel lav gereda. vetaamayhu derabbanan, mittoch sheissur kal hu, takkif aleh yitzreh. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Venimtza fasul. kegon shennishpach damo, o yatza o nitma:
Tiglachto fesula. hoil venifsal hazzevach sheggillach alav, hava leh kegillechuhu listim deamrinan leel lerabbi eliezer soter shiva yamim ulerabbanan soter sheloshim yom:
Uzevachav lo alu lo. shear hazzevachim shehikriv achar tiglachto happesula, lo alu lo, dechevan detzarich listor ad sheyyigdal searo, have cheillu hikrivan kodem zemannam:

Al hachattat shello lishmah. hayenu al hazzevach venimtza pasul, dechattat shello lishmah pesula. veayde devae lemitne al haola veal hashshelamim pelugta derabbi shimon verabbanan, tana nammi al hachattat:

Al haola veal hashshelamim shello lishman vechulei‏ tiglachto fesula. dehoil velo alu leshem chovat shalme nazir veolat nazir, have leh kimgalleach al olat nedava veshalme nedava. verabbi shimon savar deim gillach al olat nedava veshalme nedava yatza. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Im gillach al shelashtan. achar shehikrivu shelashtan:
Venimtza echad mehen kasher. vehashshear pesulim:
Tiglachto cheshera. ledivre hakkol. deha tenan veim gillach al echad mishshelashtan yatza:
Yochal kenegdan. keneged otam damim yikne mishshelo devarim shehem letzorech achila veyochal bikdushshat sheviit:
Kinne zavim vekinne zavot. shete torim o shene vene yona shechayyavin lehavi hazzavim vehayyoldot:

Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash. mippene hakkavod, ugedulla hi labbayit shello yehe velo shomrim. ushelosha mekomot yalfinan middichtiv (Bamidbar 3) vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma vegomer‏ shomre mishmeret vegomer‏ lemishmeret, remez leshalosh mishmarot bishlosha mekomot, uma matzinu vammishkan shehayu hakkohanim aharon ushene vanav shomrim bo vishlosha mekomot, af mikdash ken:
Bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz hayu aliyyot. benuyot betzad shaare haazara:
Veharovin. yeladim. targum yeled, ravya. perush acher, harovin, hammorim chitztzim bakkeshet, milleshon rove kashshat:
Uvet hammoked kippa. binyan shel bet hammoked lo hayta aliyya ella kippa, 358 belaaz, asuya vaaretz:

Vehaya mukkaf rovadim shel even. itztabbaot saviv shel avne gazit, hayu meshukkaot bakkotel veyotzot min hakkotel letoch bet hammoked letzad hakkarka, veal gabbehen avanim acherot ketzarot mehen sheyyotzot nammi min hakkotel, vehayu cheen maalot zo al zo:
Zikne vet av. hammishmar haya mitchallek leshiva vatte avot keminyan yeme hashshavua, kol echad oved yomo, vezikne vet av shel oto yom hayu yeshenim sham al otan rovdin:
Ufirche chehunna. bachurim shemmatchil sear zekanam lifroach, vehen hayu hashshomrim:
Kisto. leshon karim uchesatot:
Ish kisto vaaretz. shello hayu yecholim lishkav sham al gabbe mittot ella vaaretz kederech shomre chatzrot hammelachim:
Umannichim otan tachat rashehen. keneged rashehen velo tachat rashehen mammash, lefi sheyyesh bevigde chehunna sheyyesh bahen kilayim kegon avnet, veen muttar lehishtammesh bahen ella vishat avoda:
Umitkassim bichsut atzman. bevigde chol:

Bammesibba. bimchila hamehallechet tachat habbira. shemmechila hayta tachat hammikdash. vechol hammikdash karuy vira kedichtiv (divrei hayamim 1 29) el habbira asher hachinoti. umippene shehaya vaal keri, lo haya mehallech derech haazara ella derech hammechilot, dekayma lan mechilot lo nitkaddeshu:
Vehannerot hayu dolkim. bammechila mikkan umikkan:
Umedura hayta sham. shehakkohen mitchammem bah leachar shettaval:
Veze haya chevodo. shello nichnas bo adam meolam kol zeman shehaya chavero sham:
Metzao naul. ze simano sheyyesh adam sham, velo haya nichnas:
Nistappeg. kinnach hammayim sheal besaro:
Ba veyashav lo. bevet hammoked:
Ad shehashshearim niftachim. haya yotze veholech lo lachutz. lefi shettevul yom mishtalleach chutz laazara, kidamrinan beellu devarim, vechol zav lerabbot baal keri:

Al hammet. af al pi sheeno shalem ella sheyyesh bo rov binyan, shehem shene shokayim veyarech echad, o rov minyan haevarim shehem mea esrim vachamishsha evarim, afillu en bahem rova kav, metamme vaohel, venazir megalleach alav. veim en bammet lo rov minyan velo rov binyan, en hannazir megalleach al oholo ad sheyyehe baatzamot chatzi kav:
Veal kazzayit netzel. mohal hayyotze min hammet kemin lecha hayyotzet meippush habbasar:

Melo tarvad rakav. melo chaf meafar rikkavon shel met. veen harikkavon metamme ella cheshennikbar hammet arom baaron shel shayish vechayyotze vo sheen sham rikkavon acher ella miggufo shel met, venikbar hammet kullo shalem shello nechsar mimmennu ever:
Tarvad. kaf gedola shemmachzeket melo chafnayim:
Al hashshidra. afillu en bah basar kelal:
Vechen al etzem haggulgolet. shel harosh, afillu en bah basar:

Veal ever min hachay veal ever min hammet sheyyesh alehem basar karauy. kol sheillu haya haevar mechubbar beadam chay haya yachol lehaalot arucha al yede oto vasar hu nikra charauy. vehu pachot mikkazzayit:

Veal chatzi kav atzamot. veaf al gav derova kav atzamot metamme vaohel, halacha lemoshe missinay sheen hannazir megalleach ella al chatzi kav, vechen al chatzi log dam. veaf al gav derova dam metamme vaohel, en hannazir megalleach ella al chatzi log:
Veal etzem kasseora al maggao veal massao. aval al oholo lo, sheen etzem kasseora metamme vaohel:
Vesoter et hakkodmim. kedichtiv (Bamidbar 6) vehayyamim harishonim yippelu:
Ad sheyyithar. sheyyitbol veyaariv shimsho achar sheyyazze shelishi ushevii:

Velo feresh. af al gav dechol hakkarbanot tzarich sheyyikreu lahem habbealim shem, hacha lo tzarich, dimchi amar ellu linziruti have cheillu kara shem lechol echad veechad, dechivsa enah reuya ella lechattat, vecheves leola, veayil lishlamim:
Umeshalleach tachat haddud. shemmevashshelim bo zevach hashshelamim:
Haya megalleach bammedina. birushalayim. veaf al gav dichtiv petach ohel moed, lav davka, ella lelammed sheeno megalleach ad sheyyihye petach ohel moed patuach:

Lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) velakach et sear rosh nizro venatan al haesh, mi sheeno mechussar ella lekicha unetina, yatza ze shemmechussar lekicha vahavaa unetina tachat haddud:
Bamme devarim amurim. shebbammikdash notel sear umeshalleach tachat haddud, betiglachat tohora:
Aval betiglachat tuma. afillu gillach bammikdash, eno notel sear umeshalleach tachat haddud shel asham vechattat haof, delo chetiv netinat sear tachat haddud ella venazir tahor:

Hakkol meshallechin. tahor bammikdash uvammedina, vetame vammikdash, chutz mittame sheggillach bammedina, mippene shessearo nikbar. ufesak hahalacha, sheen meshalleach tachat haddud ella nazir tahor sheggillach petach ohel moed, shennaasa chemitzvato. veim shillach tachat haddud shel chattat, yatza. lo neemar asher tachat zevach hashshelamim ella lemitzva:
Bammuktze. keli hammeyuchad lakotz bo teenim karuy muktze:
Bacharba. sakkin, leshon cherev. vetaama mishshum dichtiv (Vayikra 25) veet inve nezirecha lo tivtzor, kederech habbotzrim:
Areva. shellashim bah et haissa:
Uvakkotev. etz gadol vechaved uverosho even gedola shennotnim al hazzetim bevet habbad, nikra kotev:
Bodida. bet habbad katan keen areva:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:

Shetoku lo omar lachem ma sherabbi eliezer omer bo. rabbi akiva kibbel merabbi eliezer rabbo demekel tefe besicha, uchesheamru lo shehaya rabbi eliezer omer yiddalek amar lahem shetoku, sheeni rashshay lefaresh kamma haya rabbi eliezer mekel bo, vahalacha kachachamim:

Shene nezirim sheamar lahem echad kulei. vehem shotkim, deim hem machchishin eno neeman, deed echad bemakom shemmachchishin oto eno neeman. umatnitin ayre kegon shezze haed lo haya immahem, ella amar raiti merachok tuma shennizreka venechem, sheim haya haed etzlam bimkomam haveya lah sefek tuma birshut harabbim, usefek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor, dechol sefek tuma missota yalfinan la dichtiv bah (Bamidbar 5) venistera vehi nitmaa, veenan ella hi vehabboel, usefekah tame. vechol zeman shehem yoter mishshenayim, afillu vetoch habbayit sefeko tahor, dehavya lah kisfek tuma birshut harabbim, lechach tzarich lomar shello haya haed bishat sefek tuma etzlam bimkomam:

Vesofrim sheloshim yom. uchegon sheshshenehem nadru nezirut beyachad venadru setam nezirut. vehu haddin im nadru shenehem beyachad ufershu nezirutam lizman katzuv, shelleachar sheheviu karban tuma vekarban tohora chozrim umonim hazzeman hakkatzuv linzirutam, umafrishim karban tohora:
Vekarban tuma safek. chattat haof habba al hattuma safek, veenah neechelet:
Ella mevi chattat of. lisfek tumot nezirut. veasham eno mevi, kerabbanan deamre leel hevi chattato velo hevi ashamo mone:
Nimtza ze mevi karbenotav lachatzaim. im nazir tahor hu. deola rishona hayta chova, veatta hu makriv chattat ushelamim:
Aval hodu chachamim leven zoma. velo chashshu al shemmakriv karbenotav lachatzaim. vahalacha keven zoma:
Litrom et hammizbeach. terumat haddeshen:
Mashkim vetovel. shello haya adam nichnas laazara laavod avoda, afillu tahor, ad shehu tovel:

Vechi veezo shaa hamemunne va. kelomar mi ikka zeman kavua leviat hamemunne, deamart shehaya mashkim vetovel kodem biat hamemunne, ella vadday lo haya zeman kavua leviato, shello chol haittim hayu shavot, sheppeamim haya va hamemunne mikkerot haggever kulei, vehilkach mi shehaya rotze litrom haya mashkim kol ma shehaya yachol, veachar kach haya va hamemunne vedofek alehem leotam shebbevet hammoked, vehem hayu fotchin lo:
Mikkeriat haggever. it dimfarshe keriat hattarnegol. veit dimfarshi chohen shehaya ragil likrot bechol yom samuch laalot hashshachar:

Mi shettaval yavo veyafis. kol otan shehayu notnim libbam litrom, hayu tovlim kodem sheyyavo hamemunne, veachar kach hayu mattilin payis benehen, hu haggoral, umi shebba lo haggoral holech vetorem. seder haggoral umaasehu, meforash perek 2‏ deyoma:
Kohen gadol venazir enan mittammein likrovehen. kedichtiv befarashat emor uvefarashat naso:
Hayu mehallechim badderech. lav davka bechohen gadol pelige, dehu haddin bechohen hedyot nammi felige, dechad tama hu:
Megalleach bashshevii umevi karban bashshemini. kedichtiv (sham) vegillach rosho beyom tohorato bayyom hashshevii yegallechenu. uvayyom hashshemini yavi shete torim vegomer‏ vecheves laasham:

Ma ben ze lammetzora. dichtiv befarashat metzora betiglachat sheniyya (Vayikra 14) vehaya bayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo vechulei‏ uvayyom hashshemini yikkach vechulei, vekayma lan bammetzora deim gillach bashshemini mevi karban batteshii:

Amar lo shezze tohorato teluya veyamav. nazir tohorato teluya behazzaat shelishi ushevii utevila, hilkach kevan shettahar bashshevii af al pi shello gillach ad yom hashshemini, mevi karbenotav bo vayyom:

Aval metzora tohorato teluya vetiglachto. kedichtiv (sham) bayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo vahadar ketiv verachatz et besaro vammayim, veim taval ad shello gillach lo alta lo tevila, hilkach im gillach bashshemini akkatti tzarich tevila vehaarev shemesh, hilkach eno yachol lehavi karbenotav ad teshii. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Bayyar. chofer borot umaspik mayim livne hair, lo yitten lo middeme sheviit lehasepik lo mayim lechol tashmisho:
Velo levallan. mechammem merchatzaot:
Velo lesappar. sechar hattisporet:
Velo lesappan. sechar hassefina:
Ulechullan. lechol hanne detaninan bematnitin yachol litten mattenat chinnam shello leshem secharan, veaf al pi sheyyodea shebbishvil shennatan mattana lo yitba mimmennu sachar:
Nazir haya shemuel. vehaomer hareni chishmuel, o keven elkana, o kemi sheshshissef agag baggilgal, have nazir ledivre rabbi nehoray. vechen halacha:
En mora ella shel basar vadam. shello tehe marut veemat adam alav:
Aniyyim nichnasim lappardesaot. bishar shene shavua littol leket shichcha ufea, vechen nichnasim lagginnot bemotzae sheviit:
Ad shettered revia sheniyya. mippene motrot perot sheviit shennisharu vah:

Batteven uvakkash shel sheviit. distam teven vekash chaze lemaachal behema veyesh bo kedushshat sheviit, veasur lesarfo velehanot bo hanaa shel [ibbud], mishshum dedarshinan leachla velo lehefsed. aval keshennitbattel ma shebbassade mimmaachal chayya paka kedushshat sheviit mimma shebbabbayit:
Laachila ushetiyya vesicha. baanavim vezetim mayre, sheyyesh bahem achila ushetiyya vesicha:

Leechol davar sheddarko leechol. af al gav deamra tora leachla velo lehefsed, en mechayyevim oto leechol davar sheen derech bene adam leachlo, kegon tavshil shennitkalkel, velo chayshinan im holech leibbud. vechen davar sheen derech bene adam leachlo ella al yede tikkun uva hu leachlo kemot shehu belo tikkun, kegon leechol teradin chayyin o lachos chittin chayyot, en shomin lo:
Vechen bitruma vechen bemaaser sheni. lo nittenu ella laachila ushetiyya vesicha:

Shennittena lehadelakat hanner. ma sheen ken bitruma tehora, aval teruma temea madlikin bah et hanner. uvemaaser sheni ketiv (Devarim 26) velo viarti mimmennu betame, aval betahor muttar levaer. uvishviit ben betame ben betahor muttar:

Chadashim lakketoret. mi shello zacha vakketoret kol yamav yavo veyafis. velo hayu mannichim lemi shezzacha vah paam achat lishnot bah, mippene shemmaasheret, dichtiv (Devarim 33) yasimu ketora veappecha vegomer‏ barech Adonai‏ chelo, lefichach lo hayu mannichim lishnot bah adam, kede sheyyihyu hakkol mitashsherim umitbarchim bah:
Chadashim im yeshanim. lefi sheamar bakketoret chadashim davka, amar hacha chadashim gam yeshanim, kelomar mi shezzacha vappayis peamim acherot umi shello zacha bou vehafisu:
Hu hammaale otam legabbe hammizbeach. velo haya chan payis. veen halacha cherabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Shehattuma vehattiglachat sotrim. dichtiv battuma (sham), vehayyamim harishonim yippelu. vetiglachat soteret sheloshim, devainan gaddel pera sear rosho (sham), veen giddul pera pachot mishsheloshim yom:
Shehayyotze min haggefen lo huttar mikkelalo. kegon lishtot yen mitzva, deamrinan miyyayin veshechar yazzir (sham) leesor yen mitzva keyen harshut:

Tuma vetiglachat hutteru mikkelalan. tuma, lemet mitzva, dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma, leaviv hu deeno mittamme, aval mittamme lemet mitzva. vetiglachat, lenazir metzora, deate ase divgillach et kol searo (Vayikra 14) vedache et lo taase detaar lo yaavor al rosho (Bamidbar 6):
Hammekanne leishto. af al gav dehammekanne mashma diavad in lechattechilla lo, hahalacha hi shechayyav adam lekanot leishto im hi tzericha lechach. ulekamman mefaresh ketzad mekanne:

Mekanne lah al pi shenayim. im ba lehashekotah me hammarim, tzarich lehavi shene edim velomar lah bifnehem al tissatri im ish peloni. veim lo kinne lah bifne shenayim, enah neeseret alav bistira zo veeno mashke otah:

Al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo. afillu en edim shennistera ella ed echad, o hu atzmo omer reitiha shennistera achar shekkinneti lah, neesra bistira zo ad shettishte, shessetiratah osartah alav missafek:

Rabbi yehoshua omer kulei. tzarich shene edim af listira. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua. veaf al pi chen amrinan baggemara devazzeman hazze lo lema eynish leveteh afillu beno levenah al tissatri im ish peloni, sheyyesh lachush ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar mekanne adam leishto al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo, veim nistera achar shekkinne lah beno levenah, neesra alav issur olam bazzeman hazze sheen sham me hammarim:
Hizzaher shemma tigga bakkeli. bammachta shehi cheli sharet. sheen adam rashshay likrav el hammizbeach velo leshum avoda ad sheyyekaddesh yadav veraglav:
Bammiktzoa. bekeren zavit:

Ben katin. kach shemo shel kohen gadol sheasa mucheni lakkiyyor. galgal hassovev sheal yado meshakkeim hakkiyyor babbor shello yihyu memav nifsalim belina, lefi shekkol davar shennitkaddesh bichle sharet nifsal belinat layla, ucheshehaya meshukka hakkiyyor babbor lo hayu memav nifsalin. verambam omer, shehammucheni hu cheli saviv lakkiyyor, shello nitkaddesh bichle sharet, vesham hayu mannichim hammayim ballayla chede shello yitkaddeshu veyippaslu velina:
Hameukkalot happenimiyyot. haggechalim shebbeemtza haesh shennitakkelu hetev vehen kerovim lihyot deshen:
Tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe haritzpa. mishshum dichtiv vesamo, vedarshinan [temura daf lod.] vesamo, chullo. vesamo, shello yefazzer:

Shachat et hashshelamim umegalleach alehem. dichtiv bannazir (Bamidbar 6) vegillach et rosho petach ohel moed, umefarshinan likra hachi, vegillach et rosho al zevach shekkatuv bo petach ohel moed, dehaynu shelamim dichtiv behu (Vayikra 3) ushechato petach ohel moed:
Shechattat kodemet bechol makom. leola ushelamim, vedin hu sheyyegalleach al harishon. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda shemmegalleach al hashshelamim:
Hammotze met mittechilla. shello haya yadua shehaya sham kever. vehayenu deamrinan baggemara hammotze velo shehaya matzuy. veod daykinan millishna dematnitin met velo shehaya harug:
Mushkav. velo shehaya yoshev:
Kedarko. velo shehaya rosho munnach ben yarchotav. dechol hane chayshinan lehu shemma goyim hem, sheen darkan shel yisrael likbor metehen kach:

Notlo veet tefusato. muttar lefannoto mishsham ulekavro bemakom acher, vetzarich sheyyittol min heafar shel hakkever immo kede tefisa, shehu kol heafar tichoach shettachtav. vechofer bekarka betula shalosh etzbaot. dichtiv (Bereshit 47) unesatani mimmitzrayim ukevartani vikvuratam, sheen tzarich lomar mimmitzrayim, ella hachi kaamar, meafar shel mitzrayim tol immi:
Matza shelosha im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot ad shemone. kelomar mikkever rishon ad shelishi en pachot mearba ammot velo yoter mishshemone:

Hare zo shechunat kevarot. venikkar shelleshem kevura netanum sham, veasur lefannotam. vaafillu met echad im nikkar shelleshem kevura natun sham asur lefannoto. ella shebbeechad o bishnayim anu tolin shello nikberu sham ella lefi shaa vehaya datam lefannotam. aval bishlosha muchach shezze makom meyuchad likvarot. veorech hammeara darkah lihyot shesh verachbah arba vaalachsonah odef shete ammot dehaynu shemone. lehachi tenan mearba ad shemone. kimlo mitta vekovreha lo garsinan la hacha:

Uvodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. shehammeara arba ammot al shesh, vehechatzer shehammearot petuchin lo mikkan umikkan shesh al shesh, dehachi sevira lehu lerabbanan beferek hammocher perot [kav:], nimtza orech shete mearot vechatzer shebbenehen shemone esre ammot. ulefi sheppeamim bodek meara achat baalachsonah vehaalachson shel meara achat odef shete ammot bekeruv, nimtzeu esrim ammot, shemone dimara rishona baalachsonah, veshesh dechatzer shebben shete hammearot, veshesh dimara sheniyya, dechad alachson amrinan, tere alachsoni lo amrinan, vehayenu dekatane esrim. veod tzarich livdok millemala umillematta esrim amma, dehaynu arbaim amma, deshemma zo hi meara shebbemizrach hechatzer veyesh adayin acheret kenegdah bemaarav hechatzer. i nammi zo hi shebbemaarav hechatzer veyesh adayin acheret bemizrach hechatzer:

Matza echad besof esrim bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. demi yemar demibbet hakkevarot haveya hahi meara, shemma kever acher hu vechatzer acheret shel adam acher, vetzarich laasot gam lesham kol bedikot dilel, dichmo sheyyesh sham kever kemo chen yesh acherim:
Sheraglayim laddavar. shezzo hassade asuya likvarim vehayu bah gam mearot acherot. umishshum raglayim laddavar tane kol hane mishnayot hacha:

Shalosh aratzot. beeretz yisrael chalukot zo mizzo leinyan biur. uviur haamur bechol makom bashsheviit hu shekkol zeman sheen nimtza bassade meoto hammin sheasaf elav babbayit, chayyav levaer oto hammin min habbayit miyyad. kegon im lakat teenim veasa mehen gerogarot, eno yachol leechol meotam gerogarot afillu bashshana hashsheviit ella kol zeman shennimtzaim teenim mechubbarot lailan, ucheshekkalu hatteenim min hailanot chayyav levaer haggerogarot shebbeveto, o leachlan kullan miyyad, o lehafekiran ad shello yishshaer mehem beveto, dichtiv (Vayikra 25) velivhemtecha velachayya, kol zeman shechayya ochelet bassade haachel livhemtecha min habbayit, kala lachayya min hassade kalle livhemtecha min habbayit. vehasheta kaamar sheeretz yisrael kullah nechleket lishlosha chalakim leinyan biur, vechol chelek vechelek mimmenna nechlak lishlosha chalakim:
Kol sheeno megaddel shikmim galil haelyon. shehashshikmim en gedelim ella bashshefela, vesiman laddavar kashshikmim asher bashshefela (Melachim 1 10):
Utechum teverya. hu haemek. ellu hashshelosha hem mehaggalil:
Hahar vehashshefela vehaemek. hem shelosha chalakim shel eretz yehuda:

Shefelat lud. vehar [shellah] lud. umibbet choron ad hayyam. hem shelosha chalukot shel ever hayyarden, ushefelat lud kishfelat haddarom, dechol zeman sheochel bishfelat [haddarom] ochel bishfelat [lud], vehahar shel shefelat lud ochlim bo kol zeman sheochlim behar hammelech:

Mibbet choron vead hayyam medina echat. vechol zeman shello chala lachayya meachat min hammekomot shebbenehem, yecholim kol anshe haggevul hahu leechol al yede hammakom haechad shello chala bo lachayya min hassade:
Amar lahem hamemunne bou vehafisu. hattilu fayis. hu haggoral hameforash perek 2‏ deyoma:
Mi shochet. af al gav dishchita keshera bezar, tikkenu vah payis, ditchillat avodat hattamid hi vachaviva lehu, i lo yattilu fayis atu leinnetzoye ala veatu vah lide sakkana:
Mi zorek. mekabbel haddam hu hazzorek, umishshum deikkar hakkarban haveya zerika lehachi nakat la:

Mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi. vehamedashshen hu hammaktir ketoret. umishshum dedishshun techillat avoda shel ketoret hi, nakat la. vechen dishshun hammenora techillat hahadlaka. vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora, kodem shechitat hattamid haya. veha demadkar beseder happayis shochet vezorek baresha, mishshum shehem ikkar avoda tefe:
Haoketz. haalya:
Hechaze. kol [hashshumman] haroe et hakkarka:
Vehaggera. makom shehu maale gera, hu hatztzavvar, uvo mechubbarim kene harea im hakkaved vehallev:

Zacha mi shezzacha. mi sheala lo happayis zorek et haddam, vehassamuch lo shochet. veaf al pi shehashshechita kodemet lekabbalat haddam, mikkol makom mippene sheavodat hazzerika gedola min hashshechita, shehashshechita cheshera vezar ma sheen ken bazzerika, lefichach zacha harishon shehiggia lo happayis bazzerika, vehashsheni hassamuch lo vashshechita, vehashshelishi medashshen mizbeach happenimi umaktir hakketoret, veharvii medashshen et hammenora umadlik et hannerot, vehachamishshi maale harosh veharegel lakkevesh, vehashshishshi shete hayyadayim, vehashshevii haoketz dehaynu haalya veharegel, vehashshemini hechaze vehaggera, vehatteshii shete defanot, vehaasiri hakkeravayim, vehaachad asar hassolet shel minchat nesachim shehi kereva im hattamid. vehashshenem asar chavitte chohen gadol, vehashshelosha asar yayin shel nesachim. kol ellu shelosha asar kohanim yotzim befayis echad kamforash perek 2‏ deyoma:
Nazir shehaya tame vesafek umuchlat besafek. safek im nitma vemet vesafek im hu metzora muchlat:

Ochel bakkadashim achar shishshim yom. aval kodem lachen lo, disfek metzora hu vead sheyyavi chapparato asur leechol bakkadashim. aval mishshum sefek nazir tame lo mittesar leechol bakkadashim, delo mikre mechussar kappara sheasur leechol bakkadashim ella mi shettuma yotza alav miggufo. ketzad, nazar sheloshim yom, uvayyom harishon era lo sefek tumat met usefek tzaraat, mazze veshone vetovel venithar mittumat met keillu va legalleach kedin nazir tame o kedin metzora shennitrappe, veeno yachol legalleach ad sheloshim yom miyyom shennazar, shemma nazir tahor hu veasur legalleach ad melot yeme nizro vead sheyyavi karbenotav, uleachar sheloshim yom megalleach, sefek tiglachat metzora sefek tiglachat tuma shel nazir usefek tiglachat tohora. umevi shete tzipporim kedin tiglachat chilluto shel metzora, vechattat haof habbaa al hassafek mishshum sefek nazir tame, veolat behema mishshum sefek nazir tahor. veaf al pi sheeno mevi shear karbanot shel tiglachat tohora, ha amrinan im gillach al achat mishshelashtan yatza. umatne aleha sheim eno nazir tahor shettehe olat nedava. vedin metzora muchlat shetztzarich shene tiglachot, achat leachar gemar chilluto keshennirpa mitztzarato, veachat leachar yeme safro leachar shessafar shiva min hattiglachat harishona, kedichtiv (Vayikra 14) vehaya vayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo, veze shehu sefek nazir eno yachol legalleach, hilkach tzarich lehametin sheloshim yom shel sefek nezirut tohora umegalleach tiglachat shel sefek yeme safro shel metzora usefek nezirut tohora, umevi olat behema shel sefek nezirut kede legalleach al hakkarbanot umatne aleha. ulemochorat yom tiglachto mevi karban metzora kede lehattiro bakkadashim, umevi chattat of, shechattat behema enah baa al hassafek, veeno mevi asham, shehaasham eno meakkev milleechol bakkadashim. venimtza shelleachar shishshim yom ochel bakkadashim, sheaz mevi kapparato al safek chilluto. vaadayin hu asur lishtot yayin velittamme lemetim, deshemma muchlat haya, vetiglachat metzora eno ole lo letiglachat nazir tahor velo letiglachat nazir tame, vetaun od shete tiglachot, echad lenazir tame veachat lenazir tahor, veim metzora muchlat haya, kol ma shemmana lime nezirato en olin lo, sheyyeme chilluto vime safro en olin lo, vetzarich limnot od sheloshim yom, uleachar sheloshim yom megalleach sefek nazir tame sefek nazir tahor, umevi chattat haof bisfek nazir tame, veolat behema bisfek nazir tahor kede legalleach al hakkarban, umatne aleha. vaadayin asur lishtot yayin velittamme lemetim, deshemma metzora muchlat haya, ulefichach hashshete tiglachot harishonot lo alu lo leshem nezirut, lo shel tuma velo shel tohora, veshemma nazir tame haya vetiglachat hashshelishit tiglachat shel tuma hi, lefichach tzarich limnot od sheloshim yom shel nezirut tohora, umevi karban nazir tahor, umatne, veachar kach muttar lishtot yayin ulehittame lemetim. vechen im nadar nezirut shana veera lo berosh shenato sefek tumat met usefek tzaraat, mone shana umegalleach tiglachat shel sefek tuma usefek tohora usefek tzaraat, umone shana sheniyya umegalleach umevi chapparato veochel bakkadashim, umone od shete shanim kodem sheyyishte yayin veyittamma lemetim:

Mesarum lachazzanim. otam kohanim shehechinu atzmam velo zachu vappayis vehayu levushim bigde chehunna, hayu mosrim otam lachazzanim, dehaynu hashshammashin haoskim betzarche hammikdash, kede sheyyafshitum bigde hakkodesh shealehem:
Velo hayu mannichim alehem ella michnasayim bilvad. velovshim bigde chol veachar kach mafshitim hammichnesayim, umannichim kol bigde chehunna veyotzim:

Vechatuv alehem tashmishe hakkelim. hachallonot shebbahen michnesayim katuv alehen michnesayim, veet shebbahen ketonet katuv alehen ketonet, vechen mitznefet veavnet. veseder levishat habbegadim, hammichnesayim techilla lechol shear begadim shel kodesh, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) umichnese vad yilbash al besaro, shello yehe davar kodem lammichnesayim, veachar kach hakketonet, veachar kach choger beavnet, veachar kach tzonef bemitznefet:
Lo vemidda velo vemishkal velo veminyan. kede sheyyimmachru bezol. i nammi mittoch sheen mochrin otan kederech shemmochrim bishar shanim, yinhagu bahem kedushshat sheviit velo atu lezalzole vehu:
Af lo aguddot. shello yimkor kederech shemmochrim bishar shanim:
Venetz chalav. meforash befirkin dilel:

Lo haya shover bo et haregel. kederech shehattabbachim osin shemmechattechin et haregel im haor shebbo, ella nokvin mittachat haarkuva hannimkeret im harosh vetole vo umafshit haregel im shear habbehema. veha kamashma lan dehakkeraayim bichlal hefshet hen:
Arkubbo. kemo arkuvo:
Merak et hahefshet. shehare lo hufshat ella ad hechaze vaadayin haor mechubbar bo:
Natal et happeder. hachelev:
Unetano al bet hashshechita. vezo hi derech kavod shel mala, shello yerae lichluch dam hashshechita:
Vehakkeres medichin otah. min happeresh shebbetochah, bifne atzmah:
Bevet hamedichin. belishka shehayta vammikdash. velo medichin otah im shear hakkeravayim, shello tetannefem:
Shelosha feamim. sheen hari yotze mehen ella vedochak lefi shehen dakkim:
Bemiutah. lechol happachot. veim ratza lehosif lahadichan yoter mishshelosha feamim mosif:
Lo hayu choftin oto. et hattamid bishte yadav leatzman o vishte raglav leatzman, kede shello laasot kechukkot haggoyim, shekkach hayu osim kesheshshochatin laavoda zara:
Ella maakidin oto. hayyad im haregel, kaakedat yitzchak:
Rosho laddarom. haya nishchat al yerech hammizbeach tzafona chedin ola, vehaya note rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav, sheim yarbitz gelalim lo yihye samuch lammizbeach:

Shel shachar. karban tamid shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit, lefi shebbabboker shemesh bammizrach vezorachat kenegdah lammaarav, vehakkatuv omer shenayim layyom, keneged hayyom, kelomar neged hashshemesh, shehashshemesh karuy yom:
Veshel ben haarbayim. shechamma vammaarav umeira cheneged hammizrach, haya nishchat al keren tzefonit mizrachit:

Betabbaat sheniyya. rachok min hammizbeach, lefi shehammizbeach gavoah umaafil kullo. veyochanan kohen gadol hitkin shishsha sedarim shel tabbaot, bechol seder arba tabbaot learbaa veesrim mishmerot kehunna, vehayu kevuot baritzpa asuyot kemin keshet, ulefi shello hayu choftim et hattamid keditnan beresh pirkin, hayu machnisin tzavvar habbehema veotan hattabbaot bishat shechita venoatzim rosh hattabbaat baaretz:

Venoten mizrachit tzefonit. techilla. leachar sheshshachat tamid shel shachar bekeren maaravit tzefonit holech letzad mizrach veomed baaretz vezorek haddam bichli lematta min [chut] hassikra, venoten shete mattanot shehen arba, achat shehi chishtayim bekeren mizrachit tzefonit, veholech lemaaravit deromit venoten achat shehi chishtayim bekeren maaravit deromit:
Vehabbazach. kaf katan:

Male vegadush ketoret. vehayta vetoch hakkaf haggadol. sheim lo haya haggadol, kevan shehakkatan gadush haya mitpazzer hakketoret laaretz beholachato. uvakkaf haggadol levad lo saggi, dechavod hu chelappe mala learot mikkaf gadush al haggechalim bishat hahaktara:
Vechissuy haya lo. labbazach:

Metutelet. rabbotay fershu cheen tabbaat haya lakkissuy millemala sheal yadah metaltel hakkissuy umesiro meal habbazach. uvearuch peresh, metutelet chatichat beged, kemo lo yetze haggamal bimtutelet deferek bamme vehema yotza. shehaya natun al kesuy habbazach kemin sudar katan lenoy:
Luleve zeradin. luleve ilan sheshshemo zardata:
Luleve haela. leshon kaela vechaallon (yeshaya 6) baaravi 48 uvelaaz 97:
Batna. milleshon batnim ushekedim, bilshon aravi 641:
Vaatadim. min mimmine hakkotzim shetztzomchim bo garinim shechorim kashim vehen neechalim:

Aval lealim. shel kol ellu yesh biur, deaf al gav delulavim en noshrim veen ani kore vahem velivhemtecha velachayya, kala lachayya min hassade kalle livhemtecha min habbayit, mikkol makom healim noshrim hen mimmekom chibburan, velaanafim shehem mechubbarim bo kare avihen, vechevan shehem noshrim yesh lahem biur:

Tishim ushelosha chele chesef uchele zahav. lo itparesh lamma hutzrechu leminyan shel kelim hallalu. uvayrushalmi vemassechet chagiga amru keneged tishim veshalosh azkarot shebbinvuot chaggay zecharya umalachi:
Hishku et hattamid. samuch lishchitato, kede sheyyehe oro nifshat yafe:
Bechos shel zahav. it deamre guzema katane delo shel zahav haya, ella shel nechoshet yafa chezahav. veit deamre vechos shel zahav mammash, sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut:
Af al pi shehu mevukkar. detamid taun bikkur mimmum arbaa yamim kodem shechitato, dumeya dese happesach:
Happegam. esev shekkorin 216 belaaz:
Vehayyarbuzin. 354 belaaz. vehashshotim hem 354 shel sadot, otan sheenan shel ginnot:
Vehachalaglogot. baaravi 234 uvelaaz 566:
Vechusbar. 401 belaaz. vedavka shel harim aval shel ginna chashuv hu: vechen karpas. shel neharot davka aval lo shel ginna:
Karpas. 107 belaaz:
Garger. 221 belaaz:
Shebbaafar. haggadel baachu. aval shel ginna chashuv hu:

Peturim min hammaaser. bechol hashshanim kedimfaresh taama sheen kayyotze vahen nishmar, sheenan necheshavin beene vaalehen umafkirin otan, vehefker patur min hammaaser dichtiv (Devarim 14) uva hallevi ki en lo chelek venachala immach, bedavar sheen lo chelek venachala immach yittol maasrotav, yatza hefker leket shichcha ufea sheyyesh lo chelek immach:

Venilkachim mikkol adam bashsheviit. lefi sheen derech leshamran. dechol davar shedderech leshamro asur liknot oto meam haaretz bashsheviit, shehu chashud lishmor happerot veshello lehafekiran, vehallokeach min hameshummar afillu kachatzi issar asur. vechol hanach dematnitin shechezkatan sheen meshammerin otan muttar likkach mehen meam haaretz kede mazon shalosh seuddot bilvad velo yoter, sheen mosrin deme perot sheviit leam haaretz, af al pi shehapperot hen min hahefker, yoter mimmazon shalosh seuddot, mippene shehu chashud leetzor haddamim veeno noheg bahem kedushshat sheviit:
Shello nechshedu alehem ovre avera. lahaviam min hashshamur. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hassefichin muttarin. lakachat mikkol adam, demachzekinan lehu sheenam min hashshamur:
Chutz missefiche cheruv. shechezkatan min hashshamur:
Lefi sheen kayyotze vahem beyarkot sade. sheen gedelim kemotan bammidbar. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Berru mishsham. mibben mekom haetzim:
Beomed chamesh seim. haya veotah maaracha shel ketoret kemo chamesh seim gechalim shemmehem haya chote letzorech hakketoret:
Beomed. kemo veomed:
Uveshshabbat beomed shemonat sein. lefi shetztzarich od gechalim lishne veziche levona shel lechem happanim shehayu maktirim mishshabbat leshabbat:
Machazirim otan lammaaracha. venisrafim sham betzidde hammaaracha haggedola:
Uvau lahem lelishkat haggazit. laasot peyasot:
Veim mitchashshev hu. im adam chashuv hu shebbene adam lemedim mimmennu tzarich lehachemir al atzmo:
Kevan shehotzi et harishona. letzorech tashmisho, maal:
Vachachamim omrim. lo maal:
Ad sheyyotzi. kol hammaot shebbakkis letzorech chullin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Peruta min hakkis ze. kelomar lo tichle feruta mikkis ze ad sheyyehe vah hekdesh:

Shoveret ketubbatah. kotevet shover al ketubbatah, zaniti veibbadti ketubbati, kede shello tuchal lachzor velitboa ketubbatah mimmennu. uvemakom sheen kotvin ketubba ella somchin al tenay bet din hu shekkotevet shover, aval bemakom shekkotvim ketubba, mekaraat ketubbatah veenah kotevet shover:
Maalin otah leshaar hammizrach. maalin umoridin otah kede leyaggeah, ulay tittaref datah vetode:
Sheal petach shaar nikkanor. adam sheshshemo nikkanor shehevi delatot leoto petach meelekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim venaasu lo nissim venikra shaar nikkanor al shemo kidamrinan beyoma [daf lach]:
Sheshsham mashkin et hassotot. devainan lifne Adonai:
Umetaharin et hayyoldot. kede sheyyaamdu al gabbe karbanan. vehu haddin zavin vezavot hatteunim karban:
Umetaharin et hammetzoraim. kedichtiv (Vayikra 14) veheemid hakkohen hametaher vechulei‏ lifne Adonai:
Ochez bivgadeha. bevet hatztzavvar shellahen:
Im nikreu. eno choshesh, veim nifremu eno choshesh. perima gedola mikkeria, shennikra likraim harebe. lashon acher, perima min hatztzedadin keria baorech:
Ad shemmegalle et libbah. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) ufara et rosh haishsha, en li ella roshah, gufa minnayin, talmud lomar haishsha, im ken ma talmud lomar et rosh, melammed shessoter et searah:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. shemma tetze zakkaa veyitgaru bah pirche chehunna sherau libbah nae vesaarah nae. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Lonviyyot. chanitot:

Lev aviv. amar lo avshalom leaviv, ketov li sheyyelchu immi shenayim ish sheevchar mikkol yisrael, katav lo. vehaya mare chotamo shel aviv lishnayim, veholchim acharav, lishnayim acherim veholchim acharav, ad shekkinnes matayim ish, kullan rashe sanhedraot. hare sheggannav lev aviv velev bet din. velev kol yisrael, dichtiv vayyegannev avshalom et lev anshe yisrael:
Maalin begizrin. shene etzim arukkim umeshufin hayu notnim letoch orech hammaaracha, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker, melammed shetteuna shene etzim:

Vechi chol haetzim kesherim lammaaracha. dekatane hechellu maalin begizrin setam velo ka mefaresh meeze min shel etzim hayu haggizrim. umeshane, hen, kelomar hakkol kesherim chutz mishshel zayit veshel gefen daasurin mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael, lefi shehen toanim perot. veit deamre taama, lefi shehen naasim deshen miyyad:
Murbiyyot. anafim shel teena. vedavka teenim raot. delo avdi fere:

Veshel etz shamen. haose shemen afarsemon. vaani shamati, shehu hailan shekkorim lo belaaz 146, uvaaravi 364. veaf al gav deetz maachol hu, en bo tzorech kemo vegefen vezayit, hilkach lo asaruhu mishshum yishshuvah shel eretz yisrael kederech sheasru haggefen vehazzayit:
Veetzba hakkaved. haya mafrish min hakkaved:
Velo haya mezizah. leetzba hakkaved mimmekomah, shehare hi hayta kereva im haoketz vehaalya, vehakkaved haya im haddofen hayemani, veharea im haggera ushete tzelaot immah, kemo shemmeforash besamuch:
Dofen yemani. chotech samuch lashshidra, ella shehaya manniach shete tzelaot lemala el hashshidra vechen shete tzelaot lematta:
Veharegel shel yamin bismolo. veaf al gav deholachat evarim lakkevesh avoda hi vaavoda fesula vismol, kevan delo meakkevet kappara, sharya afillu vismol, kidita veyoma:
Uvet oro lachutz. hammakom shemmafshitim mimmennu haor, vehu samuch lerashe haetzbaot:
Bazach. targum kaf achat, bazicha chada:
Hashshevii bassolet. leminchat nesachim sheim hattamid:

Bachavittin. minchat machavat shel kohen gadol machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baerev shemmakriv bechol yom. vehay deafsekeh lachavittin ben solet linsachim shehen tzarche tamid, mishshum desolet vachavittin lishnehem shem mincha, lechach pershan yachad:

Mechatzi hakkevesh ulematta bemaaravo. velo mechetzyo ulemala, kede shettehe nikkeret haholacha lammizbeach kesheyyachzeru millikrot et shema. vedavka vimot hachol hayu notnim evre tamid bammaarav letzad hashshechina, aval beshabbatot deshel musafin shehen chovat hayyom hayu vammaarav, hayu shel tamid bammizrach, kidmuchach bemassechet sukka perek hechalil:
Likrot et shema. vechol shear berachot, kidita lekamman beidach pirka:
Lakach bechor. baal mum, demuttar lezarim:
Muttar lemachro. uvilvad shello yimkerennu ella vaddamim shekkana oto, shello yistakker bo:
Muttarin lemachran. deha ketiv gabbe nevela (Devarim 14) o machor lenachri, ha lo asra tora ella lekayyeman laasot bahen sechora, aval benizdammen muttar:
Rabbi yehuda omer af mi shennitmanna. af al pi sheeno tzayyad ella shemmatza ofot temeim, kemo ki yikkare kan tzippor (Devarim 22). ufaleg attanna kamma deamar tzayyade davka:
Nitmanna. nizdammen, leshon vayman hammelech (Daniel 1):

Vachachamim osrim. lemi sheeno tzayyad, vaafillu en ummanuto bechach, vetaamayhu derabbanan lefi shehatztzayyadim shetztzerichim litten mas lammelech meummanutam hittiru lahem limkor chayya ofot vedagim temeim kede sheyyuchelu lifroa lammelech hammas shealehem, aval shear kol adam lo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Rabbi eliezer omer soter et hakkol. lo kol hayyamim kaamar, ella soter kol hakkarbanot. verabbi eliezer letameh deamar shello huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ella achar kol hammaasim kullam, achar havaat kol hakkarbanot, ucheshennitma kodem shehikriv kullam, have cheillu nitma shacharit kodem shehikriv shum echad mehem, vehave hakkarban shehikriv keillu hevio toch melot:

Vachachamim omrim yavi shear karbenotav veyithar. perush, lichsheyyithar. veoto hazzevach shehevi betohora lo yachzor viviennu. rabbanan letaamayhu deamre achar maase yechidi muttar lishtot yayin umuttar legalleach. hilkach kodem shennitma haya rauy lattiglachat velo yistor oto zevach, aval shear hazzevachim shehikriv mishshennitma, vadday soter, dikra kafid sheyyehu karbenot nazir kullan betohora:
Miryam hattarmodit. mittarmod hayta. vahalacha kachachamim:
Velamma amru shalosh aratzot. hoil veshalosh aratzot bechol achat hare kan tesha aratzot, lemay hilcheta amru shalosh aratzot labbiur vetu lo:

Sheyyihyu ochlim. ochlim bihuda ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbishlosh artzoteha, vechen baggalil, vechen beever hayyarden. aval en ochlim bihuda al yede otan shebbaggalil, velo vaggalil al yede otan shebbihuda, digmire deen chayya shebbihuda mitracheket latzet mihuda laggalil, umiggalil lihuda, aval yotza hi miggalil laggalil umiyyehuda lihuda:

Ushear kol haaratzot kehar hammelech. shear kol haaratzot shebbeeretz yisrael ochlim al yede happerot hannimtzaim behar hammelech, vehu haya rav happerot veacharon mikkol shear aratzot shebbeeretz yisrael:

Vechol haaratzot keachat lazzetim velattemarim. kol haaratzot shebbeeretz yisrael ochlim zetim utemarim al yede eretz achat shello chalu vah hazzetim vehattemarim lachayya min hassade, ben shettihye haaretz hahi bihuda o veever hayyarden o vaggalil. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Aval hassechachot. ilan sheyyesh lo anafim muvdalim ze mizze, veyesh kazzayit min hammet tachat echad mehen, veavar hannazir veen yadua im avar tachat heanaf hammaahil al hammet:
Vehapperaot. avanim o etzim boltim min hakkotel vetuma tachat echad mehem:
Uvet happeras. sade shennecherash bah kever osa bet happeras mea amma, shekkach shiaru shehammacharesha molicha et haetzem:
Veeretz haammim. sheggazru chachamim tuma al eretz haammim:
Golel. kissuy haaron:
Dofek. haaron atzmo shehakkissuy dofek alav:
Ureviit dam. afillu al massao umaggao en hannazir megalleach:

Veohel verova atzamot. im heehil al rova kav shel atzmot hammet, eno megalleach, ad sheyyaahil al chatzi kav. aval al magga umassa shel rova atzamot, megalleach, vaafillu hem nimmokim velo nishar bahem etzem kasseora shalem:
Vechelim hannogim bemet. shehem metammeim kammet atzmo. vehannogea bahem tame tumat shiva:
Vime gamro. yeme chilluto shel metzora:
Vime safro. leachar shennithar mitztzarato, dichtiv (Vayikra 14) veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim:
Al ellu en hannazir megalleach. al kol hanach dematnitin:
Umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii. ha lo kae ayyeme safro veayyeme gamro, delo shayyach behu hazzaa shelishi ushevii:

Veeno soter et hakkodmin umatchil umone miyyad. kol elle sheamarnu, enan olin lime hannezirut veen sotrin, ella achar sheyyazze shelishi ushevii veyithar im nitma betumat met, veachar sheyyashlim yeme gamro vime safro im nitztarea mashlim nezirato al minyan hayyamim shemmana kodem shennitma, veeno mevi karban tuma:
Beemet amru yeme hazzav vehazzava. kol yeme tumatam vime sefiratam shiva nekiyyim:
Vime hesgero shel metzora. shenneemar bo (sham 16) vehisgir et hannega shivat yamim, olin leminyan yeme hannezirut, veen tzarich lomar sheen sotrin et hakkodmim:

Rabbi eliezer omer yinnatnu leochlehen. af al pi shepperot hallalu behetter nilketu leachlan bikdushshat sheviit, mikkol makom savar rabbi eliezer deasur laze shennittenu lo perot hallalu leachlan levaddo, ella yinnatnu sheyyochlem hu im acherim, derabbi eliezer letaameh desavar kevet shammay deamre [leel mishna 2‏ perek 4] asur leechol perot sheviit betova, kelomar lehachazik tova lemi shennoten lo perot sheviit, derachamana afkerinhu, hilkach ze shennittenu lo perot sheviit bemattana o nafal lo birushsha asur sheyyochlem levaddo, shello yachazik tova lemi shehorisham lo o shennetanam lo bemattana, ella yochal otam im acherim kede shello yehe ochel perot sheviit betova:

Vachachamim omrim en hachote niskar. chachamim lidvarav derabbi eliezer kaamre leh, ledidan muttar leechol perot sheviit ben betova ben shello vetova, ella ledidach deamart asur leechol perot sheviit betova, hechi kaamart yinnatnu leochlehen, vesharet lemi shennittenu lo perot sheviit bemattana leachlan im acherim, vahalo matzinu chote niskar, sheochel otan im kol bene adam, vehaddin noten lefi devarecha sheyyimmachru leochlehen sheyyifra otam ma shehen shavin, kede shello yehe chote niskar, vehaddamim yitchalleku lechol adam. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Haochel meissat sheviit ad shello hurema challatah chayyav mita. delo tema en challa bashsheviit mishshum dichtiv leachla velo lisrefa, vechalla im nitmet teuna serefa, ka mashma lan dereshit arisotechem amra tora, meezo issa shettihye challa tarimu:
Hayta mitkassa vilvanim mechassah vishchorim. veim hayu shechorim yafin lah, mechassah bivgadim mechoarim:
Katlayot. anakim shemmesimim seviv hatztzavvar. umippene shehaishsha choneket atzmah bahem kede shetterae baalat basar nikraim katlayot:

Nezamim vetabbaot maavirim mimmenna. mefaresh baggemara delo tema sheyyanichu lah hannezamim vehattabbaot achar shekkaru begadeha vegillu et libbah, shezze yoter genay lah, kemo sheggenay yoter leadam arum sheyyelech beminalim beraglav millelech yachef, ka mashma lan delo:
Chevel mitzri. mefaresh bayrushalmi, lefi sheasta maase mitzrayim. veim en chevel mitzri mevi shear chavalim:
Vekoshro lemala middaddeha. shello yippelu begadeha vetishshaer aruma:
Vechol harotze lirot ba lirot. vedavka baanashim reshut veeno chova. aval benashim, chova al kol hannashim hammetzuyot sham lavo velirot, kedichtiv venivvasseru chol hannashim:
Vechol hannashim muttarot lirotah. chayyavin lirotah. hachi mefaresh la baggemara:
Ikkar. shoresh:
Arkavnin. rabbotay mefarshim esev haggadel etzel haddekel veole venichrach sevivot haddekel. vaani shamati shehu esev shealin shello domot leakrav:
Vehachalvitzin. hashsharashim shel netz chalav haamur lemala:
Habbuchriyya. korin lo baaravi 273:
Happua. baaravi 87 uvelaaz 234:
Harichpa. sharashim shettachat hakkarka, vesholkin otan veshotin memehen, umi sheyyesh lo tolaim bevitno yemitem:
En lahem biur. lefi shemmitkayyemim baaretz velo chale lachayya min hassade lefichach en tzarich levaaro min habbayit:

Demehem mitbaarim ad rosh hashshana. hachi kaamar demehem tzarich sheyyitbaaru min haolam kodem rosh hashshana shel sheminit. vehu haddin dahave matze lemitne mitbaarim achar rosh hashshana, sheim yeshnan leotan damim baolam achar rosh hashshana shel sheminit chayyav levaaram bikdushshat sheviit:

Kal vachomer lidmehen. verabbi meir savar machmir ani bidmehen yoter mibbahen atzman, difri atzmo minkar velo ate lemeaved beh sechora, aval damim lo minkere veate lemeaved beh sechora. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Tzeu ureu. al makom gavoah shehaya lahem bammikdash:
Zeman hashshechita. shehashshechita fesula vallayla, shenneemar (Vayikra 19) beyom zivchachem:
Barkay. heir vehivrik hashshachar:
Heir pene chol hammizrach. shello haya omer kelum ad sheheiru fene hammizrach, sheen maspik keshehivrik kinkudda vilvad. vahalacha chematya ven shemuel:
Ad shehu vechevron. otan haomdim lematta shoalim lo higgia haor bechevron, vehu omer hen. uchede lehazekir zechut haavot hakkevurim bechevron omrim ken:

Haggoyim en lahem nezirut. af al gav degoyim makrivin nedarim unedavot keyisrael, im nadar benazir en alav torat nezirut umuttar lishtot yayin velittamme lemetim, dichtiv beresh parashat nazir (Bamidbar 6) dabber el bene yisrael, bene yisrael nodrim benazir veen goyim nodrim benazir:
Shehu chofe et avdo. kofeho lishtot yayin ulehittame lemetim beal karcho:

Veeno chofe et ishto. beal karchah. uvishar nedarim sheyyesh bahem innuy nefesh o vittul melacha, en harav tzarich lachof et haeved ella hem betelim mealehem, dichtiv (sham 30) lesor issar al nafsho, mi shennafsho kenuya lo, yatza eved sheen nafsho kenuya lo. vechen hashshevuot kullam shennishba haeved, ben sheyyesh bahem innuy nefesh ben sheen bahem innuy nefesh, en rabbo tzarich lechofo, shemmealehem betelim, shehare en lo reshut leatzmo. aval nedarim sheen bahem innuy nefesh veen bahem bittul melacha lerabbo, chayyav haeved lekayyemam veen rabbo yachol lechofo alehem levattelam:

Mefer nidre ishto veeno mefer nidre avdo. sheim nitratztza veneder shennadra ishto achar shehefer lah verotze shettekayyemennu, enah chayyevet lekayyemo achar shehefer lah paam achat. veim kafa et avdo laavor al nidro veratza achar kach bekiyyumo, chayyav haeved lekayyemo:

Hefer leavdo yatza lecherut mashlim neziruto. lav davka hefer, ella im kafa et avdo lishtot yayin ulehittame lemetim veachar kach yatza haeved lecherut, chayyav haeved lehashelim neziruto achar sheyyatza lecherut. verambam peresh hefer leavdo yatza lecherut, shehaomer leavdo mufar lecha, paka zechut haadon mimmennu veyetze haeved lecherut bishvil ken vetzarich sheyyashlim neziruto. velibbi mehasses beferush ze:
Avar mikkeneged panav. shebbarach merabbo achar shennadar benazir:
Rabbi meir omer lo yishte. yayin kede sheyyitztaer veyashuv lerabbo sheyyichpehu laavor al nidro veyihye muttar lishtot yayin:
Verabbi yose omer yishte. shello yechele veyamut, shehare atid hu lashuv lerabbo, sheyyevakkesh rabbo acharav veyachzirennu, venimtza cheillu hu birshut rabbo:

Ushene fishpashin hayu lo leshshaar haggadol. hu shaar hahechol. vehayu lo delatot bitchillat ovi hakkotel shehaya avyo shesh ammot, udelatot acherot lesof avyo letzad penim. ushene fishpashin hanach shene fetachim ketannim echad mimin shaar haggadol veechad missemolo rachok ketzat min hashshaar. oto shebbaddarom ketiv sagur yihye lo yippateach, beshel atid, umissetama chen haya vevet olamim, aval pishpash shebbatztzafon haya fotcho al yede chor sheetzlo shettochev bo yado ad hashshechi vechofef yado vifnim, veal yede manul acher shebbo shenniftach lealtar beli torach:
Ufatach et happishpash. nichnas latta. vehi lishka achat happetucha lahechol:
Umin hatta el hahechol. veholech bachalal hahechol ad hashshaar haggadol shebbesof ovi hakkotel mibbifnim ufotcho uva lo el shaar hashsheni veomed bifnim ufotcho:
Neger. bariach shemmavriach mikketze haddelet liktze haddelet. perush acher, neger hayenu hayyated hannautz achore haddelet bannekev shebbaaskuppa:
Veet happotchot. hammanulim vehamasgerot:
Uvaacharona. shello haya rak meat deshen velo haya yachol likkach bechafnav, kibbed shear haddeshen letoch hatteni:

Vehinnicho. latteni sham veyatza. aval miyyad lo haya motzio, shekkevan shetztzarich latet haddeshen etzel hammizbeach kedma kemo dishshun hammenora, mamtin ad leachar zerikat hattamid, shehaya ose hatavat shete nerot vegomer hashelamat dishshun hammenora, veaz hayu shenehem motziin ze hatteni veze hakkuz veshofchin haddeshen bemakom echad etzel hammizbeach venivlaim sham bimkoman:

Umatza shete nerot mizrachiyyot dolkim. hay tanna savar menora mizrach umaarav hi munnachat. ufeamim shemmotze gam hashshear dolkim, venakat shete nerot mizrachiyyot dolkim mishshum dishar nerot afillu dolkim mechabban umedashshenan, veellu shete nerot im metzaan dolkim eno mechabban. veod mishshum dekatane vassefa metzaan shekkavu leellu mizrachiyyot chozer umadlikan, uvishar nerot metzaan shekkavu eno madlikan ad haerev:

Medashshen et hashshear. chamesh nerot shelletzad maarav, mesir mehen hashshemen hayyashan vehappetila hayeshana vehaddeshen, venoten hakkol bakkuz, venoten shemen chadash ufetila chadasha, uleachar shechitat hattamid uzerikat damo, medashshen hashshene mizrachiyyot venoten bahen shemen ufetila chadasha. veha demafsik hahatava vishchitat hattamid uzerikat damo veeno metivan kullan yachad, mishshum dichtiv (Shemot 30) babboker babboker behetivo et hannerot, amra tora challek hahatava lishne vekarim, vaavid hatavat chamesh nerot beresha vahadar hatavat shete nerot, mishshum dechevan deatchil, avid rubba. vehay dela avid shitta vahadar chad, mishshum dichtiv behetivo et hannerot, [en] hatavat nerot pachot [mishshetayim]. vehane mille vizman sheen hannes, kegon leachar shemmet shimon hatztzaddik. aval kodem shemmet shimon hatztzaddik shehaya ner maaravi dolek tamid bederech nes, kidtanya michutz lefarochet haedut, edut hu shehashshechina shora veyisrael, zo ner maaravi shennoten bah shemen kemiddat chavroteha umimmenna haya matchil uvah haya mesayyem, keshehaya va lehetiv hashshete nerot mizrachiyyot, lo haya medashshen ella hanner harishon bilvad umetivo, umanniach hanner hashsheni hassamuch lo dolek ad haerev shemmadlik et hannerot umimmennu madlik kol hannerot haacherim, veachar shehidlik shear hannerot metivo umedashsheno lener ze baerev umadliko. veaf al gav dichtiv behetivo et hannerot deen hatava fachot mishshetayim, hachi adif tefe shello lehetiv ki im ner echad min hashshete nerot mizrachiyyot ulehanniach hanner hashsheni dolek shello lehetivo ad haerev, kede lefarsem hannes shehu dolek tamid. uma shemmetiv chamesh shel tzad maarav techilla, velo chamesh letzad mizrach ulevassof shetayim shel maarav, umehem haya lo lehadelik, vela avid hachi mishshum dichtiv (Vayikra 24) lehaalot ner tamid michutz lefarochet haedut yaaroch oto lifne Adonai, amra tora keva ner lehadelik mimmennu shear nerot, veeze ze ner sheni shel tzad mizrach, vehu karuy ner maaravi, dechi ayyel bahechol behahu ner paga beresha, veen maavirin al hammitzvot, veikka lememar behahi ittokam hannes vehukba lehadelik mimmennu. uvener rishon i efshar, deha chetiv lifne Adonai, meoto ner shel tzad shechina shehu letzad maarav, veen ner rishon karuy lifne Adonai:
Metzaan shekkavu. hashshetayim mizrachiyyot. kegon leachar shemmet shimon hatztzaddik:

Medashshenan umadlikan min haddolkim. lo shehaya noten petila chadasha veshemen chadash kederech hatavat hannerot, shehare leolam en metivin shete nerot mizrachiyyot ella leachar shechitat hattamid kede lehafesik ben hatavat chamesh lahatavat shetayim, ella medashshenan hayenu shemmesir haddeshen shebberosh happetila hayeshana, umagbihah umadlikah, kede lihyot nikkar yafe hefsek shebben hatavat chamesh nerot lishtayim. veim en bannerot dolkim, madlikan mimmizbach haola:

Umedashshen et hashshear. zo hatavat chamesh hannerot, shennoten petila chadasha veshemen chadash umannichan kevuyot ad haerev shebba umadlik. umedashshen dehacha eno chemo medashshen shel shenayim mizrachit dilel. uleachar shechitat hattamid uzerikat damo chozer umedashshen [hammizrachit] venoten shemen ufetila chadasha umannichah ad haerev kevuya. vener sheniyya shekkeruya maaravit kemo chen medashshen umesir hashshemen vehappetila yeshana venoten shemen chadash umadlikah mimmizbach haola kede lehadelik mimmenna baerev hannerot haacherot, shenner maaravi hukba lehadelik mimmennu nerot acherot, ulechach nammi madlikah im metzaah kevuya kodem shechitat hattamid, kevan shetztzarich mikkol makom lehadelikah keshebba umetiv leachar shechita. kach matzati ferush mishna zo veferushe rabbenu baruch bar yitzchak, vehu hamechuvvar shebbechol happerushim. vedivre harambam bemishna zo temuhim meod, vegam ma shessover shehatavat hannerot hi hadelakatan veshehayu madlikin hannerot shel menora kullan babboker kederech shemmadlikin baerev, pelia nisgava beenay, velo shamati velo raiti leechad merabbotay shessover ken:
Veeven hayta lifne hammenora. lefi shehammenora gevoha shemona asar tefachim vehaya tzarich laalot lemakom gavoah kede lehetiv et hannerot:
Uvah shalosh maalot. keneged shalosh haalaot shekketuvot bammenora, behaalotcha et hannerot, veheela et neroteha, lehaalot ner tamid:

Vehinniach hakkuz veyatza. ad leachar zerikat dam hattamid sheaz ose hatavat shete nerot vehotzio, vechen chavero hotzi et hatteni. ucheshehotziu hishtachavu bigmar haavoda, velo achshav, sheadayin lo nigmar avodatan:

Vehiggia sheat habbiur. zeman biur happerot lefi mekoman, keditnan leel shalosh aratzot labbiur. uvabberayta [pesachim 53.] shaninu ochlim baanavim ad happesach, bazzetim ad haatzeret, baggerogarot ad hachanukka, battemarim ad happurim, vechullan shel shana hashsheminit. uzemannim hallalu bistam, sheen yadua im kala lachayya min hassade im lav, aval beyadua, hakkol lefi ma shekkalu:

Mechallekan mazon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. meanshe veto, veachar kach mechallek lishchenav velikrovav umeyuddaav, umotzi umanniach al petach beto veomer, achenu vet yisrael, mi shetztzarich littol yittol:
Vaaniyyim ochlim achar habbiur aval lo ashirim. dichtiv (Shemot 23) veachlu evyone ammecha veyitram tochal chayyat hassade, evyone ammecha velo ammecha:
Echad aniyyim veechad ashirim. kare veh veachlu evyone vegam ammecha. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hatteni. leshon vesamta battene. dome lesal ufiv rachav:
Vehakkuz. kiton belashon aravi korin 64:
Shene maftechot. liftoach shene manulim shebbappishpash hatztzefoni:
Tarkav. keli shemmachazik shelosha kabbin. uleshon tarkav, tere vekav. vedome haya letarkav aval lo haya machazik ella kabbayim vachetzi, veshel zahav haya:

Echad yored leammat hashshechi. happishpash hatztzefoni ditnan lekamman ba lo lappishpash hatztzefoni, hayu lo shene manulin, haechad haya lematta vifnim betachtito shel petach, vehaya hakkohen harotze likkanes machnis ammat yado vachor shebbakkotel ad bet hashshechi shello ufoteach beyado derech penim, vehaacher poteach bemafteach miyyad belo torach kishar kol happetachim:
Kevan. kemo [pesachim 37:] yaasenna vidfus veyikbeenna chevan, kelomar maher belo torach:
Rauhu echav. leoto shettaram et hammizbeach:
Sheyyarad. min hammizbeach venatan et haggechalim bemizracho:
Vehem ratzu vechulei‏ vekiddeshu yedehem veraglehem. kede laavod avoda:

Sonkin. mesallekim otan. leshon nianua venidnud. vechen kigdi misannekan [pesachim daf 3:], gedi shehu ayef al yede nianua unegichot shemmenaggechin ze baze. af kan sonkim menaanim umehappechin otan betzinnorot letzidde hammizbeach:
Bassovev al hakkavesh. kelomar al hakkevesh shekkeneged hassovev:
Hammakom nivvelah. shemmegalle kohen et roshah vesoter et saara vekorea et begadeha:
Hi gilleta et atzmah. yashva befarashat derachim vegilleta atzmah lannoef:
Hammakom gilla aleha. shekkohen maamidah al shaar nikkanor umare kelonah lakkol:
Bayyarech hitchila vaavera techilla. bederech tashmish hayyarech nehene techilla bekeruv basar:
Ushear kol hagguf lo falet. shear evre gufah enam peletim min hacholi, veaf al pi shello huzkeru bammikra ella beten veyarech:
Secharo muttar. veen bo kedushshat sheviit. veaf al gav dishviit tofeset dameha, hay lav deme sheviit hu:
Lekot li bo yarak. leshon mecher hu, demashma lekot li shavyo yarak, aval lekot li leshon sechirut hu velo leshon mecher:
Kikkar befunedyon. lo sheamar lo etten lecha punedyon, rak kikkar shave punedyon:
Kesheelkot yarkot sade avi lach muttar. mishshum demattenat chinnam yahave ze laze, lefi sheyyarkot sade metzuyin:
Lakach mimmennu bistam. behakkafa kederech mochrim bechanut:
Lo yeshallem lo middeme sheviit. dahave kischora:

Ochlim al hammufkar. ochlim mimma shebbabbayit al yede shemmatzuy meoto hammin bassade bemakom mufkar. aval im pasak vechala oto hammin mimmakom hammufkar, af al pi shennimtza mimmennu bemakom hashshamur babbattim o vagginnot chayyav levaer, kidamran kala lachayya min hassade kalle livhemtecha min habbayit:
Rabbi yose mattir af al hashshamur. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Ochlim al hattefichim. al ma shemmesimim haofot battefichim, shehen kele cheres habbenuyim bakkotel asher sham tzipporim yekannenu. veochlim mimma shebbabbayit kol zeman shemmatzuy meoto hammin battefichim:
Veal haddufera. ilan sheose perot shene feamim bashshana, ochlim barishon ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbeminam:
Aval lo al hassitvaniyyot. en ochlin baanavim al yede haanavim haggedelim bimot hassetav:
Rabbi yehuda mattir. leechol baanavim al yede hassitvaniyyot kol zeman shebbikkeru kodem sheyyichle hakkayitz. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ketzad hu mekanne lah amar lah bifne shenayim al tedabberi im ish peloni kulei. baggemara mefaresh lematnitin hachi, amar lah bifne shenayim al tedabberi vedibbera, al tedabberi venistera, velo kelum hu veenah asura lo levalah velo latteruma. amar lah al tissatri vedibbera immo shello basseter, adayin mutteret levalah umutteret leechol batteruma im eshet kohen hi: nichnesa immo levet hasseter veshahata immo chede tuma asura levetah vaasura leechol batteruma. veshiur kede tuma, kede litzlot betzat tarnegolet ulegamah:

Veim met choletzet velo mityabbamet. veim met balah kodem sheyyashkenna, choletzet velo mityabbemet. dichtiv beishsha shemmatza bah ervat davar (Devarim 24) veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher, vedarshinan leish acher velo layyavam. veaf al pi chen enah mutteret lezar belo chalitza, shekkeshem sheim haya balah chay lo hayta mutteret belo get, kach enah mutteret min hayyavam belo chalitza:
